-- v2 numeric contract. +Z is north; all heights are local surface Y.
local Layout = {}
local function point(x, y, z, kind)
	return { x = x, y = y, z = z, kind = kind or "Walk" }
end
function Layout.protected(x, z, radius)
	radius = radius or 0
	-- Pad plus independent eight-stud apron; west extension includes the arch.
	return (math.abs(x) <= 24 + radius and math.abs(z + 58) <= 20 + radius)
		or (x >= -38 - radius and x <= -16 + radius and math.abs(z + 58) <= 16 + radius)
end
function Layout.assemble(config, seed, _fixed)
	assert(type(seed) == "number" and seed % 1 == 0 and seed > 0, "positive integer seed")
	local l = {
		seed = seed,
		pieces = {},
		solids = {},
		ramps = {},
		sockets = {},
		routes = {},
		crossLinks = {},
		jumps = {},
		gullies = {},
	}
	local function chunk(id, x, z)
		local d = config.Pieces[id]
		table.insert(l.pieces, { id = id, x = x, z = z, width = d.width, depth = d.depth })
	end
	chunk("I01", 0, -58)
	chunk("I02", 0, 32)
	chunk("I04", -40, 12)
	chunk("I03", 40, 12)
	chunk("I06", -32, -28)
	local function box(name, x, y, z, w, h, d, role)
		table.insert(l.solids, { name = name, x = x, y = y, z = z, w = w, h = h, d = d, role = role or "Floor" })
	end
	local function ramp(name, a, b, width)
		table.insert(l.ramps, { name = name, a = a, b = b, width = width })
	end
	-- Opposing switchback runs stay within the 40x40 hill envelopes.
	for _, hill in { { -40, 18, "Mountain" }, { 40, 14, "GroveHill" } } do
		local x, h, name = hill[1], hill[2], hill[3]
		local direction = x < 0 and 1 or -1
		ramp(name .. "SouthRamp", point(x - direction * 20, 0, 0), point(x + direction * 8, h, 0), 12)
		ramp(name .. "NorthRamp", point(x + direction * 20, 8, 24), point(x - direction * 8, h, 24), 12)
		-- Clip the inner south corner so cover and hillside leave a body-clear bypass.
		box(name .. "LandingS", x + direction * 12, h / 2, 0, 8, h, 12)
		box(name .. "LandingSCorner", x + direction * 14, h / 2, 12, 12, h, 12)
		box(name .. "LandingN", x - direction * 14, h / 2, 18, 12, h, 24)
		box(name .. "Summit", x, h / 2, 12, 16, h, 12)
	end
	-- Rear shelves stay outside the carrying loop and meet the summit's north edge.
	for _, hill in { { -40, 18, "Mountain" }, { 40, 14, "GroveHill" } } do
		local x, h, name = hill[1], hill[2], hill[3]
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local top = h - (4 - i) * 4
			box(name .. "RearTerrace" .. i, x, top / 2, 34 + (4 - i) * 4, 44 - i * 4, top, 8)
		end
	end
	-- Solid voxel skirts under the thin ramp decks: the hills must read as land,
	-- not floating ribbons. Each two-stud tread rises less than one stud; the
	-- continuous twelve-wide deck above remains the carrying/navigation surface.
	for _, r in l.ramps do
		local run = math.abs(r.b.x - r.a.x)
		local count = math.ceil(run / 2)
		assert(math.abs(r.b.y - r.a.y) / count <= 1.5, "voxel tread height")
		for i = 1, count do
			local t0, t1 = (i - 1) / count, i / count
			local low = math.min(r.a.y + (r.b.y - r.a.y) * t0, r.a.y + (r.b.y - r.a.y) * t1)
			local top = math.max(0, low - 0.6)
			if top > 0 then
				box(
					r.name .. "Voxel" .. i,
					r.a.x + (r.b.x - r.a.x) * (t0 + t1) / 2,
					top / 2,
					r.a.z,
					run / count,
					top,
					12
				)
			end
		end
	end
	box("CampTerrace", 0, 4, 32, 40, 8, 40)
	-- Shoulder terraces flank the central ramp without entering the cover lane.
	for i = 1, 8 do
		for _, x in { -16, 17 } do
			box("CampShoulderStep" .. i, x, i / 2, 3.5 + i, x < 0 and 8 or 6, i, 1)
		end
	end
	ramp("CampSouthRamp", point(-4, 0, 0), point(-4, 8, 12), 16)
	ramp("CampNorthRamp", point(0, 0, 64), point(0, 8, 52), 16)
	box("CoverWest", -10, 4, -10, 8, 8, 12, "Cover")
	box("CoverEast", 10, 3, 8, 8, 6, 12, "Cover")
	l.routes.Quick = {
		point(0, 0, -58),
		point(0, 0, -22),
		point(0, 0, -2),
		point(-4, 0, 0),
		point(-4, 8, 12, "ClimbRamp"),
		point(0, 8, 32),
	}
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		l.routes[side < 0 and "Ridge" or "Grove"] = {
			point(side * 16, 0, -58),
			point(side * 24, 0, -44),
			point(side * 24, 0, -24),
			point(side * 24, 0, -18),
			point(side * 16.5, 0, -2),
			point(-4, 0, 0),
			point(-4, 8, 12, "ClimbRamp"),
			point(-4, 8, 18),
			point(side * 6, 8, 18),
			point(0, 8, 32),
		}
	end
	table.insert(l.routes.Grove, 5, point(16, 0, -12))
	table.insert(l.routes.Grove, 7, point(0, 0, -2))
	-- Ridge uses the ground bypass east of the recovery cutout.
	l.routes.Ridge = {
		point(-16, 0, -58),
		point(-10, 0, -44),
		point(-10, 0, -24),
		point(0, 0, -24),
		point(0, 0, -2),
		point(-4, 0, 0),
		point(-4, 8, 12, "ClimbRamp"),
		point(-4, 8, 18),
		point(-8, 8, 18),
		point(0, 8, 32),
	}
	-- Lower link detours six studs south of the cover so its full width is clear.
	l.crossLinks = {
		{ point(-10, 0, -24), point(0, 0, -24), point(0, 0, -18), point(24, 0, -18) },
		{ point(-8, 8, 18), point(0, 8, 18), point(8, 8, 18) },
	}
	l.gullies = { { x = -32, z = -28, w = 32, d = 24 } }
	box("RecoveryFloor", -32, -5, -28, 32, 4, 24)
	-- Bent stone chain fits the stated 32x24 footprint: edge gaps 4 then 6.
	box("JumpStart", -55, -1, -34, 12, 2, 12)
	box("Stone1", -43, -1, -34, 8, 4, 8)
	box("Stone2", -31, -0.5, -34, 8, 5, 8)
	-- One stud less gap gives the carrying jump a margin at default gravity.
	box("Stone3", -25, 0, -20.5, 8, 6, 9)
	box("JumpLanding", -25, -1, -10, 12, 2, 12)
	-- Overlap the banks: ending at the cutout edge leaves a vertical floor seam.
	ramp("RecoveryWest", point(-40, -3, -24), point(-49.5, 0, -24), 12)
	ramp("RecoveryEast", point(-23.5, -3, -32), point(-14.5, 0, -32), 12)
	l.jumps = {
		{ from = point(-43, 1, -34), to = point(-31, 2, -34, "Jump"), gap = 4 },
		{ from = point(-31, 2, -34), to = point(-25, 3, -20, "Jump"), gap = 5 },
	}
	-- Open rock cutbacks: twelve-stud through passages, no interior.
	box("CutbackRockA", 38, 4, -18, 8, 8, 8, "Cover")
	box("CutbackRockB", 38, 3, -38, 8, 6, 8, "Cover")
	box("CutbackRockC", 62, 4, -26, 8, 8, 8, "Cover")
	box("CutbackRockD", 62, 3, -46, 8, 6, 8, "Cover")
	for x = -76, 76, 4 do
		for z = -76, 76, 4 do
			if not Layout.protected(x, z) then
				table.insert(l.sockets, point(x, 0, z))
			end
		end
	end
	return l
end
function Layout.length(route)
	local length = 0
	for i = 2, #route do
		local a, b = route[i - 1], route[i]
		length += math.sqrt((a.x - b.x) ^ 2 + (a.y - b.y) ^ 2 + (a.z - b.z) ^ 2)
	end
	return length
end
function Layout.hillPaths(l)
	local paths = {}
	for _, r in l.ramps do
		if r.name == "MountainSouthRamp" or r.name == "GroveHillSouthRamp" then
			local side, route = r.a.x < 0 and -1 or 1, {}
			for _, p in { { 32, 0 }, { 28, 0 }, { 28, 12 }, { 40, 12 }, { 54, 12 }, { 54, 24 }, { 48, 24 } } do
				table.insert(route, point(side * p[1], r.b.y, p[2]))
			end
			table.insert(paths, route)
		end
	end
	return paths
end
function Layout.referencePoints(l)
	local points = {}
	for _, route in Layout.hillPaths(l) do
		for _, p in route do
			table.insert(points, p)
		end
	end
	for _, r in l.ramps do
		for i = 0, 4 do
			local t = i / 4
			table.insert(
				points,
				point(r.a.x + (r.b.x - r.a.x) * t, r.a.y + (r.b.y - r.a.y) * t, r.a.z + (r.b.z - r.a.z) * t)
			)
		end
	end
	for _, x in { -14, 14 } do
		table.insert(points, point(x, 8, 24))
	end
	return points
end
function Layout.loopCarrySteps(_l)
	local steps = {}
	local function add(name, x, y, z, kind)
		local p = point(x, y, z, kind)
		p.name = name
		table.insert(steps, p)
		return p
	end
	add("south terrace", -4, 8, 16)
	add("camp ramp lip", -4, 8, 12)
	add("camp descent", -4, 0, 0, "Dodge")
	add("west approach", -16.5, 0, 0)
	add("west corner clearance", -18, 0, -6)
	add("hill bypass south", -18, 0, -10)
	add("hill bypass west", -64, 0, -10)
	add("hill west turn", -64, 0, 0)
	add("hill foot", -60, 0, 0)
	add("hill south ramp", -32, 18, 0, "ClimbRamp")
	add("hill south landing", -28, 18, 0)
	add("hill summit east", -28, 18, 12)
	add("hill summit centre", -40, 18, 12)
	add("hill summit east back", -28, 18, 12)
	add("hill south landing back", -28, 18, 0)
	add("hill ramp back", -32, 18, 0)
	add("hill foot back", -60, 0, 0, "ClimbRamp")
	add("stone west bypass", -64, 0, 0)
	add("stone bypass north", -64, 0, -10)
	add("stone bypass approach", -56, 0, -10)
	add("stone takeoff landing", -55, 0, -34)
	add("first stone", -43, 1, -34, "Jump").takeoff = point(-50.5, 0, -34)
	add("four-stud gap", -31, 2, -34, "Jump").takeoff = point(-39.8, 1, -34)
	add("six-stud gap", -25, 3, -20, "Jump").takeoff = point(-29, 2, -30.5)
	add("stone north landing", -25, 0, -10, "Jump").takeoff = point(-25, 3, -16.8)
	for _, p in steps do
		if p.takeoff then
			local t = p.takeoff
			local dx, dz = p.x - t.x, p.z - t.z
			local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
			p.runup = point(t.x - dx / length * 6.6, t.y, t.z - dz / length * 6.6)
		end
	end
	add("east stone clearance", -18, 0, -10)
	add("inner return corner", -18, 0, -6)
	add("inner return turn", -16.5, 0, 0)
	add("centre return lane", 0, 0, 0)
	add("dodge destination", 0, 0, -24)
	add("automatic secure return", 0, 0, -40, "Return")
	return steps
end
function Layout.dodgePoints()
	-- CampSouthRamp rises from Y0 at Z0 to Y8 at Z12.
	return { point(0, 16 / 3, 8), point(0, 0, -4) }
end
function Layout.pvpRoutes()
	return {
		Tester = { point(0, 0, -58), point(-42, 0, -58), point(-62, 0, -56) },
		Dummy = {
			point(0, 8, 32),
			point(-4, 8, 16),
			point(-4, 8, 12),
			point(-4, 0, 0),
			point(-16.5, 0, 0),
			point(-18, 0, -6),
			point(-18, 0, -10),
			point(-64, 0, -10),
			point(-64, 0, -56),
		},
		Pacing = { point(-64, 0, -56), point(-64, 0, -54), point(-64, 0, -56) },
		Mercy = { point(-64, 0, -56), point(-72, 0, -48), point(-64, 0, -56) },
		Leave = { point(-64, 0, -56), point(-68, 0, -52) },
		-- The west apron starts at X=-38: crossing it secures automatically.
		Winner = { point(-64, 0, -56), point(-42, 0, -56), point(-34, 0, -56, "Return") },
	}
end
-- Drop candidates belong to traversable routes, never the old arbitrary floor grid.
-- Sample grounded segments only; jump/recovery endpoints remain known safe spots.
function Layout.dropPoints(l)
	local routes = table.clone(l.routes)
	for i, route in l.crossLinks do
		routes["Link" .. i] = route
	end
	routes.Carry = Layout.loopCarrySteps(l)
	for name, route in Layout.pvpRoutes() do
		routes["Pvp" .. name] = route
	end
	local points, seen = {}, {}
	local function add(p)
		local key = string.format("%.3f:%.3f:%.3f", p.x, p.y, p.z)
		if not seen[key] and not Layout.protected(p.x, p.z, 3) then
			seen[key] = true
			table.insert(points, point(p.x, p.y, p.z))
		end
	end
	for _, route in routes do
		for i, p in route do
			add(p)
			local previous = route[i - 1]
			if previous and p.kind ~= "Jump" and p.kind ~= "Recovery" then
				local steps = math.ceil(math.sqrt((p.x - previous.x) ^ 2 + (p.z - previous.z) ^ 2) / 2)
				for n = 1, steps - 1 do
					local t = n / steps
					add(
						point(
							previous.x + (p.x - previous.x) * t,
							previous.y + (p.y - previous.y) * t,
							previous.z + (p.z - previous.z) * t
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return points
end
function Layout.validate(config, l)
	assert(#l.pieces == 5 and #l.crossLinks == 2 and #l.jumps == 2, "required v2 topology")
	local contract = {
		{ "I01", 0, -58 },
		{ "I02", 0, 32 },
		{ "I04", -40, 12 },
		{ "I03", 40, 12 },
		{ "I06", -32, -28 },
	}
	for i, p in l.pieces do
		local c = contract[i]
		local d = assert(config.Pieces[p.id], "unknown chunk")
		assert(p.id == c[1] and p.x == c[2] and p.z == c[3], "v2 fixed landmark")
		assert(p.width == d.width and p.depth == d.depth, "unstretched footprint")
		assert(math.abs(p.x) + p.width / 2 <= 80 and math.abs(p.z) + p.depth / 2 <= 80, "160 envelope")
	end
	for _, r in l.ramps do
		local run = math.sqrt((r.a.x - r.b.x) ^ 2 + (r.a.z - r.b.z) ^ 2)
		assert(r.width >= 12 and math.deg(math.atan(math.abs(r.a.y - r.b.y) / run)) <= 35, "ramp carrying contract")
	end
	for name, route in l.routes do
		local length = Layout.length(route)
		assert(
			length >= (name == "Quick" and 90 or 110) and length <= (name == "Quick" and 105 or 130),
			"route length " .. name .. " " .. length
		)
		for _, p in route do
			assert(p.kind ~= "Jump", "mandatory jump")
		end
	end
	assert(not Layout.protected(0, 12, config.ThrowRadius), "camp protected overlap")
	return true
end
function Layout.signature(l)
	local v = {}
	for _, p in l.pieces do
		table.insert(v, p.id .. ":" .. p.x .. ":" .. p.z)
	end
	return table.concat(v, "|")
end
function Layout.selfTest(config, log)
	for seed = 1, 50 do
		local l = Layout.assemble(config, seed, false)
		Layout.validate(config, l)
		assert(
			Layout.signature(l) == Layout.signature(Layout.assemble(config, seed, true)),
			"v2 landmarks vary by seed"
		)
	end
	log("PASS 50 seeds; fixed v2 contract; measured 3 walking routes; slopes/gaps")
end
if workspace and workspace:GetAttribute("UseMeadowV4") == true then
	require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.Gameplay).install(Layout)
end
return Layout
ReplicatedStorage.GreyboxLootRules:
-- Authoritative, non-yielding item transitions. Adapters provide live range/sight/floor checks.
local Rules = {}
function Rules.new(config)
	return { config = config, actors = {}, items = {}, serial = 0, active = nil }
end
function Rules.actor(r, actor)
	local s = {
		phase = "Home",
		mercy = 0,
		shield = 0,
		shieldUsed = false,
		firstHitUsed = false,
		completed = 0,
		cooldown = 0,
	}
	r.actors[actor] = s
	return s
end
function Rules.spawn(r, position)
	assert(not r.active, "unresolved provisional item")
	r.serial += 1
	local item = {
		id = (r.identityPrefix or "arena1") .. ":" .. r.serial,
		state = "Nest",
		position = position,
		version = 0,
	}
	r.items[item.id], r.active = item, item
	return item
end
function Rules.audit(r)
	local active = 0
	for id, item in r.items do
		assert(id == item.id, "identity corruption")
		local carriers = 0
		for actor, s in r.actors do
			if s.item == item then
				carriers += 1
				assert(
					item.holder == actor and (item.state == "Carried" or item.state == "Secured"),
					"duplication/illegal holder"
				)
			end
		end
		if item.state == "Carried" or item.state == "Secured" then
			assert(carriers == 1 and item.holder ~= nil, "LOOT lost/duplicated")
		else
			assert(carriers == 0 and item.holder == nil, "orphan carrier")
			assert(
				item.state == "Nest"
					or item.state == "Dropped"
					or item.state == "Placed"
					or item.state == "Retired",
				"lost state"
			)
		end
		if item.state == "Nest" or item.state == "Carried" or item.state == "Dropped" then
			active += 1
			assert(r.active == item, "provisional item lost")
		end
	end
	assert(active == (r.active and 1 or 0), "duplicated arena LOOT")
	return true
end
-- Deadline belongs to the original item through every drop and handoff.
function Rules.expire(r, now)
	local item = r.active
	if not item or item.securePending or not item.escapeDeadline or now < item.escapeDeadline then
		return false
	end
	if item.state ~= "Carried" and item.state ~= "Dropped" then
		return false
	end
	for _, s in r.actors do
		if s.item == item then
			s.item = nil
		end
		if s.hold and s.hold.item == item then
			s.hold = nil
		end
	end
	item.state, item.holder, item.position, item.settle = "Retired", nil, nil, nil
	item.version += 1
	r.active, r.respawnAt = nil, now + r.config.RespawnSeconds
	return true, item
end
function Rules.eligible(r, actor, action, target, now, check)
	local s, item = r.actors[actor], r.active
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Run" or s.item or not item or item.securePending then
		return false, "hands/arena/Taken"
	end
	if item.escapeDeadline and now >= item.escapeDeadline then
		return false, "escape expired"
	end
	if action == "Steal" then
		if item.state ~= "Nest" then
			return false, "Taken"
		end
	elseif action == "Grab" then
		if item.state ~= "Dropped" or now < item.settle then
			return false, "Taken/settling"
		end
	elseif action == "Bump" then
		local victim = r.actors[target]
		if not victim or victim.item ~= item or item.state ~= "Carried" or target == actor then
			return false, "carrier/Taken"
		end
		if now < s.shield or now < victim.shield or now < victim.mercy then
			return false, "FIRST RUN/mercy"
		end
	else
		return false, "unknown hold"
	end
	return check(actor, action, target, item)
end
function Rules.begin(r, actor, action, target, now, check)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	if not s then
		return false, "unknown actor"
	end
	if action == "Bump" then
		if now < s.cooldown then
			return false, "Bump cooldown"
		end
		s.cooldown = now + r.config.BumpCooldown -- Includes refused/cancelled attempts.
	end
	local ok, reason = Rules.eligible(r, actor, action, target, now, check)
	if not ok or s.hold then
		return false, reason or "hold active"
	end
	s.hold = {
		action = action,
		target = target,
		began = now,
		item = r.active,
		version = r.active.version,
	}
	return true
end
function Rules.drop(r, actor, now, position)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	local item = s and s.item
	if not item or item.securePending or item.state ~= "Carried" or not position then
		return false, "no valid floor/item"
	end
	s.item, s.hold = nil, nil
	item.state, item.holder, item.position, item.settle =
		"Dropped", nil, position, now + r.config.SettleSeconds
	item.version += 1
	return true, item
end
function Rules.hit(r, actor, source, now, position)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Run" or now < s.mercy or (source == "Pvp" and now < s.shield) then
		return false, "mercy"
	end
	local retain = r.config.GuardianFirstHitRetains
		and source == "Guardian"
		and s.item ~= nil
		and s.completed == 0
		and not s.firstHitUsed
	if s.item and not retain then
		local ok, why = Rules.drop(r, actor, now, position)
		if not ok then
			return false, why
		end
	end
	if source == "Guardian" and retain then
		s.firstHitUsed = true
	end
	s.mercy, s.slowUntil = now + r.config.MercySeconds, now + r.config.SlowSeconds
	s.hold = nil
	return true, retain
end
function Rules.finish(r, actor, action, now, check, dropPosition)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	local hold = s and s.hold
	if not hold or hold.action ~= action or now - hold.began < r.config.HoldSeconds[action] then
		return false, "missing/short hold"
	end
	s.hold = nil
	if hold.item ~= r.active or hold.version ~= hold.item.version then
		return false, "Taken"
	end
	local ok, why = Rules.eligible(r, actor, action, hold.target, now, check)
	if not ok then
		return false, why
	end
	if action == "Bump" then
		return Rules.hit(r, hold.target, "Pvp", now, dropPosition(hold.target))
	end
	local item = hold.item
	if not item.firstPickup then
		item.firstPickup = now
		item.escapeDeadline = now + r.config.EscapeSeconds
	end -- Frozen through every handoff.
	item.state, item.holder, item.position = "Carried", actor, nil
	item.version += 1
	s.item, s.mercy, s.idleAt = item, now + r.config.MercySeconds, now
	if action == "Steal" and not s.shieldUsed then
		s.shieldUsed, s.shield = true, now + r.config.ShieldSeconds
	end
	return true, item
end
function Rules.secure(r, actor, now)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Run" then
		return false, "not in arena"
	end
	if s.item then
		local item = s.item
		if not item.securePending and now >= item.escapeDeadline then
			return false, "escape expired"
		end
		assert(
			item == r.active and item.holder == actor and item.state == "Carried",
			"secure identity"
		)
		item.state, item.securedAt, item.firstPup = "Secured", now, s.completed == 0
		item.version += 1
		r.active = nil
		r.respawnAt = now + r.config.RespawnSeconds
		s.completed += 1
	end
	s.phase, s.hold, s.shield = "Home", nil, 0
	return true
end
function Rules.place(r, actor)
	local s = r.actors[actor]
	local item = s and s.item
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Home" or not item or item.state ~= "Secured" then
		return false, "not secured"
	end
	s.item = nil
	item.state, item.holder = "Placed", nil
	item.version += 1
	return true, item
end
function Rules.retire(r)
	if r.active then
		local item = r.active
		if item.holder then
			r.actors[item.holder].item = nil
		end
		item.state, item.holder = "Retired", nil
		r.active = nil
	end
end
return Rules
ReplicatedStorage.GreyboxPlacement:
-- Shared footprint contract. Server calls this before consuming secured cargo.
local Placement = {}
function Placement.height(slot)
	return ((slot - 1) % 4) * 3.5
end
function Placement.center(slot)
	return slot <= 4 and -52 or 52, 96 - (slot - 1) % 4 * 64
end
local function finite(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge
end
function Placement.validate(config, slot, x, z, angle, occupied)
	if not finite(x) or not finite(z) or not finite(angle) then
		return false, "invalid placement"
	end
	if #occupied >= config.MaxActivePets then
		return false, "active pet limit"
	end
	local cx, cz = Placement.center(slot)
	local half = config.PetFootprint / 2
	local extent = half * (math.abs(math.cos(math.rad(angle))) + math.abs(math.sin(math.rad(angle))))
	local dx, dz = x - cx, z - cz
	if
		math.abs(dx) + extent > config.PlotWidth / 2 - config.PlotInset
		or math.abs(dz) + extent > config.PlotDepth / 2 - config.PlotInset
	then
		return false, "out of bounds"
	end
	-- Twelve by twelve gate reserve, plus its eight-wide route to the centre.
	local inward = cx < 0 and 1 or -1
	if
		dx * inward + extent > 16 and math.abs(dz) < 6 + extent
		or dx * inward + extent > 0 and math.abs(dz) < 4 + extent
	then
		return false, "keep entrance clear"
	end
	for _, pet in occupied do
		local other = pet.extent or half
		if
			math.abs(x - pet.x) < extent + other + config.PetSpacing
			and math.abs(z - pet.z) < extent + other + config.PetSpacing
		then
			return false, "overlap"
		end
	end
	return true, extent
end
return Placement
ReplicatedStorage.GreyboxScene:

local function lookAt(eye, target)
	local forward = (target - eye).Unit
	local right = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(eye, right, right:Cross(forward).Unit, -forward)
end
local grass = Color3.fromRGB(111, 158, 85)
local rock = Color3.fromRGB(113, 122, 137)
local stone = Color3.fromRGB(180, 173, 157)
local wood = Color3.fromRGB(136, 96, 61)

	p.Anchored = true
	p.CastShadow = false

	return p

function Scene.underside(parent, origin, width, depth, make)
	-- Broad strata with staggered cliff columns and a tapered hanging core.
	for i, scale in { 1, 0.88, 0.64, 0.36 } do

function Scene.meadow(parent, origin, layout, make)
	Scene.underside(parent, origin, 160, 160, make)
	-- Meadow-only hanging teeth; background islands and Home retain their silhouette.
	for i = 0, 23 do
		local angle = i * math.pi / 12
		local h = 28 + i % 5 * 9
		local p = cosmetic(
			make(
				parent,
				"MeadowRockTooth" .. i,
				Vector3.new(12 + i % 3 * 4, h, 14),

	local function map(x, y, z)
		return Vector3.new(x, y, -z)
	end
	-- Paths expose the three escape choices and the two shared cross-links.
	local paths = {}
	for name, route in layout.routes do
		table.insert(paths, { route = route, width = name == "Quick" and 16 or 12 })
	end
	for _, route in layout.crossLinks do
		table.insert(paths, { route = route, width = 12 })
	end
	for _, ramp in layout.ramps do
		table.insert(paths, { route = { ramp.a, ramp.b }, width = ramp.width })
	end
	-- Connect both switchbacks across their real summit/landing surfaces.
	for _, route in Layout.hillPaths(layout) do
		table.insert(paths, { route = route, width = 12 })
	end
	for _, path in paths do
		for i = 2, #path.route do
			local a, b = path.route[i - 1], path.route[i]

					make(parent, "MeadowBridgePost", Vector3.new(0.7, 3, 0.7), origin + map(side * x, 9.5, z), wood)
				)
			end
			cosmetic(
				make(parent, "MeadowBridgeRail", Vector3.new(12, 0.5, 0.5), origin + map(side * 14, 10.2, z), wood)
			)
		end
	end
	-- Staggered perimeter columns break the square base into visible cliff strata.
	for i = -9, 9 do
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			for _, axis in { "X", "Z" } do
				local h = 10 + (i + 9) % 4 * 3
				local position = axis == "X" and map(side * (78 + (i + 9) % 3 * 2), -h / 2 + (i + 9) % 4, i * 8)
					or map(i * 8, -h / 2 + (i + 9) % 4, side * (78 + (i + 9) % 3 * 2))

	for _, p in parent:GetDescendants() do

			if
				p.Name:find("Mountain")
				or p.Name:find("GroveHill")
				or p.Name == "CampTerrace"
				or p.Name:find("CampShoulderStep")
				or p.Name == "IslandGround"
			then
				p.Color, p.Material = grass, Enum.Material.Grass
			end
		end

	-- Explicit twelve-wide ground bypass south of the optional stone chain.
	cosmetic(make(parent, "StoneWalkingBypass", Vector3.new(44, 0.06, 12), origin + map(-32, 0.04, -46), stone))
	for _, d in
		{

	do

	for _, d in { { -68, 0, 48 }, { 68, 0, 28 }, { 62, 0, 58 }, { -68, 0, 30 } } do
		Scene.tree(parent, origin + map(d[1], d[2], d[3]), make, 0.65)

	-- Twenty additional off-route silhouettes, with canopies kept away from walking decks.
	for _, d in

ReplicatedStorage.GreyboxTraps:
-- Server-owned entry/charge/placement lifecycle. Geometry and presentation are injected
-- so offline tests execute the same validation without pretending to run physics.
local Traps = {}
Traps.RattleSignal, Traps.RattleTimeSignal = "Rattled", "RattleAt"
function Traps.new(config, arenaAPI, make, label)
	return {
		config = config.Traps,
		islandSize = config.IslandSize,
		arenaAPI = arenaAPI,
		make = make,
		label = label,
		active = {},
	}
end
function Traps.unlocked(t, actor, s)
	return (s.meadowEscapes or 0) >= t.config.UnlockEscapes or actor:GetAttribute("GreyboxDevTrapUnlock") == true
end
function Traps.remove(t, actor)
	for i = #t.active, 1, -1 do
		local trap = t.active[i]
		if not actor or trap.owner == actor then
			if trap.arena.decoy and trap.arena.decoy.trap == trap then
				trap.arena.decoy = nil
				trap.arena.decoyImmuneUntil = (trap.effectEnd or trap.expires) + t.config.Decoy.ImmunitySeconds
			end
			trap.part:Destroy()
			table.remove(t.active, i)
		end
	end
end
function Traps.entry(t, actor, s)
	Traps.remove(t, actor)
	s.trapCharge, s.trapPickedUp, s.trapHold = true, false, nil
	-- Deliberately preserve trapCooldown across entries.
end
function Traps.clearIsland(t, a)
	for i = #t.active, 1, -1 do
		local trap = t.active[i]
		if trap.arena == a then
			trap.part:Destroy()
			table.remove(t.active, i)
		end
	end
	a.decoy = nil
end
function Traps.spot(t, a, position, rootPosition)
	local c, api = t.config, t.arenaAPI
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false, "floor required"
	end
	for _, value in { position.X, position.Y, position.Z } do
		if value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then
			return false, "invalid coordinates"
		end
	end
	if (position - rootPosition).Magnitude > c.Range then
		return false, "trap range"
	end
	local p = position - a.origin
	local x, z = p.X, -p.Z
	if math.abs(x) > t.islandSize / 2 - c.ClearRadius or math.abs(z) > t.islandSize / 2 - c.ClearRadius then
		return false, "island edge"
	end
	local nest = a.layout.version == 4 and { x = 0, z = 96 } or { x = 0, z = 32 }
	if
		Vector3.new(x - nest.x, 0, z - nest.z).Magnitude < c.ProtectedMargin or api.safe(a, position, c.ProtectedMargin)
	then
		return false, "nest/spawn/portal margin"
	end
	-- Exclude all jump/recovery footprints and cross-link junctions, not just
	-- authored route centre lines. Remaining open floor is freely selectable.
	for _, g in a.layout.gullies do
		if math.abs(x - g.x) < g.w / 2 + c.ClearRadius and math.abs(z - g.z) < g.d / 2 + c.ClearRadius then
			return false, "jump recovery"
		end
	end
	for _, box in a.layout.solids do
		if string.find(box.name, "Jump", 1, true) or string.find(box.name, "Stone", 1, true) then
			if math.abs(x - box.x) < box.w / 2 + c.ClearRadius and math.abs(z - box.z) < box.d / 2 + c.ClearRadius then
				return false, "jump landing"
			end
		end
	end
	for _, link in a.layout.crossLinks do
		for _, point in link do
			if Vector3.new(x - point.x, 0, z - point.z).Magnitude < 12 then
				return false, "junction"
			end
		end
	end
	local floor = api.floor(a, position)
	if not floor or math.abs(floor.Y - position.Y) > 0.3 or math.abs(rootPosition.Y - floor.Y - 3) > 1.5 then
		return false, "reachable floor"
	end
	if not api.sight(a, rootPosition, floor + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) then
		return false, "trap sight"
	end
	-- Check an entire 18x18 flat walking envelope, including headroom. This
	-- rejects cover tops, narrow bridges, ramps and ledges; visuals never collide.
	for ix = -6, 6 do
		for iz = -6, 6 do
			local sample = floor + Vector3.new(ix * 1.5, 0, iz * 1.5)
			local f, normal = api.floor(a, sample)
			if
				not f
				or not normal
				or normal.Y < math.cos(math.rad(c.MaxSlope))
				or math.abs(f.Y - floor.Y) > 0.3
				or not api.sight(a, f + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), f + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0))
			then
				return false, "open flat floor/bypass"
			end
		end
	end
	return true, floor
end
function Traps.eligible(t, actor, s, a, position, rootPosition, now, finishing)
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Run" or s.run ~= a or s.item or s.hold or s.trapPickedUp then
		return false, "pre-steal entry only"
	end
	if not Traps.unlocked(t, actor, s) then
		return false, "Decoy unlock: 3 Meadow escapes"
	end
	if not s.trapCharge then
		return false, "charge spent"
	end
	if not finishing and now < (s.trapCooldown or 0) then
		return false, "15s placement cooldown"
	end
	local islandCount, ownerCount = 0, 0
	for _, trap in t.active do
		islandCount += trap.arena == a and 1 or 0
		ownerCount += trap.owner == actor and 1 or 0
		if trap.arena == a and (trap.position - position).Magnitude < t.config.Spacing then
			return false, "12-stud trap spacing"
		end
	end
	if
		ownerCount >= t.config.MaxPerPlayer
		or islandCount >= t.config.MaxPerIsland
		or #t.active >= t.config.MaxServer
	then
		return false, "trap limit"
	end
	return Traps.spot(t, a, position, rootPosition)
end
function Traps.action(t, actor, s, a, rootPosition, stage, position, now, kind)
	if not s then
		return false, "no actor"
	end
	if stage == "cancel" then
		s.trapHold = nil
		return true
	end
	if kind and kind ~= "Decoy" then
		return false, "Sticky locked: future Crystal island"
	end
	if stage == "recall" then
		if s.phase ~= "Run" or s.trapPickedUp or s.item then
			return false, "recall before pickup only"
		end
		Traps.remove(t, actor)
		s.trapHold = nil
		return true
	end
	if stage ~= "begin" and stage ~= "finish" then
		return false, "trap stage"
	end
	if not a or not rootPosition then
		return false, "arena/root"
	end
	local hold = s.trapHold
	if stage == "finish" then
		s.trapHold = nil
		if not hold or hold.arena ~= a or now - hold.began < t.config.PlacementSeconds then
			return false, "hold Decoy 1s"
		end
		position = hold.position -- Client finish cannot move the committed preview.
	end
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false, "floor required"
	end
	local ok, floor = Traps.eligible(t, actor, s, a, position, rootPosition, now, stage == "finish")
	if stage == "begin" and now >= (s.trapCooldown or 0) then
		s.trapCooldown, s.trapHold = now + t.config.Cooldown, nil
	end
	if not ok then
		return false, floor
	end
	if stage == "begin" then
		s.trapHold = { position = floor, began = now, arena = a }
		return true
	end
	local part = t.make(
		a.model,
		"DecoyBell",
		Vector3.new(0.1, 6, 6),
		floor + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60)
	)
	part.Shape, part.CFrame = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(part.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
	part.Material, part.Transparency = Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35
	part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false, false
	part:SetAttribute("TrapOwner", actor.UserId)
	part:SetAttribute("TrapType", "Decoy")
	local bell = t.make(part, "Bell", Vector3.new(1.8, 2, 1.8), floor + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 65))
	bell.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bell.Color, bell.Material = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 65), Enum.Material.Metal
	bell.Anchored, bell.CanCollide, bell.CanTouch, bell.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	bell.Position, bell.Parent = floor + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), part
	local trap = {
		owner = actor,
		arena = a,
		position = floor,
		part = part,
		bell = bell,
		caption = t.label(part, "DECOY / arming 2s"),
		armed = now + t.config.ArmSeconds,
		expires = now + t.config.Lifetime,
	}
	part:SetAttribute("ExpiresAt", trap.expires)
	part:SetAttribute("ArmedAt", trap.armed)
	table.insert(t.active, trap)
	s.trapCharge = false
	return true
end
function Traps.tick(t, now, states)
	for _, s in states do
		local hold = s.trapHold
		if hold then
			local actorRoot = s.trapRoot and s.trapRoot()
			if
				s.trapRoot
				and (
					not actorRoot
					or not Traps.eligible(t, s.trapActor, s, hold.arena, hold.position, actorRoot.Position, now, true)
				)
			then
				s.trapHold = nil
			end
		end
	end
	for i = #t.active, 1, -1 do
		local trap, c = t.active[i], t.config.Decoy
		local s = states[trap.owner]
		if now >= trap.expires or not s or s.phase ~= "Run" or s.run ~= trap.arena then
			Traps.remove(t, trap.owner)
			continue
		end

-- Upload-free, deliberately independent of Humanoid/Animator animation assets.
-- C0 is used because Motor6D.Transform is not replicated. Use one driver only.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Clips = require(script.Parent.Clips)
local Animator = {}
Animator.__index = Animator

local function ease(a, style)
	if style == "sine" then
		return (1 - math.cos(a * math.pi)) / 2
	end
	if style == "in" then
		return a * a
	end
	if style == "out" then
		return 1 - (1 - a) * (1 - a)
	end
	return a
end

function Animator.sample(name, time)
	local clip = assert(Clips.clips[name], "Unknown Keeper animation: " .. tostring(name))
	time = math.clamp(time, 0, clip.duration)
	local frames = clip.frames
	local left, right = frames[1], frames[#frames]
	for i = 2, #frames do
		if time <= frames[i].t then
			left, right = frames[i - 1], frames[i]
			break
		end
	end
	local a = ease((time - left.t) / (right.t - left.t), right.ease)
	local pose = {}
	for _, joint in ipairs(Clips.jointOrder) do
		pose[joint] = left.pose[joint]:Lerp(right.pose[joint], a)
	end
	return pose
end

function Animator.new(rig)
	local self = {
		rig = rig,
		time = 0,
		speed = 1,
		fade = 0.12,
		elapsed = 0,
		pose = Animator.sample("idle", 0),
		stopped = true,
		generation = 0,
	}
	setmetatable(self, Animator)
	self.Marker = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	self.Completed = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	self.connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
		self:Step(dt)
	end)
	return self
end

function Animator:Apply(pose)
	for name, motor in pairs(self.rig.motors) do
		motor.C0 = self.rig.rest[name] * pose[name]
	end
	self.pose = pose
end

function Animator:Play(name, options)
	options = options or {}
	local clip = assert(Clips.clips[name], "Unknown Keeper animation")
	assert((options.speed or 1) > 0, "speed must be positive")
	self.generation += 1
	self.name, self.clip, self.time, self.elapsed = name, clip, 0, 0
	self.speed, self.fade = options.speed or 1, math.max(0, options.fade or 0.12)
	-- Attack callbacks must match the sampled release pose, without crossfade drift.
	if name == "throw" or name == "lob" or name == "fan" or name == "slam" or name == "dash" then
		self.fade = 0
	end
	self.loop = if options.loop == nil then clip.loop else options.loop
	self.from, self.stopped = self.pose, false
	self.onMarker = options.onMarker
	self:Apply(if self.fade == 0 then Animator.sample(name, 0) else self.from)
	for _, marker in ipairs(clip.markers or {}) do
		if marker.t == 0 then
			self:Emit(marker, name, 0)
		end
	end
	return self
end

function Animator:Emit(marker, name, lateness)
	local snapshot = { releaseCFrame = self.rig:ReleaseCFrame(Animator.sample(name, marker.t), name) }
	-- Immutable CFrame snapshot remains correct with deferred Roblox signals.
	self.Marker:Fire(marker.name, name, marker.t, lateness, snapshot)
	if self.onMarker then
		self.onMarker(marker.name, name, marker.t, lateness, snapshot)
	end
end

function Animator:Step(dt)
	if self.stopped or dt <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local generation, clip, name = self.generation, self.clip, self.name
	local remaining = dt * self.speed
	self.elapsed += dt
	-- Split at markers: apply their exact pose BEFORE the event fires, even on a hitch.
	while remaining > 1e-8 and not self.stopped do
		local before = self.time
		local after = math.min(clip.duration, before + remaining)
		for _, marker in ipairs(clip.markers or {}) do
			if marker.t > before and marker.t <= after then
				self:Apply(Animator.sample(name, marker.t))
				self:Emit(marker, name, (after - marker.t) / self.speed)
				if self.generation ~= generation or self.stopped then
					return
				end
			end
		end
		self.time = after
		local pose = Animator.sample(name, after)
		if self.elapsed < self.fade then
			local a = ease(self.elapsed / self.fade, "sine")
			for joint, cf in pairs(pose) do
				pose[joint] = self.from[joint]:Lerp(cf, a)
			end
		end
		self:Apply(pose)
		remaining -= after - before
		if after >= clip.duration then
			if self.loop then
				self.time = 0
			else
				self.stopped = true
				self.Completed:Fire(name)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function Animator:Stop(reset)
	self.generation += 1
	self.stopped = true
	if reset then
		self:Apply(Animator.sample("idle", 0))
	end
end

function Animator:Destroy()
	self:Stop(true)
	self.connection:Disconnect()
	self.Marker:Destroy()
	self.Completed:Destroy()
end

Animator.Clips = Clips.clips
return Animator

		if not wall and delta.Magnitude > 0.001 and leashed and not safe
			and (not floor or math.abs(floor.Y-(guard.Position.Y-5.5)) > T.FanHeight) then
			local near = workspace:Blockcast(guard.CFrame, guard.Size, delta + t.direction*T.FanHeight, a.wallParams or a.params)

				and math.abs(near.Instance.CFrame.Position.Y-near.Instance.Size.Y/2-(guard.Position.Y-5.5)) <= T.FanHeight then
				wall = near
			end
		end
		a.model:SetAttribute("DashStopCollider", wall and wall.Instance:GetFullName() or nil)
		if
			wall
			or not floor
			or math.abs(floor.Y - (guard.Position.Y - 5.5)) > T.FanHeight
			or safe
			or not leashed
		then
			a.model:SetAttribute("DashStopReason", wall and "collision" or not floor and "missing floor"
				or math.abs(floor.Y - (guard.Position.Y - 5.5)) > T.FanHeight and "floor height"
				or not leashed and "leash/tunnel" or "safe zone")
			-- Only a vertical cover impact earns stars. Floor/lip/leash stops do not.
			-- Keep the last fooled corner across navigation resets: waiting here
			-- cannot refresh a stun or repeatedly select charges into this cover.
			if wall and wall.Normal.Y < 0.5 and wall.Instance:GetAttribute("SurfaceRole") == "Cover"
				and leashed and not safe
				and (not a.wallBaitCorner or flat(wall.Position - a.wallBaitCorner).Magnitude > 28) then
				a.wallBaitCorner = wall.Position
				a.keeperStunUntil = now + T.DashStun
				a.model:SetAttribute("WallBaitAt", now)
				a.model:SetAttribute("WallBaitCorner", wall.Position)
				fx(api, a, "WallStun", guard.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
			end
			Kit.clear(a)
			return
		end
		for actor, s in pairs(actors) do
			local r = root(actor)
			if r then
				accept(
					actor,
					s,
					r,
					segmentDistance(r.Position, guard.Position, nextPoint) <= 3
						and math.abs(r.Position.Y - nextPoint.Y) <= 5
				)
			end
		end
		guard.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
			Vector3.new(nextPoint.X, floor.Y + 5.5, nextPoint.Z),
			Vector3.new(nextPoint.X, floor.Y + 5.5, nextPoint.Z) + t.direction
		)
	end
	for _, projectile in ipairs(t.projectiles) do
		if not projectile.blocked then
			local flight = math.clamp((elapsed - t.release) / (t.duration - t.release), 0, 1)
			local nextPoint = projectile.from:Lerp(projectile.destination, flight)
				+ Vector3.new(0, (t.kind == "lob" and 36 or 3) * flight * (1 - flight), 0)
			local delta = nextPoint - projectile.previous
			local obstruction = delta.Magnitude > 0.001
				and workspace:Spherecast(projectile.previous, projectile.size / 2, delta, a.params)
			if obstruction then
				-- A lob's floor landing is expected; all intervening cover cancels it.
				local landingFloor = obstruction.Instance
					and obstruction.Instance:GetAttribute("SurfaceRole") == "Floor"
					and obstruction.Normal.Y > 0.7
					and (obstruction.Position - t.position).Magnitude <= T.LobSize
				projectile.blocked = t.kind ~= "lob" or not landingFloor
				if projectile.blocked then
					fx(api, a, t.kind == "fan" and "AcornPop" or "LogBlocked", obstruction.Position)
					projectile.part.Transparency = 1
					if projectile.cap then
						projectile.cap.Transparency = 1
					end
				end
			end
			if t.kind == "fan" and not projectile.blocked then
				for actor, s in pairs(actors) do
					local r = root(actor)
					if r then
						accept(
							actor,
							s,
							r,
							segmentDistance(r.Position, projectile.previous, nextPoint) <= projectile.size / 2 + 1
						)
					end
				end
			end
			projectile.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(nextPoint) * CFrame.Angles(flight * 12, 0, 0)
			projectile.previous = nextPoint
			if projectile.cap then
				projectile.cap.Position = nextPoint + Vector3.new(0, projectile.size * 0.38, 0)
			end
		end
	end
	if t.kind == "slam" and t.released then
		local radius = math.min(T.SlamRadius, (elapsed - T.SlamLand) * T.SlamSpeed)
		resizeRing(t.wave, t.position, radius)
		for actor, s in pairs(actors) do
			local r = root(actor)
			if r then
				local distance = flat(r.Position - t.position).Magnitude
				local previousDistance = t.distances and t.distances[actor] or distance
				local previousRadius = t.radius or 0
				local crossed = math.min(previousDistance - previousRadius, distance - radius) <= T.SlamWidth
					and math.max(previousDistance - previousRadius, distance - radius) >= -T.SlamWidth
				local floor = api.floor(a, r.Position)
				local feet = r.Position.Y - 3
				accept(
					actor,
					s,
					r,
					crossed
						and floor ~= nil
						and math.abs(floor.Y - t.position.Y) <= T.JumpClearance
						and feet - floor.Y <= T.JumpClearance
						and feet >= floor.Y - 1
				)
				t.distances = t.distances or {}
				t.distances[actor] = distance
			end
		end
		t.radius = radius
	end
	if elapsed >= t.duration then
		if t.kind == "lob" and t.projectiles[1] and not t.projectiles[1].blocked then
			fx(api, a, "lobImpact", t.position, T.LobRadius)
			for actor, s in pairs(actors) do
				local r = root(actor)
				if r then
					accept(
						actor,
						s,
						r,
						flat(r.Position - t.position).Magnitude <= T.LobRadius
							and math.abs(r.Position.Y - t.position.Y) <= T.Height
					)
				end
			end
		end
		a.impacts += 1
		a.model:SetAttribute("LastImpactAt", now)
		a.model:SetAttribute("LastImpactDelay", elapsed)
		Kit.clear(a)
	end
end
return Kit

local Skeleton = require(script.Parent.Skeleton)
local Kinematics = {}
function Kinematics.world(pose, ground)
	local world = { Root = ground or CFrame.identity }
	for _, joint in ipairs(Skeleton.jointOrder) do
		local parent = Skeleton.parents[joint]
		local pivot = Vector3.new(table.unpack(Skeleton.pivots[joint]))
		local parentPivot = parent == "Root" and Vector3.zero
			or Vector3.new(table.unpack(Skeleton.pivots[parent]))
		world[joint] = world[parent] * CFrame.new(pivot - parentPivot) * pose[joint]
	end
	return world
end
function Kinematics.socket(pose, ground, clip)
	local world = Kinematics.world(pose, ground)
	local right = world["Wrist.R"] * CFrame.new(table.unpack(Skeleton.hand))
	if clip == "lob" then
		local left = world["Wrist.L"] * CFrame.new(table.unpack(Skeleton.hand))
		local half = (right.Position - left.Position) / 2
		local basis = ground or CFrame.identity
		local middle = (right.Position + left.Position) / 2
		local height = basis:PointToObjectSpace(middle).Y
		local blend = math.clamp((height - 7) / 2.6, 0, 1)
		local direction =
			basis:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0.2 + 0.8 * blend, 1 - 0.95 * blend).Unit)
		local localHalf = basis:VectorToObjectSpace(half)
		local cross = basis:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, localHalf.Y, localHalf.Z))
		if cross.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local axis = cross.Unit
			direction -= axis * direction:Dot(axis)
		end
		-- 8x6 cylinder along local X: both mittens support the circular underside.
		local offset = math.sqrt(math.max(0, 9 - cross.Magnitude ^ 2))
		return CFrame.new(middle + direction.Unit * offset) * (ground or CFrame.identity).Rotation
	end
	return right
end
return Kinematics

				template, retained = {}, {}

					local mesh = assert(AssetService:CreateEditableMesh(), "acorn mesh budget unavailable")

					for _, v in ipairs(section.vertices) do
						local p = Vector3.new(table.unpack(v))
						lo = lo:Min(p)
						hi = hi:Max(p)
					end
					local centre, ids = (lo + hi) / 2, {}
					for i, v in ipairs(section.vertices) do
						ids[i] = mesh:AddVertex(Vector3.new(table.unpack(v)) - centre)
					end
					for _, t in ipairs(section.triangles) do
						mesh:AddTriangle(ids[t[1] + 1], ids[t[2] + 1], ids[t[3] + 1])
					end
					-- Content is a Roblox engine global absent from the offline roblox_min std.
					-- selene: allow(undefined_variable)
					local p = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(mesh))
					p.Name = section.name
					p.Color = section.name:lower():find("cap") and Color3.fromRGB(75, 101, 38)
						or section.name:lower():find("stem") and Color3.fromRGB(65, 48, 26)
						or Color3.fromRGB(151, 90, 43)
					p.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
					p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
					p.Size *= 0.5 -- Source acorn is 3 studs tall; readable 1.5-stud projectile.
					table.insert(template, { part = p, cf = CFrame.new((centre - Vector3.new(0, 2.28, 0)) * 0.5) })
				end
			end)
			building = false
			if not ok then
				for _, e in ipairs(template or {}) do
					e.part:Destroy()
				end
				for _, mesh in ipairs(retained or {}) do
					mesh:Destroy()
				end
				template = nil
				model:Destroy()
				error(err)
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(template) do
			local p = entry.part:Clone()
			p.Parent = model
			table.insert(pieces, { part = p, cf = entry.cf })
		end
	end
	return { model = model, pieces = pieces }
end
function Props.move(entry, cf, visible)
	for _, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
		piece.part.CFrame = cf * piece.cf
		piece.part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
	end
end
return Props
ReplicatedStorage.MeadowKeeper.Rig:
-- Approved JSON's pivots, not MeshPart bounding-box centres, drive all joints.
local Blocks = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("NativeBlocks"))
local Data = require(script.Parent.Geometry)
local Skeleton = require(script.Parent.Skeleton)
local Kinematics = require(script.Parent.Kinematics)
local Rig = {}
local order = Skeleton.jointOrder
local parents = Skeleton.parents

local function invisible(name, cf, model)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name, part.Size, part.Transparency = name, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), 1
	part.CFrame, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = cf, false, false, false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Parent = model
	return part
end

local function skeleton(model, placement, pivots)
	local rig = { model = model, carriers = {}, motors = {}, rest = {}, meshes = {} }
	local root = invisible("KeeperRoot", placement, model)
	root.Anchored = true
	rig.root, rig.carriers.Root = root, root
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	for _, name in ipairs(order) do
		local cf = placement * CFrame.new(table.unpack(pivots[name]))
		local carrier = invisible("Pivot_" .. name, cf, model)
		rig.carriers[name] = carrier
		local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		motor.Name, motor.Part0, motor.Part1 = "Keeper_" .. name, rig.carriers[parents[name]], carrier
		motor.C0 = motor.Part0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf)
		motor.C1 = CFrame.identity
		motor.Parent = motor.Part0
		rig.motors[name], rig.rest[name] = motor, motor.C0
	end
	-- Actual hand centre in Arm.R pivot coordinates. Front is +Z.
	local hand = Instance.new("Attachment")
	hand.Name, hand.Position = "ReleaseSocket", Vector3.new(table.unpack(Skeleton.hand))
	hand.Parent = rig.carriers["Wrist.R"]
	rig.release = hand
	function rig:ReleaseCFrame(pose, clip)
		-- Forward kinematics is immediate; Attachment.WorldCFrame can lag until physics.
		return Kinematics.socket(pose, self.root.CFrame, clip)
	end
	return rig
end

local function weld(part, carrier)
	part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery, part.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
	local joint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.Parent = carrier, part, carrier
end

function Rig.build(placement)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "MeadowKeeperAnimationDemo"
	local pivots = Skeleton.pivots
	local rig = skeleton(model, placement or CFrame.identity, pivots)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local count = 0
		for _, section in ipairs(Data) do
			count += Blocks.section(section, model, rig.root.CFrame, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, function(part)
				weld(part, assert(rig.carriers[section.rig_part], section.rig_part))
			end)
		end
		model:SetAttribute("KeeperGeometry", "NativeBlocks")
		Blocks.log("MeadowKeeper", count)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[MeadowKeeper] geometry creation failed: " .. tostring(err) .. "; using emergency coloured block rig")
		for _, child in model:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Name ~= "KeeperRoot" and not child.Name:match("^Pivot_") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for _, section in ipairs(Data) do
			Blocks.section(
				{ name = section.name, color = section.color, vertices = section.vertices, triangles = {} },
				model,
				rig.root.CFrame,
				Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
				function(part)
					weld(part, rig.carriers[section.rig_part])
				end
			)
		end
	end
	return rig
end

-- Alternative: articulated neutral meshes, aligned to the JSON's Y-up +Z basis.
-- Call before animation begins. Captures existing visual transforms, avoiding mesh-centre assumptions.
function Rig.bind(model, placement)
	assert(not model:FindFirstChild("KeeperRoot"), "Keeper is already rigged")
	assert(
		model:FindFirstChild("Elbow.R", true),
		"Seven-part FBX cannot throw with elbows; use Rig.build or articulated named meshes"
	)
	local pivots, parts = Skeleton.pivots, {}
	for _, name in ipairs(order) do
		if name == "Pelvis" then
			continue
		end -- virtual pelvis has no imported visual mesh
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		assert(part and part:IsA("BasePart"), "Missing imported part: " .. name)
		parts[name] = part
	end
	local rig = skeleton(model, placement or CFrame.identity, pivots)
	for name, part in pairs(parts) do
		weld(part, rig.carriers[name])
	end
	return rig
end

function Rig.destroy(rig)
	rig.model:Destroy()
	for _, mesh in ipairs(rig.meshes) do
		mesh:Destroy()
	end
end

return Rig
ReplicatedStorage.MeadowV4.Builder:
-- Isolated native geometry; no dependency on guardian/Keeper code.
local MeadowV4 = {}
local data = require(script.Parent.Data)
local art = require(script.Parent.Fix1Art)
local routes = require(script.Parent.RouteData)
local fix2 = require(script.Parent.Fix2Routes)
local drops = require(script.Parent.ReachableDrops)
local polish = require(script.Parent.Polish)
function MeadowV4.build(parent: Instance, origin: Vector3?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "MeadowV4"
	local offset = origin or Vector3.zero
	for _, item in polish.transform(fix2.transform(art.transform(data, routes), routes), routes) do
		local p = Instance.new(if item.shape == "Wedge" then "WedgePart" else "Part")
		p.Name = item.name
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = item.collidable, item.collidable, false
		p.Size = Vector3.new(unpack(item.size))
		p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(unpack(item.color))
		p.Material = Enum.Material[item.material]
		if p:IsA("Part") then
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType[item.shape]
		end
		p.Transparency = item.transparency
		local r, v = item.rotation, item.position
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(
			v[1],
			v[2],
			v[3],
			r[1],
			r[2],
			r[3],
			r[4],
			r[5],
			r[6],
			r[7],
			r[8],
			r[9]
		)
		p:SetAttribute("MeadowV4Category", item.category)
		if item.polishCleared then p:SetAttribute("MeadowPolishCleared", true) end
		p:SetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor", drops.isLane(item, routes))
		if drops.isLane(item, routes) then
			p:AddTag("AuthoredLaneFloor")
			p:SetAttribute("LaneId", item.name:match("^Fix2Lane_(.-)_%d+$")
				or item.name:match("^Fix2Junction_(.-)_%d+$") or item.name:match("^(.-)%d+$") or item.name)
		end
		p:SetAttribute(
			"SurfaceRole",
			if item.collidable then (if item.category == "cover" then "Cover" else "Floor") else "Scenery"
		)
		p.Parent = model
		if item.category == "light" then
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = p.Color
			light.Brightness, light.Range = 1.5, 18
			light.Parent = p
		end
	end
	-- Build every section in island-local coordinates, then translate once.
	local court = require(script.Parent.Gameplay).PvpCourt
	local deck = Instance.new("Part")
	deck.Name, deck.Size = "PvpCourtFloor", Vector3.new(18, 1.2, 18)
	deck.CFrame = CFrame.new(court.x, court.y - .48, -court.z)
	deck.Anchored, deck.CanCollide, deck.CanQuery, deck.CanTouch = true, true, true, false
	deck.Color, deck.Material = Color3.fromRGB(101, 148, 64), Enum.Material.Grass
	deck:SetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor", true)
	deck:SetAttribute("SurfaceRole", "Floor")
	deck:SetAttribute("MeadowV4Category", "lane")
	deck:SetAttribute("LaneId", "pvp_court")
	deck:AddTag("AuthoredLaneFloor")
	deck.Parent = model
	-- Section dressing is cosmetic: a failed prop must never take the island down with it.
	local sections = {}
	for _, module in script.Parent:GetChildren() do
		if module:IsA("ModuleScript") and (module.Name:match("^Section%d+$") or module.Name == "Outsmart"
			or module:GetAttribute("MeadowDressing") == true) then table.insert(sections, module) end
	end
	table.sort(sections, function(a, b)
		if a.Name == "Outsmart" then return false end
		if b.Name == "Outsmart" then return true end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	for _, module in sections do
		local ok, err = pcall(function() require(module).build(model, Vector3.zero) end)
		if not ok then warn("[MeadowV4] " .. module.Name .. " dressing skipped: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	-- Audit after every section, including fix8's additional authored bait lane.
	-- Preserve section failure isolation while retaining a visible failure reason.
	local clearanceOK, clearanceProblem = pcall(function()
		require(script.Parent.Section1).clearProps(model)
	end)
	if not clearanceOK then model:SetAttribute("PvpMapClearanceFailure", tostring(clearanceProblem)) end
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CFrame = CFrame.new(offset) * p.CFrame end
	end
	model:SetAttribute("MeadowOrigin", offset)
	model.Parent = parent
	return model
end
MeadowV4.Build = MeadowV4.build
return MeadowV4
ReplicatedStorage.MeadowV4.Clearance:
-- Shared Studio/offline resolve contract. Ray provider returns engine-shaped hits.
local C = {}
function C.resolve(position, edge, radius, ray, meadow, V)
	radius = radius or 3
	local function down(x, z)
		return ray(V.new(x, position.Y + (meadow and 9 or 42), z), V.new(0, -70, 0))
	end
	local function walkable(hit)
		return hit and hit.Normal.Y >= math.cos(math.rad(35.1))
			and (hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SurfaceRole") == "Floor" or hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SurfaceRole") == nil)
	end
	local center = down(position.X, position.Z)
	assert(walkable(center), "no walkable center floor")
	assert(math.abs(center.Position.Y - (position.Y - 3)) < 0.7, "authored Y disagrees with " .. center.Instance.Name)
	for ix = -6, 6 do
		for iz = -6, 6 do
			if ix * ix + iz * iz <= (radius * 2) ^ 2 then
				local x, z = position.X + ix * 0.5, position.Z + iz * 0.5
				local hit = down(x, z)
				assert(walkable(hit), "clearance floor/cover at " .. x .. "," .. z)
				local rise = hit.Position.Y - center.Position.Y
				local tolerance = (center.Normal.Y < 0.999 or hit.Normal.Y < 0.999) and 2.15 or 1.5
				assert(rise <= tolerance and (edge or rise >= -tolerance), "clearance cliff/wall " .. hit.Instance.Name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. z .. " rise " .. rise)
				local overhead = ray(V.new(x, center.Position.Y + 2.2, z), V.new(0, 6, 0))
				assert(not overhead, "head clearance " .. (overhead and overhead.Instance.Name or ""))
			end
		end
	end
	return V.new(position.X, center.Position.Y + 3, position.Z)
end
return C
ReplicatedStorage.MeadowV4.Fix1Art:
-- Studio pass 1: native, thick hill caps and voxel cave scenery. No new collision.
local Art = {}
function Art.transform(data, routes)
	local out = {}
	local function copy(p)
		local q = table.clone(p)
		q.position, q.size, q.rotation, q.color =
			table.clone(p.position), table.clone(p.size), table.clone(p.rotation), table.clone(p.color)
		return q
	end
	local function nearRoute(p)
		local radius = math.sqrt(p.size[1] ^ 2 + p.size[3] ^ 2) / 2 + 11
		local floor = -math.huge
		for _, route in pairs(routes) do
			for i = 2, #route do
				local a, b = route[i - 1], route[i]
				local dx, dz = b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z
				local t = math.clamp(
					((p.position[1] - a.x) * dx + (-p.position[3] - a.z) * dz) / math.max(0.001, dx * dx + dz * dz),
					0,
					1
				)
				if (p.position[1] - a.x - dx * t) ^ 2 + (-p.position[3] - a.z - dz * t) ^ 2 < radius ^ 2 then
					floor = math.max(floor, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t + 20.1)
				end
			end
		end
		return floor
	end
	for _, source in ipairs(data) do
		local p = copy(source)
		local name = p.name
		if name == "LookContinuousTurf" or name == "LookHillEarthBank" or name == "LookHillGrassBank" then
			continue -- Remove the paper-thin triangulated skin and its exposed skirts.
		end
		local tunnel = name:find("Tunnel") or name:find("LookHill") or name:find("LookSkylight")
		if tunnel then
			if p.material == "Rock" or p.material == "Basalt" then
				p.material = "Slate"
			end
			if p.material == "Wood" then
				p.material = "WoodPlanks"
			end
		end
		if name == "TunnelHillTurf" then
			-- Retain the authored walkable collider; grow its visible cap downwards.
			table.insert(out, p)
			local cap = copy(p)
			cap.name, cap.transparency, cap.collidable = "Fix1SolidGrassCap", 0, false
			local minimum = nearRoute(p)
			local nx, ny, nz = p.rotation[2], p.rotation[5], p.rotation[8]
			local low = p.position[2] - (math.abs(p.rotation[4]) * p.size[1] + math.abs(p.rotation[6]) * p.size[3]) / 2
			local depth = math.min(4, math.max(1.4, (low - minimum) / math.max(ny, 0.1) + 0.7))
			cap.size[2] = depth
			local shift = (depth - 1.4) / 2
			cap.position = { p.position[1] - nx * shift, p.position[2] - ny * shift, p.position[3] - nz * shift }
			table.insert(out, cap)
			-- Interlocked slate backing ties the turf to the existing 410 solid earth columns.
			local bottom = low - ny * (depth - 0.7)
			if bottom - 6 >= minimum then
				local rock = copy(cap)
				rock.name, rock.material, rock.color = "Fix1HillSlateBacking", "Slate", { 97, 107, 119 }
				rock.size[2] = 6
				local offset = depth / 2 + 2.9
				rock.position =
					{ cap.position[1] - nx * offset, cap.position[2] - ny * offset, cap.position[3] - nz * offset }
				table.insert(out, rock)
			end
			continue
		end
		if tunnel and p.shape == "Ball" and not name:find("Puddle") then
			if p.collidable then
				local collider = copy(p)
				collider.transparency = 1
				table.insert(out, collider)
			end
			-- Three overlapping rectangular masses within the previous prop bounds.
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local q = copy(p)
				q.name, q.shape = name .. "Voxel" .. i, "Block"
				q.collidable = false -- Keep the original hidden collision hull and route clearance.
				q.size = {
					p.size[1] * (i == 1 and 0.7 or 0.45),
					p.size[2] * (i == 1 and 1 or 0.65),
					p.size[3] * (i == 1 and 0.7 or 0.5),
				}
				q.position[1] += i == 2 and -p.size[1] * 0.25 or i == 3 and p.size[1] * 0.25 or 0
				q.position[2] -= i == 1 and 0 or p.size[2] * 0.175
				table.insert(out, q)
			end
			continue
		end
		if name == "TunnelMushroomGlow" then
			p.name, p.material, p.color = "Fix1MushroomCap", "Slate", { 85, 166, 180 }
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local dot = copy(p)
				dot.name, dot.material, dot.color = "Fix1MushroomSpot", "Neon", { 131, 248, 225 }
				dot.size = { 0.25, 0.08, 0.25 }
				dot.position[1] += (i == 1 and -0.3 or 0.3)
				dot.position[2] += p.size[2] / 2 + 0.04
				table.insert(out, dot)
			end
		elseif name == "TunnelMushroomStem" then
			p.material = "WoodPlanks"
		elseif name == "TunnelSkylightGlow" then
			p.transparency = 1
		elseif name == "TunnelExitAmberCrystal" then
			p.name, p.color = "Fix1AmethystCrystal", { 171, 116, 225 }
		end
		table.insert(out, p)
	end
	return out
end
return Art
ReplicatedStorage.MeadowV4.Fix2Routes:
-- The route centerlines are also the authoring source for the physical lanes.
-- Preserve the 18-stud deck and fill bend seams; carve earth below its low edge.
local F = {}
function F.waypoints(routes)
	local out = {}
	for name, route in routes do
		local points = {table.clone(route[1])}
		for i=2,#route do
			local a,b=route[i-1],route[i]
			local length=math.sqrt((b.x-a.x)^2+(b.y-a.y)^2+(b.z-a.z)^2)
			local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(length/3))
			for j=1,steps-1 do
				local t=j/steps
				table.insert(points,{x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,y=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t,z=a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t,kind="Walk"})
			end
			table.insert(points,table.clone(b))
		end
		out[name]=points
	end
	return out
end
function F.transform(data, routes)
	local out, lanes = {}, {}
	local styles={}
	for _,p in data do
		local name=p.name:match("^(.-)%d+$")
		if name and routes[name] then styles[p.name]=p;styles[name]=styles[name] or p end
	end
	for name, route in routes do
		if not name:match("^tunnel") and not name:match("^ravine") and not name:match("^jump") then
			for i = 2, #route do
				local a, b = route[i-1], route[i]
				local dx, dz, dy = b.x-a.x, -(b.z-a.z), b.y-a.y
				local run = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
				if run < 0.001 then continue end
				local length = math.sqrt(run*run+dy*dy)
				local ux, uz, c, s = dx/run, dz/run, run/length, dy/length
				local nx, ny, nz = -ux*s, c, -uz*s
				local style=styles[name..(i-2)] or styles[name]
				local p = {name="Fix2Lane_"..name.."_"..(i-1),category="lane",shape="Block",
					position={(a.x+b.x)/2-nx*0.6,(a.y+b.y)/2-ny*0.6+0.12,-(a.z+b.z)/2-nz*0.6},
					size={18,1.2,length+(if dy==0 and ((i==#route and (name=="spiral" or name=="fork_link" or name=="shelf")) or (name=="shelf_link" and i==2)) then 8 else 2)},rotation={uz,nx,ux*c,0,ny,s,-ux,nz,uz*c},
					material=if style then style.material else "Grass",color=if style then table.clone(style.color) else {99,172,44},collidable=true,transparency=0}
				table.insert(lanes,p)
			end
			-- Shared courts at flat route endpoints keep turning bodies supported;
			-- narrow longitudinal extensions alone leave outer L-junction corners.
			for _,i in {1,#route} do
				local p=route[i]
				local neighbour=route[if i==1 then 2 else #route-1]
				if math.abs(p.y-neighbour.y)<0.00001 then
					local style=styles[name]
					table.insert(lanes,{name="Fix2Junction_"..name.."_"..i,category="lane",shape="Block",
						position={p.x,p.y-0.48,-p.z},size={18,1.2,18},rotation={1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1},
						material=if style then style.material else "Grass",color=if style then table.clone(style.color) else {99,172,44},collidable=true,transparency=0})
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, source in data do
		-- Replace old route slabs rather than stack inconsistent sloped surfaces.
		local routeName = source.name:match("^(.-)%d+$")
		if routeName and routes[routeName] and not routeName:match("^tunnel") and not routeName:match("^ravine") and not routeName:match("^jump") then continue end
		local p = source
		if source.name == "SolidMountainStone" then
			local top = source.position[2]+source.size[2]/2
			for _, lane in lanes do
				local r, v = lane.rotation,lane.position
				local dx,dz = source.position[1]-v[1],source.position[3]-v[3]
				local cross = dx*r[1]+dz*r[7]
				local along = (dx*r[3]+dz*r[9])/r[5]
				local extent = (math.abs(r[1])+math.abs(r[7]))*2
				local endExtent = (math.abs(r[3])+math.abs(r[9]))*2/r[5]
				if math.abs(cross)<=9+extent and math.abs(along)<=lane.size[3]/2+endExtent then
					-- Entire column top below the lowest lane surface over its footprint.
					local floor = v[2]+0.6/r[5]-(r[2]*dx+r[8]*dz)/r[5]
					local low = floor-2*(math.abs(r[2])+math.abs(r[8]))/r[5]-1.4
					top = math.min(top,low)
				end
			end
			local bottom = source.position[2]-source.size[2]/2
			if top<=bottom then continue end
			if top<source.position[2]+source.size[2]/2 then
				p=table.clone(source)
				p.size={source.size[1],top-bottom,source.size[3]}
				p.position={source.position[1],(top+bottom)/2,source.position[3]}
			end
		end
		table.insert(out,p)
	end
	for _, lane in lanes do
		local r,v=lane.rotation,lane.position
		if math.abs(r[6])<0.00001 then table.insert(out,lane);continue end

-- Presentation only. Geometry, query flags, lane identity and routes stay intact.
local P = {}
function P.clearZone(position, routes)
	local x, y, z = position[1], position[2], position[3]
	-- Quiet summit camp; do not clear scenery on floors below it.
	if math.abs(y - 48) < 12 and x*x + (z+99)^2 < 31^2 then return true end
	-- First 30 horizontal studs from BOTH ends of every authored route.
	for _, route in routes do
		for _, reverse in {false, true} do
			local remaining = 30
			for j = 2, #route do
				local i = if reverse then #route-j+2 else j
				local a, b = route[if reverse then i else i-1], route[if reverse then i-1 else i]
				local dx, dz = b.x-a.x, -(b.z-a.z)
				local length = math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
				local limit = math.min(1, remaining/math.max(length, 0.001))
				local t = math.clamp(((x-a.x)*dx+(z+a.z)*dz)/math.max(length*length,0.001),0,limit)
				if (x-a.x-dx*t)^2+(z+a.z-dz*t)^2 < 16^2
					and math.abs(y-a.y-(b.y-a.y)*t) < 8 then return true end
				remaining -= length
				if remaining <= 0 then break end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end
function P.color(color, material, name)
	local c = Color3.fromRGB(unpack(color))
	local h,s,v = c:ToHSV()
	if material == "Grass" then
		return Color3.fromHSV(h,math.min(0.92,s*1.35),math.min(0.94,v*1.22))
	elseif name:find("Petal") or name:find("Flower") and not name:find("Stem") then
		return Color3.fromHSV(h,math.min(0.85,s*1.2),math.min(1,v*1.08))
	elseif name:find("Pav") or material == "Sand" or material == "Cobblestone" then
		return Color3.fromHSV(h*0.78,math.min(0.68,s*1.4),math.min(0.98,v*1.16))
	end
	return c
end
function P.transform(data, routes)
	local out = {}
	for _, source in data do
		local p = table.clone(source)
		local c = P.color(p.color,p.material,p.name)
		p.color = {c.R*255,c.G*255,c.B*255}
		-- Only remove small, nonphysical dressing. Never invisible collision hulls.
		local small = math.max(unpack(p.size)) <= 12
		local prop = p.name:find("Flower") or p.name:find("Bush") or p.name:find("Pebble")
			or p.name:find("Mushroom") or p.name:find("GrassTuft")
		if small and prop and not p.collidable and P.clearZone(p.position,routes) then
			p.transparency, p.polishCleared = 1, true
		end
		table.insert(out,p)
	end
	return out
end
return P

-- Pure deterministic fall/drop policy, shared by the isolated server and Lune tests.
local Policy = {}
function Policy.isRavineFall(x:number, y:number, z:number, falling:boolean):boolean
    return falling and math.abs(x)<79 and math.abs(z)<18 and y<0
end
function Policy.rim(x:number, z:number, approachZ:number):(number,number)
    if math.abs(x)>65 then return if x<0 then -84 else 84, math.clamp(z,-12,12) end
    local side = if math.abs(z)>.5 then z else approachZ
    local rz = if side>=0 then 24 else -24
    local rx = math.clamp(x,-72,72)
    if rz>0 and rx>-36 and rx<-8 then rx=-42 end -- carve beside walkout: use upper bank
    return rx,rz
end
function Policy.canPickup(carrier:number?, player:number):boolean
    return carrier==nil
end
return Policy

ReplicatedStorage.MeadowV4.TunnelControl:
-- Production adapter for reviewed tunnel policy: live Keeper and shared treasure ownership.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Policy = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TunnelPolicy"))
local Controller = {}
function Controller.attach(adapter)
	assert(
		adapter.getCarrier and adapter.drop and adapter.intercept and adapter.map and adapter.origin,
		"Production tunnel requires live ownership, Keeper, map and origin adapters"
	)
	local map = adapter.map or workspace:WaitForChild("MeadowV4")
	local origin = adapter.origin or Vector3.zero
	local function insideWorld(p)
		local q = p - origin
		return Policy.inside(q.X, q.Y, q.Z)
	end
	local function mudWorld(p)
		local q = p - origin
		return Policy.inMud(q.X, q.Y, q.Z)
	end
	local effects = Instance.new("Folder")
	effects.Name = "TunnelTransientEffects"
	effects.Parent = map
	local states = {}
	local random = Random.new(1013)
	local active = true
	local activeExit = nil
	local pursuedEntrant = nil
	local pursuedEpoch = nil
	local externalCleanup = nil
	local function restore(player, state)
		local hum = state.hum
		if state.originalSpeed and hum and hum.Parent then
			hum.WalkSpeed = state.originalSpeed
		end
		state.originalSpeed = nil
		state.hum = nil
		if player.Parent then
			player:SetAttribute("TunnelInside", false)
			player:SetAttribute("TunnelRumbling", false)
		end
	end
	local function intercept(exitId, entrant, epoch)
		-- Dropping/re-picking cannot cancel this player's already-running/waiting intercept.
		if not Policy.shouldIntercept(pursuedEntrant, activeExit, pursuedEpoch, entrant, exitId, epoch) then
			return
		end
		pursuedEntrant = entrant
		activeExit = exitId
		pursuedEpoch = epoch
		if externalCleanup then
			externalCleanup()
			externalCleanup = nil
		end
		externalCleanup = adapter.intercept(exitId, Policy.path(exitId), Policy.Tuning.ExitHoldSeconds, entrant, epoch)
	end
	local function hazard(player, root)
		local originalCharacter = player.Character
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local localPoint = root.Position - origin
		local x, z = Policy.hazardTarget(localPoint.X, localPoint.Z, velocity.X, velocity.Z)
		local target = origin + Vector3.new(x, 0.22, z)
		local shadow = Instance.new("Part")
		shadow.Name = "TunnelRedShadow"
		shadow.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.06, 6)
		shadow.Anchored = true
		shadow.CanCollide = false
		shadow.CanTouch = false
		shadow.CanQuery = false
		shadow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 48, 44)
		shadow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		shadow.Transparency = 0.18
		shadow.Position = target
		shadow.Parent = effects
		Debris:AddItem(shadow, 2)
		task.delay(Policy.Tuning.ShadowSeconds, function()
			if not active or not shadow.Parent then
				return
			end
			local rock = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			rock.Name = "TunnelFallingStalactite"
			rock.Size = Vector3.new(2.7, 4, 2.7)
			rock.Anchored = true
			rock.CanCollide = false
			rock.CanTouch = false
			rock.CanQuery = false
			rock.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 106, 127)
			rock.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
			rock.CFrame = CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 23, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0)
			rock.Parent = effects
			Debris:AddItem(rock, 0.8)
			TweenService:Create(
				rock,
				TweenInfo.new(Policy.Tuning.FallSeconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
				{ Position = target + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0) }
			):Play()
			task.delay(Policy.Tuning.FallSeconds, function()
				if not active then
					return
				end
				shadow:Destroy()
				local character = player.Character
				local currentRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if character ~= originalCharacter or currentRoot ~= root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
					return
				end
				local p = currentRoot.Position
				if
					insideWorld(p)
					and Vector2.new(p.X - target.X, p.Z - target.Z).Magnitude <= Policy.Tuning.ImpactRadius
				then
					if adapter.getCarrier() == player then
						adapter.drop(Vector3.new(p.X, origin.Y + 2.8, p.Z), "tunnel stalactite")
					end
					currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(Policy.Tuning.KnockVelocity, 8, 0)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		local carrier = adapter.getCarrier()
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local s = states[player]
			local inside = root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and insideWorld(root.Position)
			if inside then
				if not s then
					s = { entered = now, nextHazard = now + Policy.Tuning.FirstHazardSeconds }
					states[player] = s
				end
				if s.hum and s.hum ~= hum then
					restore(player, s)
				end
				if not s.inside then
					if s.left and now - s.left > Policy.Tuning.ReentryGrace then
						s.entered = now
						s.prediction = nil
						s.rumbleStarted = nil
						s.wasCarrier = nil
						s.nextHazard = now + Policy.Tuning.FirstHazardSeconds
					end
					s.inside = true
				end
				player:SetAttribute("TunnelInside", true)
				local age = now - s.entered
				player:SetAttribute("TunnelRumbling", age >= Policy.Tuning.RumbleAfter)
				if not adapter.managedSpeed and mudWorld(root.Position) then
					if not s.originalSpeed then
						s.originalSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
						s.hum = hum
					end
					hum.WalkSpeed = math.min(s.originalSpeed, Policy.Tuning.MudSpeed)
				elseif s.originalSpeed then
					hum.WalkSpeed = s.originalSpeed
					s.originalSpeed = nil
					s.hum = nil
				end
				if carrier == player then
					s.wasCarrier = true
					player:SetAttribute("TunnelKeeperThrowsSuppressed", true)
					if not s.carrying then
						s.carrying = true
						if not s.prediction then
							s.prediction = Policy.predict(
								root.Position.X - origin.X,
								root.Position.Z - origin.Z,
								random:NextNumber()
							)
						end
						workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardedExit", s.prediction)
						intercept(s.prediction, player, s.entered)
					end
				else
					s.carrying = false
					player:SetAttribute("TunnelKeeperThrowsSuppressed", false)
				end
				-- Former thieves still face rumble after dropping, so dropping cannot create a hide spot.
				if carrier == player or (s.wasCarrier and age >= Policy.Tuning.RumbleAfter) then
					if age >= Policy.Tuning.RumbleAfter and not s.rumbleStarted then
						s.rumbleStarted = true
						s.nextHazard = math.min(s.nextHazard, now + Policy.Tuning.RumbleInterval)
					end
					if now >= s.nextHazard then
						hazard(player, root)
						s.nextHazard = now + Policy.interval(age)
					end
				end
			elseif s then
				s.carrying = false
				if s.inside then
					s.inside = false
					s.left = now
				end
				restore(player, s)
				player:SetAttribute("TunnelKeeperThrowsSuppressed", false)
				if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
					states[player] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelRumbleActive", carrier ~= nil and carrier:GetAttribute("TunnelRumbling") == true)
	end)
	local removing = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if states[player] then
			restore(player, states[player])
			states[player] = nil
		end
	end)
	workspace:SetAttribute(
		"TunnelRuntime",
		adapter.intercept and "Production Keeper adapter / shared treasure state"
			or "Prototype hazards/slow/rumble and surface stand-in intercept"
	)
	return {
		disconnect = function()
			active = false
			connection:Disconnect()
			removing:Disconnect()
			for p, s in states do
				restore(p, s)
				if p.Parent then
					p:SetAttribute("TunnelKeeperThrowsSuppressed", false)
				end
			end
			if externalCleanup then
				externalCleanup()
				externalCleanup = nil
			end
			effects:Destroy()
			workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardWaiting", false)
			workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelRumbleActive", false)
			workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardedExit", nil)
		end,
	}
end
return Controller
