-- ProfileStore owns locking, retries, autosave and shutdown. Keep domain snapshots
-- separate while a save yields; acknowledge economy operations only after persistence.
local Profiles = {}
Profiles.__index = Profiles
function Profiles.new(store, config, domain, token, now, wait)
	return setmetatable({store=store, config=config, domain=domain, token=token,
		now=now, wait=wait, sessions={}}, Profiles)
end
function Profiles:load(key)
	if self.sessions[key] then return self.sessions[key].data end
	local ok, profile = pcall(function()
		return self.store:StartSessionAsync(key, {Cancel=function() return self.store.cancel and self.store.cancel(key) end})
	end)
	if not ok or not profile then return nil, "load failed/session locked" end
	local envelope = profile.Data
	if envelope.data == nil then
		if next(envelope) ~= nil then profile:EndSession(); return nil, "invalid save envelope" end
		local migrated, data = pcall(function()
			return self.store.legacy and self.store.legacy(key) or self.domain.default()
		end)
		if not migrated then profile:EndSession(); return nil, tostring(data) end
		envelope = {data=self.domain.copy(data), revision=0}
	end
	local valid, why = self.domain.validate(envelope.data, self.config)
	if not valid or not self.domain.finite(envelope.revision)
		or envelope.revision < 0 or envelope.revision % 1 ~= 0 then
		profile:EndSession()
		return nil, why or "invalid save revision"
	end
	profile.Data = self.domain.copy(envelope)
	local session = {profile=profile, data=self.domain.copy(envelope.data),
		revision=envelope.revision, expires=math.huge}
	self.sessions[key] = session
	profile.Data.data = session.data -- Restored pet ticks must be visible to native autosave.
	session.ended = profile.OnSessionEnd:Connect(function()
		session.expires = 0
		if self.store.lost then self.store.lost(key) end
	end)
	return session.data
end
function Profiles:commit(key, nextData, release)
	local s = self.sessions[key]
	if not s.profile:IsActive() then return false, "session ended" end
	local pending = s.pending or {data=self.domain.copy(nextData), revision=s.revision+1,
		operation=self.token .. ":" .. (s.revision+1)}
	s.pending = pending
	local acknowledged = false
	local function check(saved)
		if saved and saved.operation == pending.operation and saved.revision == pending.revision then
			acknowledged = true
		end
	end
	local connection = s.profile.OnAfterSave:Connect(check)
	check(s.profile.LastSavedData)
	s.profile.Data = self.domain.copy(pending)
	for _ = 1, self.config.Retries do
		if acknowledged or not s.profile:IsActive() then break end
		s.profile:Save()
		-- Save queues asynchronously; OnAfterSave is the acknowledgement, not Save's return.
		for _ = 1, 100 do
			if acknowledged or not s.profile:IsActive() then break end
			self.wait(0.05)
		end
	end
	connection:Disconnect()
	if not acknowledged or not s.profile:IsActive() then
		return false, "save unacknowledged/session ended"
	end
	s.data = self.domain.copy(pending.data)
	s.data.bank += s.deferredBank or 0
	s.deferredBank, s.pending, s.uncertain = 0, nil, nil
	s.revision = pending.revision
	-- Autosave must see ticks accrued during the acknowledged write too.
	s.profile.Data.data = s.data
	if release then
		s.ended:Disconnect()
		s.profile:EndSession()
		s.expires = 0
	end
	return true
end
function Profiles:transaction(key, mutate)
	local s = self.sessions[key]
	if not self:available(key) then return false, "profile busy/unavailable" end
	s.busy = true
	local nextData = self.domain.copy(s.data)
	local ran, ok, result = pcall(mutate, nextData)
	if not ran or not ok then s.busy=false; return false, result or ok end
	local valid, why = self.domain.validate(nextData, self.config)
	if not valid then s.busy=false; return false, why end
	local saved, err = self:commit(key, nextData, false)
	if not saved then s.uncertain=nextData end
	s.busy=false
	return saved, saved and result or err
end
function Profiles:save(key, release)
	local s = self.sessions[key]
	if not s or s.busy then return false, "profile busy" end
	s.busy=true
	local ok, why = self:commit(key, s.uncertain or s.data, release)
	if not ok then s.uncertain=s.uncertain or self.domain.copy(s.data) end
	s.busy=false
	return ok, why
end
function Profiles:available(key)
	local s = self.sessions[key]
	return s and s.profile:IsActive() and not s.busy and not s.closing
		and not s.uncertain and s.expires > self.now()
end
return Profiles
ReplicatedStorage.TreasureCore.Runtime:
local Runtime = {}
function Runtime.create(config, domain, profiles, service, hooks)
	local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
	local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local ProfileStore = require(script.Parent.Packages.ProfileStore)
	local mock = RS:IsStudio() and not SSS:GetAttribute("CoreUseDataStore")
	-- Legacy custom envelopes cannot be passed directly to ProfileStore.
	local native = ProfileStore.New(config.Store .. "_ProfileStore", {})
	if mock then native=native.Mock end
	local legacy = not mock and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore(config.Store)
	local store = {volatile=mock}
	function store:StartSessionAsync(key, options)
		if not mock then
			while ProfileStore.DataStoreState=="NotReady" do task.wait(.1) end
			assert(ProfileStore.DataStoreState=="Access", "QA DataStore inaccessible; refusing volatile fallback")
		end
		return native:StartSessionAsync(key, options)
	end
	store.cancel = function(key)
		return not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(key:match("%d+$")))
	end
	store.lost = function(key)
		local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(key:match("%d+$")))
		if player then player:Kick("Save session ended. Please rejoin.") end
	end
	store.legacy = function(key)
		if not legacy then return domain.default() end
		local old=legacy:GetAsync(key)
		if old == nil then return domain.default() end
		assert(type(old)=="table" and type(old.data)=="table", "invalid legacy record")
		assert(not old.token or (type(old.expires)=="number" and old.expires<=os.time()),
			"legacy session still active; retire old servers before migration")
		local valid, why=domain.validate(old.data, config)
		assert(valid, why)
		return old.data
	end
	local token=game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	return service.new(config, domain, profiles.new(store, config, domain, token, os.time, task.wait), hooks), token
end
return Runtime
ReplicatedStorage.TreasureCore.Service:
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
function Service.new(config, domain, profiles, hooks)
	return setmetatable({
		config = config,
		domain = domain,
		profiles = profiles,
		hooks = hooks,
		keys = {},
		openers = {},
		taps = {},
		roots = {},
		holds = {},
		accumulated = 0,
	}, Service)
end
function Service:data(actor)
	local key = self.keys[actor]
	local session = key and self.profiles.sessions[key]
	return session and session.data
end
function Service:publish(actor)
	local data = self:data(actor)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	actor:SetAttribute("Coins", data.coins)
	actor:SetAttribute("PlotCoins", data.bank)
	actor:SetAttribute("CoinsPerSecond", self.domain.rate(data, self.config))
	actor:SetAttribute("CoreOpenReady", data.pending and data.pending.placed == true or false)
	actor:SetAttribute(
		"CoreSaveStatus",
		self.profiles.store.volatile and "STUDIO: UNSAVED"
			or (
				self.profiles:available(self.keys[actor]) and "Saving active" or "Saving / retrying"
			)
	)
	local names = {}
	for name in data.discovered do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names)
	actor:SetAttribute("PetDiscoveries", table.concat(names, "|"))
end
function Service:load(actor, state)
	local key = "player_" .. actor.UserId
	local data, why = self.profiles:load(key)
	if not data then
		return false, why
	end
	self.keys[actor] = key
	state.completed, state.meadowEscapes = data.escapes, data.escapes
	state.shieldUsed, state.firstHitUsed = data.shieldUsed, data.firstHitUsed
	for _, pet in data.pets do
		self.hooks.restore(actor, pet, true)
	end
	if data.pending then
		self.hooks.restore(actor, data.pending, false)
	end
	self:publish(actor)
	return true
end
function Service:canEnter(actor)
	local data = self:data(actor)
	return data
		and self.profiles:available(self.keys[actor])
		and not data.pending
		and #data.pets < self.config.MaxPets
end
function Service:secure(actor, item, state)
	return self.profiles:transaction(self.keys[actor], function(data)
		return self.domain.secure(data, self.config, item.id, item.rollTier, state)
	end)
end
function Service:place(actor, item, position, rotation, slot)
	local x, z = self.hooks.center(slot)
	local ok, why = self.profiles:transaction(self.keys[actor], function(data)
		return self.domain.place(data, item.id, position.X - x, position.Z - z, rotation)
	end)
	local session = self.profiles.sessions[self.keys[actor]]
	while not ok and session and session.uncertain and actor.Parent do
		task.wait(2)
		ok = self:save(actor, false)
	end
	return ok, why
end
function Service:decorate(actor, item, opened)
	local root = item.visual
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local data = self:data(actor)
	local pet = not opened and data.pending or nil
	if opened then
		for _, entry in data.pets do
			if entry.id == item.id then
				pet = entry
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not pet then
		return
	end
	local rarity = self.config.Rarities[pet.tier]
	root:SetAttribute("CoreOwner", actor.UserId)
	root:SetAttribute("PetModel", rarity.model)
	root:SetAttribute("PetName", rarity.pet)
	root:SetAttribute("PetRarity", rarity.name)
	root:SetAttribute("PetTier", pet.tier)
	local rate = rarity.rate
	if opened and data.feed and data.pets[1].id == pet.id then
		rate += 1
	end
	root:SetAttribute("PetRate", rate)
	root:SetAttribute("CoreState", opened and "Pet" or "Acorn")
	root:SetAttribute("CorePlaced", pet.placed)
	if pet.placed and not root:FindFirstChild("CorePetPad") then
		local pad = Instance.new("Part")
		pad.Name, pad.Size, pad.CFrame =
			"CorePetPad", Vector3.new(4, 0.12, 4), root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1.45, 0)
		pad.Anchored, pad.CanCollide, pad.CanQuery, pad.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
		pad.Color, pad.Material, pad.Parent =
			Color3.fromRGB(103, 119, 130), Enum.Material.Slate, root
	end
	self.roots[item.id] = root
	if not opened and pet.placed and not root:FindFirstChild("CoreOpenPoint") then
		local point = Instance.new("Attachment")
		point.Name, point.Parent = "CoreOpenPoint", root
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.Name, prompt.ActionText, prompt.ObjectText = "CoreOpen", "Open", "Golden Acorn"
		prompt:SetAttribute("CoreOwner", actor.UserId)
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode, prompt.GamepadKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX
		prompt.HoldDuration, prompt.MaxActivationDistance, prompt.RequiresLineOfSight =
			self.config.OpenHold, 9, true
		prompt.ClickablePrompt, prompt.Parent = true, point
		local function begin(player)
			if player == actor and (self.hooks.openNear or self.hooks.near)(player, root) then
				self.holds[player] = { at = os.clock(), root = root }
			end
		end
		prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(begin)
		prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(player)
			local held = self.holds[player]
			task.delay(0.15, function()
				if self.holds[player] == held then
					self.holds[player] = nil
				end
			end)
		end)
		local function finish(player)
			local held = self.holds[player]
			self.holds[player] = nil
			if
				player ~= actor
				or not held
				or held.root ~= root
				or os.clock() - held.at < self.config.OpenHold - 0.05
				or not (self.hooks.openNear or self.hooks.near)(player, root)
			then
				return
			end
			local ok = self.profiles:transaction(self.keys[player], function(nextData)
				return self.domain.open(nextData, self.config, item.id)
			end)
			local session = self.profiles.sessions[self.keys[player]]
			while not ok and session and session.uncertain and player.Parent do
				task.wait(2)
				ok = self:save(player, false)
			end
			if ok and root.Parent then
				prompt:Destroy()
				root:SetAttribute("RevealAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
				self:decorate(player, item, true)
				self.hooks.event:FireClient(
					player,
					"Reveal",
					rarity.pet,
					rarity.name,
					rate,
					item.id
				)
				self.hooks.goal(player, "Pet earns Coins / collect at your plot gate")
			end
			self:publish(player)
		end
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(finish)
		self.openers[item.id] = { begin = begin, finish = finish }
	end
end
function Service:tapOpen(actor)
	local data, state = self:data(actor), self.hooks.state(actor)
	if
		not data
		or not state
		or state.phase ~= "Home"
		or not data.pending
		or not data.pending.placed
		or not self.profiles:available(self.keys[actor])
	then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.taps[actor] or -math.huge) < 1 then
		return
	end
	self.taps[actor] = now
	local opener = self.openers[data.pending.id]
	if not opener then
		return
	end
	opener.begin(actor)
	-- One touch intent; the server checks the full 0.6-second dwell/range/sight.
	task.delay(self.config.OpenHold + 0.05, function()
		opener.finish(actor)
	end)
end
function Service:collect(actor, marker)
	local state = self.hooks.state(actor)
	if not state or state.phase ~= "Home" or not self.hooks.near(actor, marker) then
		return
	end
	local data = self:data(actor)
	if not data or data.bank <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local ok, amount = self.profiles:transaction(self.keys[actor], self.domain.collect)
	if ok and amount > 0 then
		self.hooks.event:FireClient(actor, "Collect", amount)
	end
	self:publish(actor)
end
function Service:tick(dt)
	-- Holds are checked each server frame, not just on Triggered/whole-second income ticks.
	for actor, held in self.holds do
		if not (self.hooks.openNear or self.hooks.near)(actor, held.root) then
			self.holds[actor] = nil
		end
	end
	self.accumulated += dt
	if self.accumulated < 1 then
		return
	end
	local seconds = math.floor(self.accumulated)
	self.accumulated -= seconds
	for actor, key in self.keys do
		local session = self.profiles.sessions[key]
		if self.profiles:available(key) then
			local data, state = self:data(actor), self.hooks.state(actor)
			if state then
				data.shieldUsed, data.firstHitUsed = state.shieldUsed, state.firstHitUsed
			end
			self.domain.tick(data, self.config, seconds)
		elseif
			session.busy
			and not session.uncertain
			and not session.closing
			and session.expires > self.profiles.now()
		then
			session.deferredBank = (session.deferredBank or 0)
				+ self.domain.rate(session.data, self.config) * seconds
		end
		self:publish(actor)
	end
end
function Service:save(actor, release)
	local key = self.keys[actor]
	if not key then
		return true
	end
	local session = self.profiles.sessions[key]
	if release then
		session.closing = true
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 20
	while session.busy and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if not session.uncertain then
		local state = self.hooks.state(actor)
		if state then
			session.data.shieldUsed, session.data.firstHitUsed =
				state.shieldUsed, state.firstHitUsed
		end
	end
	local ok, why = self.profiles:save(key, release)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Core] " .. tostring(why))
	end
	if release and ok then
		self.keys[actor] = nil
		self.profiles.sessions[key] = nil
	end
	return ok
end
return Service

	adapter:collect({}, {})

	assert(adapter:data(actor).coins == 1 and collected == 1, "owner collect/pop")
	adapter:tick(1)
	store.onWrite = function()
		store.onWrite = nil
		adapter:tick(2)
	end
	adapter:collect(actor, {})
	assert(
		adapter:data(actor).coins == 2 and adapter:data(actor).bank == 2,
		"yielding save erased online ticks"
	)
	assert(adapter:save(actor, true), "adapter release")
	return "acorn handoff -> secure -> Open -> Pup -> Coins -> ProfileStore contract save/load; replay, session fencing, unknown-write, schema, migration, capacity PASS"
end

ServerScriptService.DropSampleTestRunner:
-- Studio raycasts over the loaded place, AFTER KitSwap finishes; no offline proxy.
local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Sample = {}
function Sample.run(arena, Arena)
	local deadline = os.clock() + 120
	while arena.v4:GetAttribute("KitSwapVersion") == nil do
		assert(os.clock() < deadline, "KitSwap not complete >120s; live sample refused")
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	local n = SSS:GetAttribute("DropSampleTestN") or 8
	assert(type(n) == "number" and n % 1 == 0 and n >= 2 and n <= 64, "DropSampleTestN must be integer 2..64")
	-- Refresh the allowlist AFTER all asynchronous kit placements.
	arena.laneParams = nil
	local D = require(RS.MeadowV4.ReachableDrops)
	local routes = require(RS.MeadowV4.RouteData)
	local total, failures = 0, 0
	local groups = {}
	SSS:SetAttribute("DropSampleTestFailures", "[]")
	SSS:SetAttribute("DropSampleTestFailureCount", 0)
	arena.samplingDrops = true
	local function persist()
		local rows = {}
		for _, row in groups do
			table.insert(rows, row)
		end
		table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
			if a.count ~= b.count then return a.count > b.count end
			return a.laneId .. a.landingInstance .. a.reason < b.laneId .. b.landingInstance .. b.reason
		end)
		while #rows > 30 do
			table.remove(rows)
		end
		SSS:SetAttribute("DropSampleTestFailures", game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(rows))
		SSS:SetAttribute("DropSampleTestFailureCount", failures)
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, {arena.model}
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local function fail(label, point, reason, laneId)
		failures += 1
		local h = workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), params)
		local landing = h and h.Instance:GetFullName() or "NONE"
		laneId = laneId or "kit"
		local key = laneId .. "|" .. landing .. "|" .. tostring(reason)
		local row = groups[key] or {laneId=laneId, landingInstance=landing, reason=tostring(reason), count=0, samples={}}
		groups[key] = row
		row.count += 1
		if #row.samples < 3 then
			table.insert(row.samples, {label=label, position={point.X, point.Y, point.Z}, landingY=h and h.Position.Y or "UNKNOWN"})
		end
		persist() -- Retain evidence even if the runner is interrupted.
		if failures <= 30 then
			warn("[DropSampleTest] FAIL " .. label .. " " .. tostring(reason) .. " under=" .. landing .. " Y=" .. tostring(h and h.Position.Y))
		end
	end
	for _, p in arena.v4:GetDescendants() do
		if p:GetAttribute("KitAssemblyId") or p:FindFirstAncestor("KitDressing") then
			if p:GetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor") == true or p:GetAttribute("Walkable") == true
				or p:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor") or p:HasTag("Walkable") or p:HasTag("WalkableLaneFloor") then
				fail("kit allowlist contamination " .. p:GetFullName(), arena.origin, "walkable kit prop")
			end
		end
	end
	for lane, route in routes do
		for i = 2, #route do
			local u, v = route[i - 1], route[i]
			local a, b = arena.origin + Vector3.new(u.x, u.y, -u.z), arena.origin + Vector3.new(v.x, v.y, -v.z)
			local forward = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z).Unit
			local side = Vector3.new(-forward.Z, 0, forward.X)
			for j = 0, n - 1 do
				for _, edge in {-5, 0, 5} do
					local pose = a:Lerp(b, (j + 0.5) / n) + side * edge
					local floor = Arena.carrierFloor(arena, pose + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
					for _, knock in {-20, 0, 20} do
						total += 1
						local label = lane .. "/" .. i .. "/" .. j .. " edge=" .. edge .. " knock=" .. knock
						if not floor then fail(label, pose, "no lane floor at carrier", lane)
						else
							local socket, why = Arena.dropSocket(arena, pose + side * knock + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), floor)
							if not socket then fail(label, pose, why, lane)
							else
								local hit = workspace:Raycast(socket + Vector3.new(0, 8.25, 0), Vector3.new(0, -10.45, 0), params)
								if not hit or not hit.Instance:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor")
									or math.abs(hit.Position.Y - socket.Y) > 0.1 or math.abs(socket.Y - floor.Y) > 2
									or not D.connected(D.segment(floor, arena.laneGraph), D.segment(socket, arena.laneGraph)) then
										fail(label, socket, "landing differs from carrier lane / blocked live surface", lane)
								end
							end
						end
						if total % 9 == 0 then
							task.wait()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	SSS:SetAttribute("DropSampleTestSamples", total)
	arena.samplingDrops = false
	persist()
	assert(failures == 0, string.format("%d/%d live drops failed; see ServerScriptService.DropSampleTestFailures JSON", failures, total))
	return string.format("%d live knock-drops; zero failures; KitSwapVersion=%s; N=%d per segment", total, tostring(arena.v4:GetAttribute("KitSwapVersion")), n)
end
return Sample

		return
	end
	item.recoverAt, item.bounceAt = nil, now
	visual(item)
	local effect =
		part(world, "TreasureRecoveryPoof", Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), item.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), orange)
	effect.Shape, effect.Material = Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon
	effect.CanCollide, effect.CanQuery = false, false
	TweenService:Create(effect, TweenInfo.new(1), { Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(effect, 1)
end
local function expireLoot(now)
	local expired, item = Rules.expire(rules, now)
	if expired then
		visual(item)
		Traps.clearIsland(traps, arena)
		Arena.reset(arena)
		for actor, s in states do
			if s.phase == "Run" then
				goal(actor, "Time up / treasure lost / new treasure in 3s")
			end
		end
		refreshLoot()
		conservation()
	end
	return expired
end
local function drop(actor, reason, position)

	local ok, item = Rules.drop(rules, actor, os.clock(), position or dropPosition(actor))
	if ok then
		presentDrop(item, actor)
		goal(actor, Config.ItemName .. " DROPPED / Grab after settle")

local function hit(actor, from, source)
	local r = root(actor)
	if V4 and r and (source == nil or source == "Guardian") then
		local p = r.Position - arena.origin
		if TunnelPolicy.inside(p.X, p.Y, p.Z) then
			return false
		end
	end
	if not r or Arena.safe(arena, r.Position) then
		return false
	end
	local s, item = states[actor], states[actor].item
	local ok, retained = Rules.hit(rules, actor, source or "Guardian", os.clock(), dropPosition(actor))
	if not ok then
		return false
	end
	s.catches = (s.catches or 0) + 1
	local away = Vector3.new(r.Position.X - from.X, 0, r.Position.Z - from.Z)
	if away.Magnitude > 0 then
		local movement = away.Unit * Config.GuardianKnockback
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, { actor.Character }
		local collision = workspace:Blockcast(r.CFrame, Vector3.new(2, 4, 2), movement, params)
		local distance = collision and math.max(0, collision.Distance - 0.5) or Config.GuardianKnockback
		r.CFrame += away.Unit * distance
	end
	if item then
		if item.state == "Dropped" then
			presentDrop(item, actor)
		else
			visual(item)
		end
	end
	goal(
		actor,
		retained and "Stumble / first hit: kept " .. Config.ItemName
			or Config.ItemName .. " DROPPED / " .. Config.MercySeconds .. "s mercy"
	)
	publish(actor)
	refreshLoot()
	if testLog then
		testLog("production hit " .. tostring(source or "Guardian") .. " retained=" .. tostring(retained))
	end
	return true
end
local function check(actor, action, target, item)
	local r = root(actor)
	if not arena or not r or states[actor].run ~= arena or Arena.safe(arena, r.Position) then
		return false, "arena/safe"
	end
	if action == "Bump" then
		local victim = states[target]
		local v = victim and root(target)
		if not v or victim.run ~= arena or Arena.safe(arena, v.Position) then
			return false, "victim/safe"
		end
		return (r.Position - v.Position).Magnitude <= 4 and math.abs(r.Position.Y - v.Position.Y) <= 3 and Arena.sight(
			arena,
			r.Position,
			v.Position
		),
			"Bump range/sight/height"
	end
	local position = item.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	local distance, limit = (r.Position-position).Magnitude, action == "Steal" and 9 or 4
	local visible, obstruction = Arena.sight(arena,r.Position,position)
	if distance <= limit and visible then return true end
	local blocker = obstruction and obstruction.Instance:GetFullName() or "NONE"
	local diagnostic = {action=action,itemId=item.id,itemVersion=item.version,distance=distance,limit=limit,
		root=tostring(r.Position),socket=tostring(item.position),target=tostring(position),
		blocker=blocker,hit=obstruction and tostring(obstruction.Position) or "NONE",visible=visible}
	game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):SetAttribute("LootHoldLastRefusal",
		game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(diagnostic))
	local reason=string.format("item %s distance=%.3f limit=%.1f blocker=%s root=%s socket=%s",
		distance>limit and "range" or "sight",distance,limit,blocker,tostring(r.Position),tostring(item.position))
	if testLog then testLog(reason) end
	return false,reason
end
local function bumpTarget(actor)
	local r = root(actor)
	if not r then
		return nil
	end
	local nearest, distance = nil, 4.001
	for other, s in states do
		local v = root(other)
		if other ~= actor and s.item and s.phase == "Run" and v then
			local d = (r.Position - v.Position).Magnitude
			if d < distance then
				nearest, distance = other, d
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end
local function holdAction(actor, action, stage)
	expireLoot(os.clock())
	if testLog then
		testLog("hold " .. action .. " / " .. stage)
	end
	local s = states[actor]
	if not s then
		return false, "no state"
	end
	if stage == "cancel" then
		s.hold = nil
		return true
	end
	if stage == "begin" then
		local target = action == "Bump" and bumpTarget(actor) or nil
		local now = os.clock()
		local ok, why = Rules.begin(rules, actor, action, target, now, check)
		if ok and target then
			s.combatUntil, states[target].combatUntil = now + 2, now + 2
		end
		return ok, why
	end
	if stage ~= "finish" then
		return false, "invalid stage"
	end
	local hold = s.hold
	if hold and hold.action == action then
		local remainder = Config.HoldSeconds[action] - (os.clock() - hold.began)
		if remainder > 0 and remainder < 0.2 then
			task.wait(remainder)
		end
	end
	expireLoot(os.clock())
	local oldItem = rules.active
	local oldPosition = oldItem and oldItem.position
	local target = s.hold and s.hold.target
	local ok, result = Rules.finish(rules, actor, action, os.clock(), check, dropPosition)
	if not ok then
		return false, result
	end
	if action == "Bump" then
		local v = root(target)
		if v then
			local from = root(actor).Position
			local delta = Vector3.new(v.Position.X - from.X, 0, v.Position.Z - from.Z)
			if delta.Magnitude > 0 then
				local movement = delta.Unit * 3.5
				local obstruction = workspace:Blockcast(v.CFrame, Vector3.new(2, 4, 2), movement, arena.params)
				v.CFrame += delta.Unit * (obstruction and math.max(0, obstruction.Distance - 0.5) or 3.5)
			end
		end
		goal(target, Config.ItemName .. " DROPPED")
	else
		s.trapPickedUp, s.trapHold = true, nil
		s.lastSocket = oldPosition or s.lastSocket
		if not oldItem.eventTimestamp then
			oldItem.eventTimestamp = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			oldItem.escapeClock = oldItem.eventTimestamp + math.max(0, oldItem.escapeDeadline - os.clock())
			oldItem.rollTier = CoreDomain.roll(CoreConfig, math.random())
			oldItem.baseOutcome = CoreConfig.Rarities[oldItem.rollTier].pet
		end
		goal(actor, Config.ItemName .. " is yours when you escape. RUN!")
		if action == "Steal" then
			Arena.warn(arena, actor, os.clock())
		end
	end
	if action == "Bump" then
		presentDrop(oldItem, target)
	else
		visual(oldItem)
	end
	refreshLoot()
	Rules.audit(rules)
	return true
end
local function bindHold(q, action)
	q.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(actor)
		if not testRunning then
			holdAction(actor, action, "begin")
		end
	end)
	q.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(actor)
		local s = states[actor]
		local held = s and s.hold
		task.delay(0.2, function()
			if s and s.hold == held then
				s.hold = nil
			end
		end)
	end)
	q.Triggered:Connect(function(actor)
		if not testRunning then
			holdAction(actor, action, "finish")
		end
	end)
end

	Traps.remove(traps, actor)
	s.trapHold = nil
	s.run, s.hold = nil, nil
	if actor.Character then
		local pen = s.item and pens[s.slot]
		actor.Character:PivotTo(pen and CFrame.new(pen.gate) or CFrame.new(0, 6, Config.HomeSpawnZ))
	end
	if s.item then
		visual(s.item)
	end

end
local function returnRun(actor, automatic)
	expireLoot(os.clock())
	local s, r = states[actor], root(actor)
	if
		not s
		or s.phase ~= "Run"
		or not r
		or not arena
		or (not Arena.safe(arena, r.Position) and not (not automatic and near(actor, arena.dock)))
	then
		return false, "return boundary/phase"
	end
	if s.coreSecuring then
		return false, "secure saving"
	end
	if not testRunning and s.item then
		local item = s.item
		-- Atomic flag precedes any yield. Ambiguous saves keep the same cargo locked.
		item.securePending, s.coreSecuring = true, true
		local saved, detail = core:secure(actor, item, s)
		if not saved then
			goal(actor, "Saving treasure / retrying safely")
			-- Reconcile the same snapshot before allowing the boundary transition.
			while actor.Parent and not saved do
				task.wait(2)
				saved = core:save(actor, false)
				local data = core:data(actor)
				saved = saved and data and data.pending and data.pending.id == item.id
				if not saved and core.profiles:available(core.keys[actor]) then
					saved = core:secure(actor, item, s)
				end
			end
			if not saved then
				s.coreSecuring = false
				return false, detail
			end
		end
		s.coreSecuring = false
	end
	local ok, why = Rules.secure(rules, actor, os.clock())
	if ok then
		if s.item and s.item.state == "Secured" then
			-- Legacy fixtures use RAM; ordinary core awards were saved before this point.
			s.meadowEscapes = (s.meadowEscapes or 0) + 1
		end
		print(
			string.format(
				"[Greybox] return source=%s boundary=%s position=%s item=%s",
				automatic and "protected apron" or "return action",
				tostring(Arena.safe(arena, r.Position)),
				tostring(r.Position),
				s.item and (s.item.id .. "/" .. s.item.state) or "empty"
			)
		)
		home(actor)
		if not testRunning and s.item then
			core:decorate(actor, s.item, false)
		end
		refreshLoot()
		Rules.audit(rules)
	end
	return ok, why
end
local function placeItem(actor, slot, position, rotation)
	local s, pen = states[actor], pens[slot]
	local r = root(actor)
	if not s or not pen or s.slot ~= slot or not r then
		return false, "plot owner"
	end
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" or type(rotation) ~= "number" then
		return false, "placement required"
	end
	local valid, extent = Placement.validate(Config, slot, position.X, position.Z, rotation, pen.occupied)
	if not valid then
		return false, extent
	end
	if
		position.Y ~= position.Y
		or math.abs(position.Y - (Placement.height(slot) + 0.2)) > 0.05
		or (r.Position - position).Magnitude > 24
	then
		return false, "floor/range"
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, { pen.base }
	local floor = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), params)
	if not floor or math.abs(floor.Position.Y - position.Y) > 0.05 then
		return false, "plot floor"
	end
	if not s.item or s.item.state ~= "Secured" or s.corePlacing then
		return false, "not secured/busy"
	end
	if not testRunning then
		s.corePlacing = true
		local saved, why = core:place(actor, s.item, position, rotation, slot)
		s.corePlacing = false
		if not saved then
			return false, why
		end
	end
	local ok, item = Rules.place(rules, actor)
	if not ok then
		return false, item
	end
	pen.count += 1
	item.position = Vector3.new(position.X, Placement.height(slot) + 1.7, position.Z)
	item.rotation = rotation % 360
	item.penSlot = slot
	table.insert(pen.occupied, { x = position.X, z = position.Z, extent = extent })
	visual(item)
	item.visual.Name = "Placed_" .. item.id
	item.visual:SetAttribute("PenSlot", slot)
	item.visual:SetAttribute("PlacementX", position.X)
	item.visual:SetAttribute("PlacementZ", position.Z)
	item.visual:SetAttribute("PlacementExtent", extent)
	if not testRunning then
		core:decorate(actor, item, false)
	end
	goal(actor, testRunning and "Placed / enter for another run" or "Hold E / tap Open at your Golden Acorn")
	publish(actor)
	Rules.audit(rules)
	return true
end

		end,

							if good then

			end

local function assemble()
	if arena and arena.tunnel then
		arena.tunnel.disconnect()
	end
	session += 1
	local override = SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxSeed")
	local fixed = type(override) == "number" and override > 0 and override < 2147483647 and override % 1 == 0
	local seed = fixed and override
		or (Config.SessionSeed + 1009 + session * 9176 + Config.RecipeVersion * 31) % 2147483647
	local layout
	for retry = 1, 8 do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			local candidate = Layout.assemble(Config, seed + retry - 1, session == 1 and not fixed)
			Layout.validate(Config, candidate)
			return candidate
		end)
		if ok then
			layout = value
			break
		else
			warn("[Greybox] recipe rejected: " .. tostring(value))
		end
	end
	if not layout then
		layout = Layout.assemble(Config, 101, true)
		Layout.validate(Config, layout)
	end
	arena = Arena.build(world, layout, part, label)
	arena.nest =
		part(arena.model, "NestAction", Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), nestPosition(arena) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), orange)
	arena.nest.Transparency, arena.nest.CanCollide, arena.nest.CanQuery = 1, false, false
	arena.steal = prompt(arena.nest, "Steal", Config.ItemName, Config.HoldSeconds.Steal)
	bindHold(arena.steal, "Steal")
	arena.groundAction = part(arena.model, "GroundAction", Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), arena.nest.Position)
	arena.groundAction.Transparency, arena.groundAction.CanCollide, arena.groundAction.CanQuery = 1, false, false
	arena.grab = prompt(arena.groundAction, "Grab", Config.ItemName, Config.HoldSeconds.Grab)
	arena.grab.MaxActivationDistance = 4
	bindHold(arena.grab, "Grab")
	local back = prompt(arena.dock, "Return", "Home")
	back.Triggered:Connect(function(actor)
		if not testRunning then
			returnRun(actor)
		end
	end)
	visual(Rules.spawn(rules, nestPosition(arena)))
	refreshLoot()
	print("[Greybox] shared arena: " .. Layout.signature(layout))
	if V4 then
		local a = arena
		local function attachTunnel()
			a.tunnel = require(V4.TunnelController).attach({
				map = a.v4,
				origin = a.origin,
				managedSpeed = true,
				getCarrier = function()
					local item = rules.active
					return item
							and item.state == "Carried"
							and item.holder
							and item.holder:IsA("Player")
							and item.holder
						or nil
				end,
				drop = function(_position, reason)
					local item = rules.active
					if item and item.state == "Carried" then
						drop(item.holder, reason)
					end
				end,
				intercept = function(...)
					return Arena.intercept(a, ...)
				end,
			})
		end
		a.attachTunnel = attachTunnel
		attachTunnel()
	end
end

local function enterRun(actor)
	local s = states[actor]
	if not s or s.phase ~= "Home" or s.item or not near(actor, portal) or (s.slot and pens[s.slot].count >= 8) then
		return false, "enter phase/range/cargo/full pen"
	end
	if not testRunning and not core:canEnter(actor) then
		goal(actor, "Open your acorn / plot full / saving unavailable")
		return false, "core capacity/profile"
	end
	if
		not testRunning
		and SSS:GetAttribute("CoreRequireLegacyGates") == true
		and (SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestSuccess") ~= true or SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxPvpTestSuccess") ~= true)
	then
		goal(actor, "Locked / run GreyboxLoopTest AND GreyboxPvpTest in Server attributes")
		return false, "runtime gates not passed"
	end
	if population() >= Config.Capacity then
		return false, "shared island full (8)"
	end
	if not arena then
		assemble()
	elseif arena.idle then
		-- Keep the empty island visible; shuffle only when the next run begins.
		if arena.tunnel then
			arena.tunnel.disconnect()
			arena.tunnel = nil
		end
		arena.model:Destroy()
		assemble()
	end
	arena.hasEntrants = true
	s.phase, s.run, s.counter, s.started, s.mercy, s.catches =
		"Run", arena, (s.counter or 0) + 1, os.clock(), os.clock() + Config.MercySeconds, 0
	Traps.entry(traps, actor, s)
	local arrivals = { -12, 0, 12 }
	s.lastSafe = Arena.position(arena, arrivals[((population() - 1) % 3) + 1], 3, Config.EntryZ)
	actor.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Arena.position(arena, arrivals[((population() - 1) % 3) + 1], 4, Config.EntryZ)))
	publish(actor)
	goal(actor, "Choose a route / hold Steal at " .. Config.ItemName .. " / escape commits ownership")
	return true
end

actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(actor, action, stage, rotation)
	if testRunning or type(action) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastAction[actor] or 0) < 0.08 and stage ~= "cancel" then
		return
	end
	lastAction[actor] = now
	local ok, why
	if action == "Trap" then
		ok, why = trapAction(actor, stage, rotation)
	elseif action == "TrapRecall" then
		ok, why = trapAction(actor, "recall")
	elseif Config.HoldSeconds[action] then
		ok, why = holdAction(actor, action, stage)
	elseif action == "Enter" then

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not testRunning then
		core:tick(dt)
	end
	accumulator += dt
	if accumulator < 0.05 then
		return

	local step, now = math.min(accumulator, 0.15), os.clock()

	for _, item in rules.items do
		if item.state == "Placed" and item.visual then

				or Vector3.zero
			item.visual.CFrame = CFrame.new(
				item.position + drift + Vector3.new(0, math.abs(math.sin(now * 2)) * 0.15, 0)
			) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(item.rotation or 0), 0)
		end
	end
	expireLoot(now)

		h.UseJumpPower, h.JumpHeight = false, s.item and Config.CarryJumpHeight or Config.JumpHeight
		h.WalkSpeed = now < (s.slowUntil or 0) and Config.StumbleSpeed
			or (s.item and Config.CarrySpeed or Config.WalkSpeed)
		if V4 and s.phase == "Run" and arena then
			local p = r.Position - arena.origin
			if TunnelPolicy.inMud(p.X, p.Y, p.Z) then
				h.WalkSpeed = math.min(h.WalkSpeed, TunnelPolicy.Tuning.MudSpeed)
			end
			if s.item and RavinePolicy.isRavineFall(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, h:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) then
				local x, z = RavinePolicy.rim(p.X, p.Z, s.approachZ or p.Z)
				local rim = Arena.rimDropSocket(arena, arena.origin + Vector3.new(x, 0, z))
				drop(actor, "ravine rim / physical climb-out", rim)
			end
			if math.abs(p.Z) > 22 then
				s.approachZ = p.Z
			end
		end
		if s.phase ~= "Run" or not arena then
			continue
		end
		if Arena.outside(arena, r.Position) then
			if s.item then
				drop(actor, "outside island fall/recovery")
			end
			actor.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(s.lastSafe or Arena.position(arena, 0, 3, Config.EntryZ)))
			r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			continue
		end
		if s.item and Arena.safe(arena, r.Position) then
			if not s.coreSecuring then
				task.spawn(returnRun, actor, true)
			end
			continue
		end
		local carrierFloor = Arena.carrierFloor(arena, r.Position)
		if
			carrierFloor
			and h.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
			and math.abs(r.Position.Y - carrierFloor.Y - 3) < 1
		then
			s.lastLaneFloor = carrierFloor
		end
		local socket = Arena.dropSocket(arena, r.Position, carrierFloor or s.lastLaneFloor)
		if h.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			local floor = Arena.floor(arena, r.Position)
			if socket and floor and math.abs(r.Position.Y - floor.Y - 3) < 1 and (socket - floor).Magnitude < 3 then
				s.lastSafe = socket + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
		if socket then
			s.lastSocket = socket
		end
		if s.hold then
			local hold = s.hold
			local ok = Rules.eligible(rules, actor, hold.action, hold.target, now, check)

				s.hold = nil

		if s.item then
			if

				or (arena.attack and arena.attack.actor == actor)

				s.idleAt = now

			if not s.lastPosition or (r.Position - s.lastPosition).Magnitude > 0.4 then

			if now - (s.idleAt or now) > 10 then

					drop(actor, "idle 10s + warning 2s")

			end
		end

		if s.item and s.item.visual then
			s.item.visual.Color = now < s.mercy and Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255) or orange

		return

		if arena.hasEntrants and not arena.idle then
			Traps.clearIsland(traps, arena)

		visual(Rules.spawn(rules, nestPosition(arena)))
		arena.mode, arena.target = "Guard", nil
	end
	if rules.active and rules.active.state == "Dropped" then
		recoverFallenLoot(rules.active, now)

	if not ok then
		for _, mode in { "GreyboxLoopTest", "GreyboxPvpTest" } do
			SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Success", false)
			SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Result", "FAIL: conservation " .. tostring(why))
			warn("[" .. mode .. "] conservation FAIL " .. tostring(why))
		end
	end
end)

local function startTest(mode)
	if testRunning then
		return
	end
	testRunning = true
	SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Success", false)
	SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Result", "RUNNING")
	return task.spawn(function()
		local player, dummy
		local function snapshot(actor, name)
			local r, h
			if actor then
				r, h = root(actor)
			end
			-- Logical and physical state together distinguish range misses from legal drops.
			local s = actor and states[actor]
			if not r or not s then
				return name .. "=missing"
			end
			local p = arena and s.phase == "Run" and r.Position - arena.origin or r.Position
			return string.format(
				"%s pos=(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f) phase=%s carry=%s item=%s shield=%.2f mercy=%.2f floor=%s speed=%.1f",
				name,
				p.X,
				p.Y,
				p.Z,
				s.phase,
				tostring(s.item ~= nil),
				s.item and (s.item.id .. "/" .. s.item.state) or "none",
				math.max(0, s.shield - os.clock()),
				math.max(0, s.mercy - os.clock()),
				h.FloorMaterial.Name,
				h.WalkSpeed
			)
		end
		local function log(message)
			local item = rules.active
			print(
				"["
					.. mode
					.. "] "
					.. message
					.. " | "
					.. snapshot(player, "player")
					.. (dummy and (" | " .. snapshot(dummy, "dummy")) or "")
					.. " | active="
					.. (item and (item.id .. "/" .. item.state) or "none")
			)
		end
		testLog = log
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if mode == "DropSampleTest" then
				assert(RunService:IsStudio(), "DropSampleTest is Studio-only")
				return require(SSS:WaitForChild("DropSampleTestRunner")).run(arena, Arena)
			end
			local deadline = os.clock() + 8
			repeat
				player = firstPlayer
				if player and player:GetAttribute("GreyboxReady") then
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			until os.clock() >= deadline
			assert(player and player:GetAttribute("GreyboxReady"), "player not ready >8s")
			player:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTesting", true)
			local runner = require(SSS:WaitForChild("GreyboxLoopTestRunner"))
			if mode == "GreyboxTrapTest" then
				return require(SSS:WaitForChild("GreyboxTrapTestRunner")).run(player, states, api, log)
			end
			if mode == "OutsmartTest" then
				assert(RunService:IsStudio(), "OutsmartTest is Studio-only")
				return require(SSS:WaitForChild("OutsmartTestRunner")).run(api, log)
			end
			if mode == "GreyboxPvpTest" then
				return runner.pvp(player, states, pens, world, api, log, function(value)
					dummy = value
				end)
			end
			local runs = SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestRuns") or 3
			assert(type(runs) == "number" and runs >= 3 and runs % 1 == 0, "GreyboxLoopTestRuns must be an integer >=3")
			local passed, expiries = 0, 0
			SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestPassCount", 0)
			SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestExpiryCount", 0)
			for i = 1, runs do
				log("loop " .. i .. "/" .. runs .. " START")
				local loopOk, detail, outcome = pcall(runner.run, player, states, pens, world, api, log)
				if not loopOk then
					error(passed .. "/" .. runs .. " passed; loop " .. i .. " harness error: " .. tostring(detail))
				end
				passed += 1
				expiries += outcome == "expiry" and 1 or 0
				SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestPassCount", passed)
				SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestExpiryCount", expiries)
				log("loop " .. i .. "/" .. runs .. " PASS: " .. detail)
			end
			return passed
				.. "/"
				.. runs
				.. " passed; "
				.. expiries
				.. " legal expiries; "
				.. (passed - expiries)
				.. " placed"
		end)
		log((ok and "PASS: " or "FAIL: ") .. tostring(result))
		pvpCourtPaused = false -- Always restore on success or failure.
		testLog = nil
		if dummy then
			api.removeDummy(dummy)
		end
		if player then
			player:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTesting", false)
			local r, h = root(player)
			if r then
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				pcall(function()
					r:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
				end)
			end
		end
		testRunning = false
		SSS:SetAttribute(mode, false)
		SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Success", ok)
		SSS:SetAttribute(mode .. "Result", (ok and "PASS: " or "FAIL: ") .. tostring(result))
	end)
end
-- Studio-only orchestration reuses the authoritative runners and restores RAM fixtures.
if RunService:IsStudio() then
	local baseline
	local function preparePass()
		baseline = nil
		assert(not testRunning, "another legacy test is running")
		assert(not SSS:GetAttribute("CoreLoopTest"), "another core test is running")
		assert(SSS:GetAttribute("CoreUseDataStore") ~= true, "use a fresh isolated Studio store")
		assert(core.profiles.store.volatile == true, "running store must be isolated, not just its attribute")
		assert(#Players:GetPlayers() == 1, "automated pass requires one player; add clients afterward")
		local actor = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
		assert(actor:GetAttribute("GreyboxReady"), "wait for GreyboxReady")
		local s, data = states[actor], core:data(actor)
		assert(
			s and s.phase == "Home" and not s.item and data and not data.pending and #data.pets == 0,
			"start a fresh Play session, empty-handed at Home with no pets"
		)
		baseline = { actor = actor, state = table.clone(s) }
	end
	local function resetPass()
		if not baseline then
			return
		end
		assert(#Players:GetPlayers() == 1, "a second player joined during the automated pass; restart Play")
		testRunning, testLog, pvpCourtPaused = false, nil, false
		if arena.tunnel then
			arena.tunnel.disconnect()
		end
		Arena.reset(arena)
		arena.idle, arena.hasEntrants = false, false
		local outsmartFixtures = arena.model:FindFirstChild("OutsmartFixtures")
		if outsmartFixtures then outsmartFixtures:Destroy() end
		Traps.clearIsland(traps, arena)
		for _, item in rules.items do
			item.state, item.holder = "Retired", nil
			visual(item)
		end
		table.clear(rules.items)
		rules.active, rules.respawnAt = nil, nil
		for actor in states do
			if actor ~= baseline.actor then
				api.removeDummy(actor)
			end
		end
		local actor, s = baseline.actor, states[baseline.actor]
		assert(actor.Parent and s, "test player left")
		Traps.remove(traps, actor)
		table.clear(s)
		for k, v in baseline.state do
			s[k] = v
		end
		pens[s.slot].count, pens[s.slot].occupied = 0, {}
		lastAction[actor] = nil
		actor:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTesting", false)
		for _, name in { "GreyboxLoopTest", "GreyboxPvpTest", "GreyboxTrapTest" } do
			SSS:SetAttribute(name, false)
		end
		local r, h = root(actor)
		assert(r and h and h.Health > 0, "player died; restart Play")
		h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
		r:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
		home(actor)
		arena.guardian.CFrame = CFrame.new(
			Arena.position(
				arena,
				Config.GuardianGuardOffset.x,
				Config.GuardianGuardOffset.y + 5.5,
				Config.GuardianGuardOffset.z
			)
		)
		visual(Rules.spawn(rules, nestPosition(arena)))
		if arena.attachTunnel then
			arena.attachTunnel()
		end
		refreshLoot()
		conservation()
	end
	require(SSS:WaitForChild("StudioPass")).attach({
		prepare = preparePass,
		reset = resetPass,
		start = startTest,
		keeperState = function()
			return arena.mode
		end,
	})
end

ServerScriptService.GreyboxArena:
local Pathfinding = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxConfig"))
local Layout = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxLayout"))
local Scene = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxScene"))
local Arena = {}
function Arena.fx(a, name, position, radius)
	local event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MeadowKeeper"):FindFirstChild("FXEvent")
	if event then
		event:FireAllClients(a.guardian, name, position, radius)
	end
end
local detectRange, throwRange = Config.GuardianDetectRange, Config.GuardianThrowRange
local leashRadius, stuckSeconds, returnSeconds =
	Config.GuardianLeashRadius, Config.GuardianStuckSeconds, Config.GuardianReturnSeconds
local campOffset =
	Vector3.new(Config.GuardianGuardOffset.x, Config.GuardianGuardOffset.y, -Config.GuardianGuardOffset.z)
function Arena.dashLegal(a, position)
	if Config.MeadowV4 then
		local p = position - a.origin
		if require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.TunnelPolicy).inside(p.X, p.Y, p.Z) then
			return false
		end
	end
	local camp = a.guardCamp or a.origin + campOffset
	return Vector3.new(position.X - camp.X, 0, position.Z - camp.Z).Magnitude <= leashRadius
end
local cyan, red = Color3.fromRGB(60, 210, 230), Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
local function vector(p)
	return Vector3.new(p.x, p.y, -p.z)
end
-- Map north (+local Z) points toward world -Z, keeping west on screen-left.
function Arena.position(a, x, y, z)
	return a.origin + Vector3.new(x, y, -z)
end
function Arena.build(world, layout, make, label)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name, model.Parent = "SharedIsland", world
	model:SetAttribute("Seed", layout.seed)
	model:SetAttribute("RecipeVersion", Config.RecipeVersion)
	model:SetAttribute("ArenaId", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("Difficulty", "Meadow")
	local a = {
		model = model,
		layout = layout,
		origin = Vector3.new(Config.MeadowX, Config.MeadowHeight, Config.MeadowZ),
		occupants = {},
		mode = "Guard",
		untilTime = 0,
		nextThrow = 0,
		nextPath = 0,
		points = {},
		index = 1,
		patrol = 1,
		chaseDistance = 0,
		chaseTicks = 0,
		throws = 0,
		impacts = 0,
		obstacles = {},
	}
	local chunks = {}
	for _, p in layout.pieces do
		local chunk = Instance.new("Model")
		chunk.Name, chunk.Parent = p.id, model
		chunk:SetAttribute("ChunkId", p.id)
		chunk:SetAttribute("Width", p.width)
		chunk:SetAttribute("Depth", p.depth)
		chunks[p] = chunk
		local ports = {
			{ "N", 0, p.depth / 2, 180 },
			{ "S", 0, -p.depth / 2, 0 },
			{ "E", p.width / 2, 0, -90 },
			{ "W", -p.width / 2, 0, 90 },
		}
		for _, port in ports do
			if not (p.id == "I01" and port[1] == "S") and not (p.id == "I02" and port[1] == "N") then
				local socket = Instance.new("Part")
				socket.Name, socket.Size, socket.Position =
					"Port" .. port[1], Vector3.new(12, 0.05, 1), Arena.position(a, p.x + port[2], 0, p.z + port[3])
				socket.Anchored, socket.Transparency, socket.CanCollide, socket.CanQuery, socket.Parent =
					true, 1, false, false, chunk
				local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
				attachment.Name, attachment.Orientation, attachment.Parent =
					"GroundPort", Vector3.new(0, port[4], 0), socket
				attachment:SetAttribute("Width", 12)
			end
		end
	end
	local function build(name, size, position, color, role)
		local p = make(model, name, size, Arena.position(a, position.X, position.Y, position.Z), color)
		if name ~= "IslandGround" and name ~= "RockUnderside" then
			for definition, chunk in chunks do
				if
					math.abs(position.X - definition.x) <= definition.width / 2
					and math.abs(position.Z - definition.z) <= definition.depth / 2
				then
					p.Parent = chunk
					break
				end
			end
		end
		p:SetAttribute("SurfaceRole", role or "Floor")
		if role == "Cover" then
			table.insert(a.obstacles, p)
		end
		return p
	end
	-- Tile the base around exact authored gully cutouts; no terrain/noise.
	local xs, zs = { -Config.IslandSize / 2, Config.IslandSize / 2 }, { -Config.IslandSize / 2, Config.IslandSize / 2 }
	for _, g in layout.gullies do
		table.insert(xs, g.x - g.w / 2)
		table.insert(xs, g.x + g.w / 2)
		table.insert(zs, g.z - g.d / 2)
		table.insert(zs, g.z + g.d / 2)
	end
	table.sort(xs)
	table.sort(zs)
	for i = 2, #xs do
		for j = 2, #zs do
			local x, z = (xs[i] + xs[i - 1]) / 2, (zs[j] + zs[j - 1]) / 2
			local hole = false
			for _, g in layout.gullies do
				if math.abs(x - g.x) < g.w / 2 and math.abs(z - g.z) < g.d / 2 then
					hole = true
				end
			end
			if not hole then
				build(
					"IslandGround",
					Vector3.new(xs[i] - xs[i - 1], 4, zs[j] - zs[j - 1]),
					Vector3.new(x, -2, z),
					Color3.fromRGB(115, 145, 110)
				)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, b in layout.solids do
		build(
			b.name,
			Vector3.new(b.w, b.h, b.d),
			Vector3.new(b.x, b.y, b.z),
			b.role == "Cover" and Color3.fromRGB(110, 115, 125) or nil,
			b.role
		)
	end
	for _, r in layout.ramps do
		local start, finish = vector(r.a), vector(r.b)
		local p = build(
			r.name,
			Vector3.new(r.width, 1, (finish - start).Magnitude),
			Vector3.new((start.X + finish.X) / 2, (start.Y + finish.Y) / 2, -(start.Z + finish.Z) / 2)
		)
		local forward = (finish - start).Unit
		local right = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
		p.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(a.origin + (start + finish) / 2, right, right:Cross(forward).Unit, -forward)
			* CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
	end
	for _, p in layout.pieces do
		local marker =
			build(p.id .. "Socket", Vector3.new(p.width, 0.03, p.depth), Vector3.new(p.x, 0.02, p.z), nil, "Marker")
		marker.CanCollide, marker.CanQuery, marker.Transparency = false, false, 0.93
	end
	a.safe = build("SafePadAndApron", Vector3.new(48, 0.06, 40), Vector3.new(0, 0.04, -58), cyan, "Marker")
	a.safe.CanCollide, a.safe.CanQuery = false, false
	a.safe.Transparency = 0.88
	local entryPad = build("SafeEntryPad", Vector3.new(32, 0.08, 24), Vector3.new(0, 0.08, -58), cyan, "Marker")
	entryPad.CanCollide, entryPad.CanQuery, entryPad.Transparency = false, false, 0.65
	local extension = build("SafeWestApron", Vector3.new(22, 0.06, 32), Vector3.new(-27, 0.04, -58), cyan, "Marker")
	extension.CanCollide, extension.CanQuery, extension.Transparency = false, false, 0.88
	a.dock = build("ReturnPortal", Vector3.new(10, 8, 2), Vector3.new(-24, 4, -58), cyan, "Marker")
	a.dock.CanCollide, a.dock.CanQuery = false, false
	a.dock.Transparency = 1
	label(a.dock, "CYAN = secured / home")
	a.guardian = build(
		"Guardian",
		Vector3.new(4, 11, 4),
		Vector3.new(campOffset.X, campOffset.Y + 5.5, -campOffset.Z),
		Color3.fromRGB(155, 115, 95),
		"Marker"
	)
	a.guardian.CanCollide, a.guardian.CanQuery = false, false
	a.arm = build("ThrowArm", Vector3.new(2, 6, 2), Vector3.new(11, 11, 32), nil, "Marker")
	a.arm.CanCollide, a.arm.CanQuery = false, false
	a.guardian.Transparency, a.arm.Transparency = 1, 1
	a.guardian.CanTouch, a.arm.CanTouch = false, false
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("MeadowKeeper", true)
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperClip", "idle")
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperElapsed", 0)
	a.keeper = true
	a.warning = label(a.guardian, "GUARDIAN / guarding")
	Scene.meadow(model, a.origin, layout, make)
	if Config.MeadowV4 then
		a.v4 = model:FindFirstChild("MeadowV4")
		a.safe.Position = Arena.position(a, 0, 0.04, -136)
		entryPad.Position = Arena.position(a, 0, 0.08, -136)
		extension.Transparency = 1 -- v4 has no west safe extension.
		a.dock.Position = Arena.position(a, 0, 4, -136)
		a.obstacles = {}
		for _, p in a.v4:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
				local category = p:GetAttribute("MeadowV4Category")
				if
					category == "cover"
					or category == "boulder"
					or category == "tunnel_rock"
					or category == "tunnel_roof"
					or category == "tunnel_hill"
				then
					p:SetAttribute("SurfaceRole", "Cover")
					table.insert(a.obstacles, p)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	a.params = RaycastParams.new()
	a.params.RespectCanCollide = true
	a.params.FilterType, a.params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, { model }
	a.wallParams = RaycastParams.new()
	a.wallParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	a.wallParams.FilterType, a.wallParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, a.obstacles
	-- Snapshot structural colliders only. Late cosmetic kit assemblies never enter
	-- this query, even if an imported prop accidentally keeps CanQuery enabled.
	local sightParts = {}
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide and not p:GetAttribute("Cosmetic")
			and not p:FindFirstAncestor("KitDressing") then table.insert(sightParts,p) end
	end
	a.sightParams = RaycastParams.new()
	a.sightParams.RespectCanCollide = true
	a.sightParams.FilterType, a.sightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, sightParts
	return a
end
function Arena.floor(a, position)
	-- Query near the intended surface: below tunnel roofs and bridges, above summit.
	local height = Config.MeadowV4 and position.Y + 12 or a.origin.Y + 45
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(
		Vector3.new(position.X, height, position.Z),
		Vector3.new(0, Config.MeadowV4 and -90 or -70, 0),
		a.params
	)
	if hit and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SurfaceRole") == "Floor" and hit.Normal.Y >= math.cos(math.rad(35.1)) then
		return hit.Position, hit.Normal
	end
	return nil
end
function Arena.sight(a, from, to)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, a.sightParams or a.params)
	return hit == nil, hit
end
function Arena.safe(a, position, radius)
	local p = position - a.origin
	return Layout.protected(p.X, -p.Z, radius)
end
function Arena.outside(a, position)
	local p = position - a.origin
	return p.Y < (Config.MeadowV4 and -45 or -10)
		or math.abs(p.X) > Config.IslandSize / 2 + 2
		or math.abs(p.Z) > Config.IslandSize / 2 + 2
end
local function dropFloor(a, p)
	local center, normal = Arena.floor(a, p)
	if not center or math.abs(center.Y - p.Y) >= 0.7 or Arena.safe(a, center, 3) then
		return nil
	end
	-- Same body/head and 3-stud ledge envelope as the live walk preflight.
	for ix = -6, 6 do
		for iz = -6, 6 do
			if ix * ix + iz * iz <= 36 then
				local sample = center + Vector3.new(ix * 0.5, 0, iz * 0.5)
				local floor, sampleNormal = Arena.floor(a, sample)
				local slope = (normal and normal.Y < 0.999) or (sampleNormal and sampleNormal.Y < 0.999)
				if not floor or math.abs(floor.Y - center.Y) > (slope and 2.15 or 1.5) then
					return nil
				end
				if workspace:Raycast(sample + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), a.params) then
					return nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return center
end
function Arena.rimDropSocket(a, position)
	if not a.dropPoints then
		a.dropPoints, a.dropFloors = Layout.dropPoints(a.layout), {}
	end
	local best, distance = nil, math.huge
	for i, socket in a.dropPoints do
		local p = a.origin + vector(socket)
		local d = (p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) - position).Magnitude
		if d < distance and a.dropFloors[i] ~= false then
			if a.dropFloors[i] == nil then
				a.dropFloors[i] = dropFloor(a, p) or false
			end
			if a.dropFloors[i] then
				best, distance = a.dropFloors[i], d
			end
		end
	end
	assert(best, "arena has no reachable drop floor")
	return best
end
local function laneQueries(a)
	if not a.laneParams then
		local parts = {}
		for _, p in a.v4:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Parent == a.v4 and p.CanCollide
				and p:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor") and p:GetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor") == true
				and p:GetAttribute("KitAssemblyId") == nil then
				table.insert(parts, p)
			end
		end
		a.laneParams = RaycastParams.new()
		a.laneParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		a.laneParams.RespectCanCollide = true
		a.laneParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = parts
		a.laneCenters = {}
		local routes = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.RouteData)
		a.laneGraph = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.ReachableDrops).graph(routes, Vector3, a.origin)
		for _, route in routes do
			for i = 2, #route do
				local u, v = route[i - 1], route[i]
				local from, to = Vector3.new(u.x, u.y, -u.z), Vector3.new(v.x, v.y, -v.z)
				local count = math.max(1, math.ceil((to - from).Magnitude))
				for j = 0, count do
					table.insert(a.laneCenters, a.origin + from:Lerp(to, j / count))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return function(o, d)
		return workspace:Raycast(o, d, a.laneParams)
	end
end
function Arena.dropDiagnostic(a, position, carrierFloor, label, carrierPos)
	local laneRay = laneQueries(a)
	local o, d = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0)
	local lane, solid = laneRay(o, d), workspace:Raycast(o, d, a.params)
	local function describe(h)
		if not h then return "NONE" end
		local p = h.Instance
		return string.format("%s Walkable=%s WalkableLaneFloor=%s tag=%s landingY=%.3f lane=%s",
			p:GetFullName(), tostring(p:GetAttribute("Walkable")), tostring(p:GetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor")),
			tostring(p:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor")), h.Position.Y, tostring(p:GetAttribute("LaneId")))
	end
	local function xyz(p)
		return p and {p.X, p.Y, p.Z} or "UNKNOWN"
	end
	return {
		carrierPos = xyz(carrierPos), carrierFloorY = carrierFloor and carrierFloor.Y or "UNKNOWN",
		laneId = lane and lane.Instance:GetAttribute("LaneId") or "UNKNOWN",
		landingInstance = solid and solid.Instance:GetFullName() or "NONE",
		landingY = solid and solid.Position.Y or "UNKNOWN", lootPos = xyz(position),
		recoverPath = {}, reason = label, laneSurface = describe(lane), solidSurface = describe(solid),
	}
end
function Arena.carrierFloor(a, position)
	if not Config.MeadowV4 then
		return Arena.floor(a, position)
	end
	local drops = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.ReachableDrops)
	return drops.floor(position, laneQueries(a), Vector3)
end
function Arena.dropSocket(a, position, carrierFloor)
	if not Config.MeadowV4 then
		return Arena.rimDropSocket(a, position)
	end
	local laneRay = laneQueries(a)
	local drops = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.ReachableDrops)
	local floor = carrierFloor or Arena.carrierFloor(a, position)
	if not floor then return nil, "no grounded carrier lane" end
	local point, why = drops.settle(
		position,
		floor and floor.Y or position.Y - 3,
		a.laneCenters,
		laneRay,
		function(o, d)
			return workspace:Raycast(o, d, a.params)
		end,
		Vector3,
		a.laneGraph,
		floor
	)
	if not point and not a.samplingDrops then
		a.dropFailureLogs = (a.dropFailureLogs or 0) + 1
		if a.dropFailureLogs <= 30 then
			warn("[DropDiagnostic] FAIL " .. tostring(why))
		end
	end
	if point and not a.samplingDrops then
		-- Retain the pre-displacement carrier reference without logging successes.
		a.lastDropResolution = {position=point, carrierPos=position, floor=floor, reason=why}
	end
	return point, why -- No floor means refuse the drop; never park loot on scenery.
end
local function logState(a, root)
	local state = a.attack and (a.attack.close and "Poke" or "Throw") or a.mode
	if a.loggedState == state then
		return
	end
	a.loggedState = state
	local p = a.guardian.Position - a.origin
	local r = a.target and root(a.target)
	local target = r and r.Position - a.origin
	print(
		string.format(
			"[GreyboxGuardian] state=%s pos=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) target=%s range=%.1f reason=%s",
			state,
			p.X,
			p.Y,
			p.Z,
			target and string.format("(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)", target.X, target.Y, target.Z) or "none",
			r and (r.Position - a.guardian.Position).Magnitude or -1,
			a.returnReason or "none"
		)
	)
end
local function clearPath(a)
	a.pathVersion = (a.pathVersion or 0) + 1
	a.points, a.index, a.nextPath = {}, 1, 0
end
local function returnToCamp(a, now, reason)
	a.mode, a.untilTime, a.returnReason = "Return", now + returnSeconds, reason
	a.target, a.lostTarget, a.searchAt = nil, nil, nil
	a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, a.guardian.Position
	clearPath(a)
end
local function poof(a, position, now)
	if a.poof then
		a.poof.part:Destroy()
	end
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Shape = "GuardianRecoveryPoof", Enum.PartType.Ball
	p.Size, p.CFrame = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6), CFrame.new(position)
	p.Color, p.Material = Color3.fromRGB(220, 205, 180), Enum.Material.Neon
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
	p.Transparency, p.Parent = 0.2, a.model
	a.poof = { part = p, start = now }
end
function Arena.warn(a, actor, now)
	if a.target == actor and (a.mode == "Chase" or a.mode == "Warn") then
		return -- Pickup must not restart the approach warning.
	end
	a.target, a.mode, a.untilTime, a.targetSince = actor, "Warn", now + Config.WarningSeconds, now
	a.chaseBegan = now + Config.WarningSeconds
	a.lostTarget = nil
	clearPath(a)
	a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, a.guardian.Position
end
local function attack(a, actor, position, now, close)
	local floor = Arena.floor(a, position)
	if not floor or Arena.safe(a, floor, close and 0 or Config.ThrowRadius) then
		return
	end
	a.nextThrow = now + Config.ThrowCooldown
	if not close then
		local facing = Vector3.new(floor.X, a.guardian.Position.Y, floor.Z)
		if (facing - a.guardian.Position).Magnitude > 0.1 then
			a.guardian.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a.guardian.Position, facing)
		end
	end
	a.attack = {
		actor = actor,
		position = floor,
		start = now,
		from = a.guardian.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
		close = close,
		closeRadius = Config.CatchRadius,
		previous = a.guardian.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
	}
	if not close then
		a.throws += 1
		local disc = Instance.new("Part")
		disc.Name, disc.Shape = "RedGroundDisc", Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		disc.Size, disc.CFrame =
			Vector3.new(0.08, Config.ThrowRadius * 2, Config.ThrowRadius * 2),
			CFrame.new(floor + Vector3.new(0, 0.09, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
		disc.Color, disc.Material, disc.Transparency = red, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.55
		disc.Anchored, disc.CanCollide, disc.CanQuery, disc.Parent = true, false, false, a.model
		disc:SetAttribute("TelegraphStarted", now)
		disc:SetAttribute("ImpactDue", now + Config.ThrowSeconds)
		local ring = disc:Clone()
		ring.Name, ring.Size, ring.Transparency, ring.Parent = "DiscFill", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), 0.2, a.model
		local outline = Instance.new("Folder")
		outline.Name, outline.Parent = "DiscOutline", a.model
		for i = 0, 23 do
			local angle = i * math.pi / 12
			local segmentPosition = floor
				+ Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * Config.ThrowRadius, 0.15, math.sin(angle) * Config.ThrowRadius)
			local segment = Instance.new("Part")
			segment.Size, segment.CFrame =
				Vector3.new(0.12, 0.08, 1.05),
				CFrame.lookAt(segmentPosition, segmentPosition + Vector3.new(-math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle)))
			segment.Color, segment.Material, segment.Anchored = red, Enum.Material.Neon, true
			segment.CanCollide, segment.CanQuery, segment.Parent = false, false, outline
		end
		a.attack.outline = outline
		a.attack.disc, a.attack.fill = disc, ring
		a.model:SetAttribute("TelegraphStarted", now)
	else
		a.warning.Text = "! / close poke"
		a.attack.standing = a.guardian.CFrame
		a.guardian.Size = Vector3.new(4, 6, 4)
		a.guardian.CFrame += Vector3.new(0, -2.5, 0)
	end
end
local function tick(a, dt, now, actors, root, hitPlayer, goal, loot)
	if a.tunnelGuard then
		local t = a.tunnelGuard
		if t.waiting then
			local carrier = loot and loot.holder
			local r = carrier and root(carrier)
			if
				r
				and not Arena.safe(a, r.Position)
				and (Vector3.new(r.Position.X, t.exit.Y, r.Position.Z) - t.exit).Magnitude < 12
				and math.abs(r.Position.Y - t.exit.Y) < 10
			then
				if hitPlayer(carrier, a.guardian.Position, "TunnelGuard") then
					a.keeperCelebrateUntil = now + 1.9
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end
	local guard = a.guardian
	if a.poof then
		local alpha = math.min(1, now - a.poof.start)
		a.poof.part.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6) * (1 + alpha)
		a.poof.part.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * alpha

			a.poof.part:Destroy()
			a.poof = nil
		end
	end

	local camp = a.guardCamp or nestCamp
	if loot and loot.state == "Dropped" and a.guardedVersion ~= loot.version then
		a.guardedVersion = loot.version
		local delta = loot.position - nestCamp
		local nearby = loot.position - guard.Position
		if
			Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude <= Config.GuardianDroppedGuardRadius
			or Vector3.new(nearby.X, 0, nearby.Z).Magnitude <= Config.GuardianDroppedGuardRadius
		then
			local beside = loot.position + Vector3.new(Config.GuardianGuardOffset.x, 0, 0)
			camp = Arena.floor(a, beside) or nestCamp
			a.guardCamp = camp
			if not a.attack then
				returnToCamp(a, now, "guard nearby dropped treasure")
			else
				a.returnAfterAttack = true
			end
		end
	elseif not loot or loot.state ~= "Dropped" then
		a.guardCamp, a.guardedVersion, a.returnAfterAttack = nil, nil, nil
		camp = nestCamp
	end
	if a.returnAfterAttack and not a.attack then
		a.returnAfterAttack = nil
		returnToCamp(a, now, "guard nearby dropped treasure")
	end
	logState(a, root)
	-- Windups stay planted; recovery takes priority after impact.
	if a.keeperStunUntil and now < a.keeperStunUntil then
		a.warning.Text = "STUNNED / wall hit"
		a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, guard.Position
		return
	end
	if not a.attack and not a.decoy then
		if a.progressPosition and (guard.Position - a.progressPosition).Magnitude >= Config.GuardianProgressStuds then
			a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, guard.Position
			a.recoveryStarted = nil
		end
		local flat = Vector3.new(guard.Position.X - camp.X, 0, guard.Position.Z - camp.Z)
		if a.mode ~= "Return" and flat.Magnitude > leashRadius then
			returnToCamp(a, now, "outside camp leash")
		elseif a.mode ~= "Return" and a.progressAt and now - a.progressAt >= stuckSeconds then
			returnToCamp(a, now, "navigation made no progress")
		end
		if a.mode == "Return" then
			logState(a, root)
			local home = camp + Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0)
			if (guard.Position - home).Magnitude < Config.GuardianGuardArrival then
				a.mode, a.returnReason, a.patrol = "Guard", nil, 1
				a.recoveryStarted = nil
				a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = nil, nil
				clearPath(a)
				logState(a, root)
			elseif a.progressAt and now - a.progressAt >= returnSeconds then
				if not a.recoveryStarted then
					a.recoveryStarted = now
					poof(a, guard.Position, now)
					print("[GreyboxGuardian] recovery poof / stationary >=20s / " .. tostring(a.returnReason))
				elseif now - a.recoveryStarted >= 1 then
					guard.CFrame = CFrame.new(home)
					poof(a, home, now)
					a.recoveryStarted = nil
					a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, guard.Position
					clearPath(a)
				end
				return -- Visible departure before the exceptional NPC-only relocation.
			end
		end
	end

	a.warning.TextColor3 = (a.mode == "Warn" or a.attack) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 40) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	local function visible(actor, detect)
		local s = actors[actor]
		local r = root(actor)
		if Config.MeadowV4 and r then
			local p = r.Position - a.origin
			if require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.TunnelPolicy).inside(p.X, p.Y, p.Z) then

			end
		end

			return false
		end
		local distance = (r.Position - guard.Position).Magnitude
		-- A visible carrier is actionable across the whole throw range, even after

		local range = s.item and throwRange or detectRange
		-- Upper-body sight clears small cover tops without ignoring walls/terrain.
		return (not detect or distance <= range)
			and Arena.sight(a, guard.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), r.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	end
	if a.attack then
		a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = nil, nil
		local t = a.attack
		if t.kind then
			local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MeadowKeeper")
			require(folder:WaitForChild("Attacks")).step(
				a,
				now,
				actors,
				root,
				hitPlayer,
				Arena,
				require(folder:WaitForChild("Pose"))
			)
			return
		end
		local alpha = math.min(1, (now - t.start) / Config.ThrowSeconds)
		-- Lock aim at attack creation; spawn exactly once on the authored Release.
		if not t.close and not t.rock and now - t.start >= 0.620 then

			rock.Name, rock.Size, rock.Position = "ThrownRock", Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), t.from
			rock.Anchored, rock.CanCollide, rock.CanQuery, rock.CanTouch, rock.Parent =

		if t.fill then

			-- Keep the original impact deadline; remaining flight follows release.
			local flight = math.clamp((now - t.start - 0.620) / (Config.ThrowSeconds - 0.620), 0, 1)

				+ Vector3.new(0, 40 * flight * (1 - flight), 0)

			-- Floor at the locked destination is an impact; other geometry intercepts.
			if obstruction and (obstruction.Position - t.position).Magnitude > 2 then

							or (

								and (r.Position - guard.Position).Magnitude <= t.closeRadius
								and Arena.sight(a, guard.Position, r.Position)

						if
							distance <= (t.close and t.closeRadius or Config.ThrowRadius)
							and Arena.sight(a, t.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), r.Position)
							and closeLegal

				end

		return -- Plant feet; never overlap windups.
	end

	end

		a.target, a.mode, a.untilTime = nil, "Search", now + Config.GuardianSearchSeconds
		a.searchAt = a.lastSeen

		and a.mode ~= "Return"
		and (not a.target or now - (a.targetSince or 0) >= Config.GuardianTargetLockSeconds)

			if visible(actor, actor ~= a.target and actor ~= a.lostTarget) then

				if score < best then
					candidate, best = actor, score

		or (a.mode == "Warn" and "!" or (a.mode == "Search" and "?" or "GUARDIAN / " .. a.mode))
	if a.mode == "Warn" then
		if target then
			local r = root(target)
			local towards = Vector3.new(r.Position.X, guard.Position.Y, r.Position.Z)

		destination = r.Position

		if now >= s.mercy and now >= a.nextThrow then
			if a.keeper then
				local kit =
					require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MeadowKeeper"):WaitForChild("Attacks"))

				if kind then
					local velocity = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
					local leadSeconds = kind == "lob" and kit.Tuning.LobLeadSeconds or kit.Tuning.FanLeadSeconds
					local leadMax = kind == "lob" and kit.Tuning.LobLeadMax or kit.Tuning.FanLeadMax
					local lead = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z) * leadSeconds
					if lead.Magnitude > leadMax then

					end

					if not Arena.floor(a, predicted) then

					end
				end
			else

					local velocity = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
					local lead = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z) * Config.GuardianLeadSeconds
					if lead.Magnitude > Config.GuardianLeadMaxStuds then

					end

					if not Arena.floor(a, predicted) or Arena.safe(a, predicted, Config.ThrowRadius) then
						predicted = r.Position
					end

				end

				if
					horizontal <= Config.CatchRadius
					and math.abs(r.Position.Y - (guard.Position.Y - 2.5)) <= Config.GuardianPokeVertical

				end

		end
	elseif a.mode == "Return" then
		destination = camp
	elseif a.mode == "Search" then
		destination = a.searchAt
	else
		destination = camp
		if (guard.Position - camp - Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0)).Magnitude < Config.GuardianGuardArrival then
			a.mode, a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = "Guard", nil, nil
			return
		end
	end
	if not destination then
		return
	end
	a.progressAt = a.progressAt or now
	a.progressPosition = a.progressPosition or guard.Position
	if (guard.Position - a.progressPosition).Magnitude >= Config.GuardianProgressStuds then
		a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = now, guard.Position
	end
