		a.nextPath, a.computing = now + Config.GuardianPathRefreshSeconds, true
		local requested, version = destination, a.pathVersion or 0
		task.spawn(function()
			local path
			local ok = pcall(function()
				path = Pathfinding:CreatePath({
					AgentRadius = 2,
					AgentHeight = 11,
					AgentCanJump = false,
					WaypointSpacing = 3,
				})
				path:ComputeAsync(guard.Position - Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0), requested)
			end)
			if a.model.Parent and version == (a.pathVersion or 0) and ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
				a.points, a.index = path:GetWaypoints(), 2
			end
			if path then
				path:Destroy()
			end
			a.computing = false
		end)
	end
	local waypoint = a.points[a.index]
	if not waypoint then
		return
	end
	local offset = Vector3.new(waypoint.Position.X - guard.Position.X, 0, waypoint.Position.Z - guard.Position.Z)
	if offset.Magnitude < 0.5 then
		a.index += 1
		return
	end
	local speed = Config.GuardianReturnSpeed
	if a.mode == "Chase" then
		local burst = (now - (a.chaseBegan or now)) % Config.GuardianBurstCooldown < Config.GuardianBurstSeconds
		speed = burst and Config.GuardianBurstSpeed or Config.GuardianSpeed
		a.warning.Text = burst and "GUARDIAN / BURST!" or "GUARDIAN / Chase"
	end
	local movement = offset.Unit * math.min(offset.Magnitude, speed * dt)
	local nextPoint = guard.Position + movement
	if Config.MeadowV4 then
		local p = nextPoint - a.origin - Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0)
		if require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.TunnelPolicy).inside(p.X, math.max(0, p.Y), p.Z) then
			a.points, a.nextPath = {}, 0
			return
		end
	end
	local floor = Arena.floor(a, nextPoint)
	local blocked = workspace:Blockcast(guard.CFrame, Vector3.new(4, 10, 4), movement, a.wallParams)
	if
		floor
		and not blocked
		and not Arena.safe(a, floor)
		and (a.mode == "Return" or Vector3.new(floor.X - camp.X, 0, floor.Z - camp.Z).Magnitude <= leashRadius)
		and math.abs(floor.Y - (guard.Position.Y - 5.5)) <= movement.Magnitude * math.tan(math.rad(35)) + 0.25
	then
		local position = floor + Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0)
		guard.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + movement)
		if a.mode == "Chase" then
			a.chaseDistance += movement.Magnitude
		end
	else
		a.points, a.nextPath = {}, 0
	end
end
function Arena.tick(a, dt, now, actors, root, hitPlayer, goal, loot)
	local before = a.guardian.Position
	tick(a, dt, now, actors, root, hitPlayer, goal, loot)
	if not a.keeper then
		return
	end
	local moved = (a.guardian.Position - before).Magnitude > 0.001
	local clip = "idle"
	if a.attack then
		clip = a.attack.kind or (a.attack.close and "warn" or "throw")
	elseif a.recoveryStarted or a.mode == "Stun" or a.keeperStunUntil and now < a.keeperStunUntil then
		clip = "stun"
	elseif a.mode == "Warn" or a.mode == "DecoyTell" then
		clip = "warn"
	elseif a.mode == "Return" then
		clip = "return"
	elseif a.keeperCelebrateUntil and now < a.keeperCelebrateUntil or a.mode == "Celebrate" then
		clip = "celebrate"
	elseif a.keeperClip == "throw" and now - a.keeperClipStart < 1.4 then
		clip = "throw"
	elseif a.mode == "Chase" then
		clip = "chase"
	elseif moved or a.mode == "Patrol" then
		clip = "patrol"
	end
	local attackStart = a.attack and a.attack.start
	if clip ~= a.keeperClip or attackStart and attackStart ~= a.keeperAttackStart then
		a.keeperClip, a.keeperClipStart, a.keeperAttackStart = clip, attackStart or now, attackStart
		a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperClip", clip)
		if workspace.GetServerTimeNow then
			a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperStartedAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (now - a.keeperClipStart))
		end
	end
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperElapsed", math.max(0, now - a.keeperClipStart))
	local targetRoot = a.target and root(a.target)
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperLookTarget", a.decoy and a.decoy.position or targetRoot and targetRoot.Position or nil)
	a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperAttention", a.decoy and a.mode or "")
end
function Arena.reset(a)
	a.tunnelGeneration = (a.tunnelGeneration or 0) + 1
	a.tunnelGuard = nil
	if Config.MeadowV4 then
		workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardWaiting", false)
	end
	a.decoy = nil
	if a.poof then
		a.poof.part:Destroy()
		a.poof = nil
	end
	a.recoveryStarted = nil
	if a.attack then
		for _, name in { "disc", "fill", "rock", "outline" } do
			if a.attack[name] then
				a.attack[name]:Destroy()
			end
		end
		if a.attack.parts then
			for _, part in ipairs(a.attack.parts) do
				part:Destroy()
			end
		end
		if a.attack.standing then
			a.guardian.Size, a.guardian.CFrame = Vector3.new(4, 11, 4), a.attack.standing
		end
	end
	a.attack, a.target, a.lostTarget, a.searchAt, a.lastSeen = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	a.mode, a.patrol, a.nextThrow = "Guard", 1, 0
	a.kitCooldowns = nil
	a.keeperStunUntil = nil
	if a.keeper then
		Arena.fx(a, "Reset", a.guardian.Position)
	end
	a.keeperClip, a.keeperClipStart, a.keeperAttackStart, a.keeperCelebrateUntil = nil, nil, nil, nil
	if a.keeper then
		a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperClip", "idle")
		a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperElapsed", 0)
		a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperStartedAt", nil)
		a.guardian:SetAttribute("KeeperLookTarget", nil)
	end
	a.progressAt, a.progressPosition = nil, nil
	clearPath(a)
end
-- Adapter called once per entrant/exit/occupancy epoch. Live rig follows this handle.
function Arena.intercept(a, exitId, path, holdSeconds, entrant, _epoch)
	Arena.reset(a)
	local token = a.tunnelGeneration
	local t = { waiting = false }
	a.tunnelGuard = t
	a.mode = "TunnelIntercept"
	local function valid()
		return a.model.Parent and a.tunnelGeneration == token and a.tunnelGuard == t
	end
	local function cleanup()
		if not valid() then
			return
		end
		a.tunnelGuard = nil
		a.target = nil
		a.mode = "Guard"
		a.progressAt = nil
		clearPath(a)
		workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardWaiting", false)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		for i, p in path do
			local start = a.guardian.Position
			local target = a.origin + Vector3.new(p.x, 5.5, p.z)
			local seconds = i == 1 and 0.8 or (target - start).Magnitude / 32
			local elapsed = 0
			while elapsed < seconds do
				elapsed += game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
				if not valid() then
					return
				end
				local alpha = math.min(elapsed / math.max(seconds, 0.05), 1)
				local pos = start:Lerp(target, alpha)
				if i == 1 then
					pos += Vector3.new(0, math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * 18, 0)
				end
				local forward = Vector3.new(target.X - start.X, 0, target.Z - start.Z)
				a.guardian.CFrame = forward.Magnitude > 0.01 and CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + forward)
					or CFrame.new(pos) * a.guardian.CFrame.Rotation
			end
		end
		if not valid() then
			return
		end
		local e = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.TunnelPolicy).Exits[exitId]
		t.exit = a.origin + Vector3.new(e.x, 0, e.z)
		t.waiting = true
		workspace:SetAttribute("TunnelGuardWaiting", true)
		local deadline = os.clock() + 14
		local left = false
		while valid() and os.clock() < deadline do
			if not left and (not entrant.Parent or entrant:GetAttribute("TunnelInside") ~= true) then
				left = true
				deadline = math.min(deadline, os.clock() + holdSeconds)
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		cleanup()
	end)
	return cleanup
end
return Arena

local Placement = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxPlacement"))
local Clearance = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MeadowV4"):WaitForChild("Clearance"))
local function at(arena, x, y, z)
	return (arena and arena.origin or Vector3.zero) + Vector3.new(x, y + 3, arena and -z or z)
end
-- Resolve against real collidable geometry; never target guessed root heights.
local function validator(world, log)
	local function resolve(position, edge, radius)
		radius = radius or 3
		local parts = {}
		for _, p in world:GetDescendants() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Anchored and p.CanCollide then
				table.insert(parts, p)
			end
		end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, parts
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		return Clearance.resolve(position, edge, radius, function(origin, direction)
			return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
		end, Config.MeadowV4, Vector3)
	end
	local function checked(position, name, edge, radius)
		local ok, result = pcall(resolve, position, edge, radius)
		if not ok then
			log("BAD WAYPOINT " .. name .. " at " .. tostring(position) .. ": " .. tostring(result))
		end
		assert(ok, "bad waypoint " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(result))
		return result
	end
	local function preflight(points)
		local bad = 0
		for i, p in points do
			if i % 8 == 0 then
				task.wait() -- Yield so long routes cannot trip Roblox's script timeout.
			end
			local ok, reason = pcall(resolve, p.position, p.edge)
			if not ok then
				bad += 1
				log("BAD WAYPOINT " .. p.name .. " at " .. tostring(p.position) .. ": " .. tostring(reason))
			end
		end
		assert(bad == 0, "waypoint preflight: " .. bad .. " bad points")
		log("waypoint preflight PASS " .. #points .. " points / 3-stud clearance")
	end
	return checked, preflight
end

local function approachRecorder(actor, api, world, item)
	local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local started = os.clock()
	local data = { status = "approaching", waypoints = {}, paths = {}, stuck = {}, samples = {}, blockingInstances = {}, legs = {}, phases = {} }
	local activeLeg, activePhase
	local function xyz(p) return { p.X, p.Y, p.Z } end
	local function push(list, value, limit)
		table.insert(list, value)
		if #list > limit then table.remove(list, 1) end
	end
	local function record(event, goal, name, detail, observedActor)
		local now = os.clock()
		local root, humanoid = api.root(observedActor or actor)
		data.elapsed = now - started
		data.cargoElapsed = now - (item.firstPickup or started)
		data.remaining = item.escapeDeadline - now
		if activeLeg then activeLeg.seconds = now-activeLeg.started;activeLeg.remaining = data.remaining end
		if activePhase then activePhase.seconds = now-activePhase.started;activePhase.remaining = data.remaining end
		if event == "waypoint" then
			if activeLeg then activeLeg.status = "superseded" end
			activeLeg = { name = name, started = now, elapsed = data.elapsed, seconds = 0, remaining = data.remaining, status = "walking" }
			push(data.legs, activeLeg, 256)
		elseif event == "arrived" or event == "interrupted" or event == "failed" or event == "complete" then
			if activeLeg then activeLeg.status = event;activeLeg = nil end
		end
		if event == "phase" then
			if activePhase then activePhase.status = "complete" end
			activePhase = { name = name, started = now, elapsed = data.elapsed, seconds = 0, remaining = data.remaining, status = "running" }
			push(data.phases, activePhase, 16)
		elseif event == "failed" or event == "secured" then
			if activePhase then activePhase.status = event;activePhase = nil end
		end
		data.itemId, data.itemState = item.id, item.state
		data.event, data.goalName = event, name
		if detail then data.detail = detail end
		if root then
			data.position = xyz(root.Position)
			local snapshot = { time = data.elapsed, position = data.position, goal = goal and xyz(goal), name = name }
			if event == "waypoint" then push(data.waypoints, snapshot, 128)
			elseif event == "stuck" then push(data.stuck, snapshot, 32)
			elseif event == "sample" then push(data.samples, snapshot, 64) end
			if event == "path" then push(data.paths, { time = data.elapsed, points = detail }, 16) end
			data.walkSpeed, data.floorMaterial = humanoid.WalkSpeed, tostring(humanoid.FloorMaterial)
			-- Probe the body corridor and nearby colliders, retaining full instance paths.
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, { (observedActor or actor).Character }
			params.RespectCanCollide = true
			local function blocker(part)
				local key = part:GetFullName()
				if not data.blockingInstances[key] then
					local count = 0
					for _ in data.blockingInstances do count += 1 end
					if count >= 64 then return end
				end
				data.blockingInstances[key] = { time = data.elapsed, position = xyz(part.Position), size = xyz(part.Size),
					collidable = part.CanCollide, category = part:GetAttribute("MeadowV4Category"), section = part:GetAttribute("Section") }
			end
			if goal then
				local delta = Vector3.new(goal.X-root.Position.X, 0, goal.Z-root.Position.Z)
				if delta.Magnitude > .01 then
					for _, height in { -1.5, 0, 1.5 } do
						local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0,height,0), delta.Unit*math.min(8,delta.Magnitude), params)
						if hit then blocker(hit.Instance) end
					end
				end
			end
			if event == "stuck" then
				local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
				overlap.FilterType, overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, { (observedActor or actor).Character }
				overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
				for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(root.CFrame, Vector3.new(7,4,7), overlap) do blocker(part) end
			end
		end
		if event == "complete" then data.approachSeconds = data.elapsed end
		if event == "phase" then data.status = name end
		if event == "complete" or event == "failed" or event == "secured" then data.status = event end
		local json = http:JSONEncode(data)
		SSS:SetAttribute("PvpTestLastApproach", json)
		world:SetAttribute("PvpTestLastApproach", json)
	end
	record("start")
	return record
end
local function driver(actor, states, api, log, checked, monitor, approach)
	local character = actor.Character
	local r, h = api.root(actor)
	assert(r and h, "character missing")
	r:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	local function walk(position, name, jump, autoReturn, takeoff, runup, edgeGoal, radius, arrivalLine, navigation)
		if not navigation then
			position = checked(position, name, edgeGoal, radius)
		end
		if takeoff then
			takeoff = checked(takeoff, "takeoff " .. name, true)
		end
		if runup then
			local reached, reason = walk(runup, "straight run-up " .. name, false, false, nil, nil, true, nil, true)
			if not reached then
				return false, reason
			end
		end
		log((jump and "Jump " or "Walk ") .. name)
		if approach then approach("waypoint", position, name) end
		local started, progressed, best, nextLog = os.clock(), os.clock(), 0, 0

				if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
					h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
					return "expiry"
				end
				if cargo and states[actor].phase == "Run" and states[actor].item ~= cargo then
					h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
					return "drop"
				end
			end
			if monitor and monitor.item and os.clock() < (states[actor].slowUntil or 0) then
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				return "stumble"
			end
		end
		if jump then
			while os.clock() < (states[actor].slowUntil or 0) or h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air do
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				local reason = interruption()
				if reason then
					return false, reason
				end
				if navigation and (navigation.blocked or os.clock() - started >= 3) then
					return false, "recompute"
				end
				assert(os.clock() - started < 3, "jump readiness >3s: " .. name)
				task.wait(0.03)
			end
		end
		-- One command per segment. Run-ups cross a line rather than braking at a point.
		local origin = r.Position
		local segment = Vector3.new(position.X - origin.X, 0, position.Z - origin.Z)
		local length = segment.Magnitude
		local routeDirection = length > 0.001 and segment.Unit or Vector3.zero
		local movementGoal = arrivalLine and position + routeDirection * 3 or position
		local commanded = false
		local launchDirection = takeoff and Vector3.new(position.X - takeoff.X, 0, position.Z - takeoff.Z).Unit
		while true do
			assert(actor.Character == character and h.Health > 0, "character lost")
			api.audit()

				if approach then approach("interrupted", position, name, reason) end
				return false, reason
			end
			if os.clock() < (states[actor].slowUntil or 0) then
				started, progressed = os.clock(), os.clock()
				task.wait(0.03)
				continue
			end
			if autoReturn and cargo and not states[actor].item and states[actor].phase == "Run" then
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				log("return interrupted by legal drop / recover before crossing cyan")
				return false
			end
			if (autoReturn or (monitor and monitor.item)) and expected ~= nil and states[actor].phase == "Home" then
				local secured = monitor and monitor.item or cargo
				assert(
					secured
						and states[actor].item == secured
						and secured.state == "Secured"
						and secured.holder == actor
						and secured.securedAt < secured.escapeDeadline,
					"automatic return lost cargo or missed deadline"
				)
				log("legal automatic secure / " .. secured.id .. " / " .. name)
				break
			end
			assert(states[actor].run == expected, "unexpected arena reset/return")
			local now = os.clock()
			if navigation and (navigation.blocked or now - progressed >= 3) then
				if approach then approach("stuck", position, name, navigation.blocked and "path blocked" or "no progress") end
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				return false, "recompute"
			end
			if jump and takeoff and r.Position.Y < math.min(takeoff.Y, position.Y) - 2 then
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				log("missed jump / climb-out and walking bypass " .. name)
				return false, "missed jump"
			end
			if h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
				airborne = true
			elseif airborne then
				landed = true
			end
			local delta = position - r.Position
			local horizontal = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
			local along = Vector3.new(r.Position.X - origin.X, 0, r.Position.Z - origin.Z):Dot(routeDirection)
			local passed = along >= length
			local arrived = passed or (not arrivalLine and horizontal <= 3)
			if
				not autoReturn -- Return legs finish only after the production boundary handler secures cargo.
				and arrived
				-- Loot recovery goals sit on the acorn, which stands ~2.5 studs off its floor.
				and math.abs(delta.Y) < (name:find("^recover") and 4.5 or 2)
				and h.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
				and (not jump or (launched and landed))
			then
				break
			end
			if along > best + 0.2 then
				best, progressed = along, now
			end
			if not navigation and (monitor or api.arena) and now - progressed >= 3 then
				if approach then approach("stuck", position, name, "no progress") end
				return false, "displaced"
			end
			assert(now - progressed <= 8, "stuck >8s at " .. name)
			assert(now - started <= 30, "waypoint >30s at " .. name)
			if now >= nextLog then
				if approach then approach("sample", position, name) end
				log(
					string.format(
						"progress %s goal=%s horizontal=%.2f route=%.2f/%.2f noProgress=%.2fs",
						name,
						tostring(position),
						horizontal,
						along,
						length,

				)

			end
			if not commanded then
				h:MoveTo(movementGoal)

			end
			if jump and not launched then
				local toEdge = takeoff and takeoff - r.Position or Vector3.zero
				local remaining = launchDirection and toEdge:Dot(launchDirection) or 0
				if remaining <= 0 then
					assert(h.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air, "jump takeoff not grounded: " .. name)
					assert(now >= (states[actor].slowUntil or 0), "jump takeoff during stumble: " .. name)
					h.Jump = true

					launched = true
					log("takeoff " .. name)
				end
			end

		end

		log("arrived " .. name)
		if approach then approach("arrived", position, name) end

			assert(airborne and landed, "no takeoff/landing")

	local function navigate(position, name, autoReturn)

				and item.state ~= "Secured"
				and item.state ~= "Placed"
				and (item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline)
			then
				return false, "expiry"
			end
			if os.clock() - started >= 30 then
				updateDrop({reason="path recovery >30s: " .. name})
				error("path recovery >30s: " .. name)
			end
			local path = game:GetService("PathfindingService"):CreatePath({
				AgentRadius = 2,
				AgentHeight = 5,
				AgentCanJump = true,
				WaypointSpacing = 4,
				Costs = { JumpGully = 20 },
			})
			local computed, problem = pcall(function()
				path:ComputeAsync(r.Position, position)
			end)
			if not computed or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
				if approach then approach("stuck", position, name, tostring(problem or path.Status)) end
				updateDrop({recoverPath={}, reason="path retry: " .. tostring(problem or path.Status)})
				log("path retry from live position / " .. name .. " / " .. tostring(problem or path.Status))
				path:Destroy()
				task.wait(0.2)
				continue
			end
			local navigation = { blocked = false, index = 2 }
			local connection = path.Blocked:Connect(function(index)
				if index >= navigation.index then
					navigation.blocked = true
				end
			end)
			local reached, reason = true, nil
			local ok, followProblem = pcall(function()
				local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
				local points = {}
				for _, waypoint in waypoints do
					table.insert(points, {position={waypoint.Position.X, waypoint.Position.Y, waypoint.Position.Z}, action=tostring(waypoint.Action)})
				end
				updateDrop({recoverPath=points, reason="following path: " .. name})
				if approach then approach("path", position, name, points) end
				for i = 2, #waypoints do
					local waypoint = waypoints[i]
					navigation.index = i
					-- Navmesh positions are floor points, not authored clearance markers.
					reached, reason = walk(
						waypoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
						name .. " path " .. i,
						waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump,
						false,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						nil,
						navigation
					)
					if not reached or states[actor].phase == "Home" then
						return
					end
				end
				if autoReturn and states[actor].phase ~= "Home" then
					reached, reason =
						walk(position, name .. " secure boundary", false, true, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, navigation)
				end
			end)
			connection:Disconnect()
			path:Destroy()
			assert(ok, followProblem)
			if reached or reason ~= "recompute" then
				return reached, reason
			end
			log("recompute from live position / " .. name)
		end
	end
	local function routeWalk(position, name, jump, autoReturn, takeoff, runup, edgeGoal, radius, arrivalLine)
		local reached, reason = walk(position, name, jump, autoReturn, takeoff, runup, edgeGoal, radius, arrivalLine)
		if not monitor and api.arena and not reached and (reason == "displaced" or reason == "missed jump") then
			return navigate(position, "recover to next goal " .. name, autoReturn)
		end

	end

local function act(api, actor, name, ...)
	local ok, why = api[name](actor, ...)
	assert(ok, "illegal refusal " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(why))
end
local function hold(api, actor, action)
	local _, humanoid = api.root(actor)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
	end
	for attempt = 1, Config.TestHoldRetries do
		act(api, actor, "holdAction", action, "begin")
		task.wait(Config.HoldSeconds[action] + 0.05)
		local ok, why = api.holdAction(actor, action, "finish")
		api.audit()
		if ok then
			return
		end
		assert(action ~= "Bump" and why == "missing/short hold", "illegal hold refusal: " .. tostring(why))
		assert(attempt < Config.TestHoldRetries, "hold repeatedly interrupted by guardian")
	end
end
local function recoveryPoint(checked, item)
	-- Production drops already require this clearance. Retain nearby recovery
	-- candidates so the test independently checks the actual settled position.
	for _, offset in
		{
			Vector3.zero,
			Vector3.new(2, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(-2, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, 0, 2),
			Vector3.new(0, 0, -2),
		}
	do
		local ok, position = pcall(checked, item.position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) + offset, "recover " .. item.id)
		if ok then
			return position
		end
	end
	error("no standable Grab point for " .. item.id)
end
local function closeToDummy(api, walk, player, dummy)
	local closeDeadline = os.clock() + 8
	while true do
		local pr, dr = api.root(player), api.root(dummy)
		if (pr.Position - dr.Position).Magnitude <= 3 then
			return pr, dr
		end
		assert(os.clock() < closeDeadline, "cannot close to live dummy within 3 studs >8s")
		local floor = assert(api.floor(dr.Position), "dummy court floor missing")
		walk(floor + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "close to live dummy within 3 studs")
	end
end
local function recoverAttempt(api, actor, states, walk, item, log, checked)
	local _, humanoid = api.root(actor)
	humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
	while os.clock() < (states[actor].slowUntil or 0) do
		api.audit()
		if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
			return false, "expiry"
		end
		task.wait(0.03)
	end
	if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
		return false, "expiry"
	end
	if states[actor].item == item then
		return true
	end
	assert(
		states[actor].phase == "Run" and api.rules.active == item and item.state == "Dropped",
		"loot lost/taken before recovery"
	)
	local timestamp, escapeDeadline = item.firstPickup, item.escapeDeadline
	log("legal drop / recover " .. item.id)
	local attempt = 0
	while states[actor].item ~= item do
		attempt += 1
		if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
			return false, "expiry"
		end
		local reached, reason = walk(recoveryPoint(checked, item), "recover same dropped loot")
		if not reached then
			if reason == "expiry" then
				return false, reason
			end
			task.wait(math.max(0, (states[actor].slowUntil or 0) - os.clock()) + 0.03)
			continue
		end
		task.wait(math.max(0, item.settle - os.clock()) + 0.03)
		if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
			return false, "expiry"
		end
		local ok, why = api.holdAction(actor, "Grab", "begin")
		if ok then
			task.wait(Config.HoldSeconds.Grab + 0.05)
			ok, why = api.holdAction(actor, "Grab", "finish")
		end
		api.audit()
		if ok then
			break
		end
		if item.state == "Retired" or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
			return false, "expiry"
		end
		assert(api.rules.active == item and item.state == "Dropped", "recovery loot lost/taken")
		log("recovery interrupted / retry " .. attempt .. " / " .. tostring(why))
	end
	assert(
		states[actor].item == item and item.firstPickup == timestamp and item.escapeDeadline == escapeDeadline,
		"recovery identity/timestamp changed"
	)
	api.audit()
	return true
end
local function recover(api, actor, states, walk, item, log, checked)
	local lastPosition = item.position or (item.visual and item.visual.Position)
	local result = table.pack(pcall(recoverAttempt, api, actor, states, walk, item, log, checked))
	if not result[1] or result[2] == false then
		local position = item.position or (item.visual and item.visual.Position) or lastPosition
		if not position then
			local ok, drop = pcall(function()
				return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestLastDrop") or "{}")
			end)
			local p = ok and type(drop) == "table" and drop.lootPos
			if type(p) == "table" and type(p[1]) == "number" and type(p[2]) == "number" and type(p[3]) == "number" then
				position = Vector3.new(p[1], p[2], p[3])
			end
		end
		local reason = tostring(if result[1] then result[3] else result[2])
		local fields = {reason=reason, lootId=item.id, lootState=item.state}
		if position then fields.lootPos = {position.X, position.Y, position.Z} end
		-- Without a current position retain production's last-drop coordinates.
		updateDrop(fields)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = actor.Character and {actor.Character} or {}
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		local h = position and workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), params)
		local p = h and h.Instance
		log("RECOVER FAILURE reason=" .. reason .. " state=" .. tostring(item.state) .. " underLoot=" .. (p and p:GetFullName() or "NONE")
			.. " landingY=" .. tostring(h and h.Position.Y) .. " Walkable=" .. tostring(p and p:GetAttribute("Walkable"))
			.. " WalkableLaneFloor=" .. tostring(p and p:GetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor"))
			.. " tag=" .. tostring(p and p:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor")) .. " lane=" .. tostring(p and p:GetAttribute("LaneId")))
	end
	if result[1] and result[2] ~= false then
		updateDrop({reason="recovered same loot"})
	end
	if not result[1] then
		error(result[2], 0)
	end
	return table.unpack(result, 2, result.n)
end
-- Live production expiry: no shortened clock, immunity, teleport or synthetic award.
local function verifyExpiry(player, states, pens, world, api, log, item, count, completed)
	local s = states[player]
	local deadline = item.escapeDeadline
	assert(math.abs(deadline - item.firstPickup - Config.EscapeSeconds) < 0.001, "deadline start")
	while os.clock() < deadline + 0.15 do
		api.audit()
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	assert(item.state == "Retired" and not item.holder and not item.visual and not item.weld, "expiry orphan cargo")
	assert(not s.item and not api.rules.active, "expiry duplicate active/holder")
	for _, actorState in states do
		assert(not actorState.hold or actorState.hold.item ~= item, "expiry orphan hold")
	end
	assert(s.completed == completed and pens[s.slot].count == count, "expiry awarded")
	assert(not api.placeItem(player, s.slot), "expired placement accepted")
	assert(not api.holdAction(player, "Grab", "begin"), "expired Grab accepted")
	assert(world:GetAttribute("EscapeDeadline") == nil, "stale shared clock")
	local waitUntil = os.clock() + Config.RespawnSeconds + 2
	while not api.rules.active do
		assert(os.clock() < waitUntil, "expiry refill missing")
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	local replacement = api.rules.active
	assert(
		replacement.id ~= item.id and replacement.state == "Nest" and not replacement.escapeDeadline,
		"expiry reused ID/clock"
	)
	assert(api.rules.respawnAt >= deadline + Config.RespawnSeconds, "early refill")
	api.audit()
	local originals, replacements = 0, 0
	for _, p in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			if p:GetAttribute("LootId") == item.id then
				originals += 1
			end
			if p:GetAttribute("LootId") == replacement.id then
				replacements += 1
			end
		end
	end
	assert(originals == 0 and replacements == 1, "expiry physical duplicate")
	log("expiry PASS / retired " .. item.id .. " / fresh " .. replacement.id .. " / no award or duplicate")
	return replacement
end
local function expiryExitSteps()

		return Layout.loopCarrySteps()
	end
	return {

		{ x = -4, y = 8, z = 18 },
		{ x = -4, y = 8, z = 12 },
		{ x = -4, y = 0, z = 0 },

local function returnPortal(player, states, api, log, navigate, item)
	local s = states[player]
	if s.phase == "Run" then
		local dock = api.arena().dock
		local floor = assert(api.floor(dock.Position), "return portal floor missing")
		local reached, reason = navigate(floor + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "return portal", item ~= nil)
		if not reached then
			return false, reason
		end
	end
	if s.phase == "Run" then
		assert(api.returnInRange(player), "return portal approach outside action range")
		act(api, player, "returnRun")
	end
	assert(s.phase == "Home" and s.run == nil, "return did not reach Home")
	if item then
		assert(
			s.item == item
				and item.holder == player
				and item.state == "Secured"
				and item.securedAt < item.escapeDeadline,
			"return lost cargo or missed deadline"
		)
	else
		assert(not s.item, "empty return gained cargo")
	end
	api.audit()
	log(item and "return conserved " .. item.id or "empty return conserved")
	return true
end

local function place(player, states, pens, api, walk, log, item, initialCount)
	local s = states[player]
	assert(s.phase == "Home" and s.item == item and item.state == "Secured", "return lost loot")
	assert(not api.returnRun(player), "duplicate return accepted")
	local pen = pens[s.slot]
	local side = pen.marker.Position.X < 0 and -1 or 1
	-- Secure return is already at this plot's gate. Pick a legal free point,
	-- rather than treating the logical active count as a pad index.
	local cx, cz = Placement.center(s.slot)
	local floorY = Placement.height(s.slot) + 0.2
	local position
	for dz = -14, 14, 7 do
		for dx = -22, 22, 7 do
			local x, z = cx + dx, cz + dz
			if Placement.validate(Config, s.slot, x, z, 15, pen.occupied) then
				position = Vector3.new(x, floorY, z)
				break
			end
		end
		if position then
			break
		end
	end
	assert(position, "no free plot point")
	walk(Vector3.new(side * 1.4, 3, cz), "plot stairs approach")
	for step = 1, math.ceil(Placement.height(s.slot) / 0.5) do
		walk(
			Vector3.new(side * (1.4 + step * 0.9), 3 + math.min(step * 0.5, Placement.height(s.slot)), cz),
			"plot stair"
		)
	end
	walk(Vector3.new(side * 22, floorY + 3, cz), "own plot gate")
	walk(Vector3.new(position.X, floorY + 3, position.Z), "free plot point")
	assert(not api.placeItem(player, s.slot, Vector3.new(cx + 40, floorY, cz), 15), "out-of-bounds accepted")
	-- Reserve a fixture footprint while secured to test overlap before mutation.
	table.insert(pen.occupied, { x = position.X, z = position.Z, extent = 2 })
	assert(not api.placeItem(player, s.slot, position, 15), "overlap accepted")
	table.remove(pen.occupied)
	assert(s.item == item and item.state == "Secured" and pen.count == initialCount, "rejected Place consumed cargo")
	act(api, player, "placeItem", s.slot, position, 15)
	assert(not api.placeItem(player, s.slot, position, 15), "duplicate place accepted")
	assert(item.position == position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) and item.rotation == 15, "chosen transform lost")
	assert(not s.item and item.state == "Placed" and pen.count == initialCount + 1, "placement loss/duplication")
	local count = 0
	for _, p in workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("LootId") == item.id then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	assert(count == 1, "physical loot duplication/loss: " .. count)
	api.audit()
	log("conserved " .. item.id .. " / exactly one placed block")
	-- Retrace the placement approach through the open gate before the next
	-- loop tries to enter the hub aisle from inside a fenced plot.
	walk(Vector3.new(pen.marker.Position.X - side * 5, 3, cz), "leave placed plot through gate")
end
-- Harness-only traversal costs; leave collision and production rules untouched.
local function recoveryCosts(world)
	for _, part in world:GetDescendants() do
		if
			part:IsA("BasePart")
			and (part.Name == "RecoveryFloor" or part.Name:match("^Stone%d"))
			and not part:FindFirstChild("RecoveryPathCost")
		then
			local modifier = Instance.new("PathfindingModifier")
			modifier.Name, modifier.Label, modifier.Parent = "RecoveryPathCost", "JumpGully", part
		end
	end
end
function Test.run(player, states, pens, world, api, log)
	local s = states[player]
	assert(s.phase == "Home" and not s.item, "solo loop requires Home/empty hands")
	local initialCount, completed = pens[s.slot].count, s.completed
	local checked, preflight = validator(world, log)
	preflight(homePoints(pens[s.slot]))
	local monitor = {}
	local walk, r, h, navigate = driver(player, states, api, log, checked, monitor)
	for _, p in homeEntryPoints(pens[s.slot]) do
		walk(p.position, p.name)
	end
	act(api, player, "enterRun")
	local arena = api.arena()
	recoveryCosts(world)
	local started = s.started
	local carrySteps = Layout.loopCarrySteps(arena.layout)
	local dodgePoints = Layout.dodgePoints()
	local north = at(arena, dodgePoints[1].x, dodgePoints[1].y, dodgePoints[1].z)
	local south = at(arena, dodgePoints[2].x, dodgePoints[2].y, dodgePoints[2].z)
	local points = {}
	for i, p in dodgePoints do
		table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), name = "disc dodge option " .. i })
	end
	for i, p in Layout.referencePoints(arena.layout) do
		table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), name = "raised reference surface " .. i })
	end
	for _, p in arena.layout.routes.Quick do
		table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), name = "approach " .. p.kind })
	end
	for _, p in carrySteps do
		table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), name = p.name })
		if p.takeoff then
			local t = p.takeoff
			table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, t.x, t.y, t.z), name = "takeoff " .. p.name, edge = true })
		end
		if p.runup then
			local t = p.runup
			table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, t.x, t.y, t.z), name = "run-up " .. p.name, edge = true })
		end
	end
	for i, p in expiryExitSteps() do
		table.insert(points, { position = at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), name = "empty expiry exit " .. i })
	end
	preflight(points) -- enterRun creates the island; validate before island walking/Steal.
	local nestWait = os.clock() + Config.RespawnSeconds + 2
	while not api.rules.active or api.rules.active.state ~= "Nest" do
		assert(os.clock() < nestWait, "nest unavailable")
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	for _, p in arena.layout.routes.Quick do
		walk(at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), p.kind .. " approach")
	end
	hold(api, player, "Steal")
	local item = s.item
	assert(item and item.state == "Carried", "missing nest loot")
	monitor.item = item
	assert(not api.holdAction(player, "Steal", "finish"), "duplicate nest accepted")
	if s.counter == 1 then
		SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestFreshToSteal", os.clock() - s.joined)
	end
	local function dodge()
		h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		local began = os.clock()
		local telegraph
		repeat
			if s.item ~= item or os.clock() < (s.slowUntil or 0) or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
				return false
			end
			local t = arena.attack
			if t and t.disc and t.actor == player and t.start >= began then
				telegraph = t
				break
			end
			local flat =
				Vector3.new(r.Position.X - arena.guardian.Position.X, 0, r.Position.Z - arena.guardian.Position.Z)
			if flat.Magnitude < Config.GuardianThrowMinRange then
				local destination = (north - arena.guardian.Position).Magnitude
							> (south - arena.guardian.Position).Magnitude
						and north
					or south
				if not walk(destination, "make room for readable throw") then
					return false
				end
			end
			if os.clock() - began > 8 then
				log("no throw window / continuing legal carry")
				return true
			end
			api.audit()
			task.wait(0.03)
		until false
		assert(
			telegraph.disc.Parent
				and telegraph.disc:GetAttribute("ImpactDue") - telegraph.disc:GetAttribute("TelegraphStarted")
					>= Config.ThrowSeconds - 0.01,
			"telegraph missing/pre-impact delay"
		)
		local locked = telegraph.position
		local destination = (north - locked).Magnitude > (south - locked).Magnitude and north or south
		if not walk(destination, "Dodge locked red disc") then
			return false
		end
		if (Vector3.new(r.Position.X, locked.Y, r.Position.Z) - locked).Magnitude <= Config.ThrowRadius then
			log("still inside locked disc / observe legal impact before recovery")
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 8
		while arena.attack == telegraph do
			if s.item ~= item or os.clock() < (s.slowUntil or 0) or os.clock() >= item.escapeDeadline then
				return false
			end
			assert(os.clock() < deadline, "throw stuck >8s")
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
		assert(arena.throws > 0 and arena.chaseTicks > 0 and arena.chaseDistance > 0.1, "guardian never threw/chased")
		SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestTelegraphObserved", true)
		return true
	end
	local index, rejoin, expired = 1, false, false
	while index <= #carrySteps and s.phase == "Run" do
		if s.item ~= item then
			rejoin = true
		end
		local recovered = recover(api, player, states, navigate, item, log, checked)
		if not recovered then
			expired = true
			break
		end
		if rejoin then
			local portal = carrySteps[#carrySteps]
			local reached, reason =
				navigate(at(arena, portal.x, portal.y, portal.z), "recover directly to return portal", true)
			if not reached then
				if reason == "expiry" then
					expired = true
					break
				end
				continue
			end
			break
		end
		local step = carrySteps[index]
		if not step then
			break
		end
		local reached, reason = walk(
			at(arena, step.x, step.y, step.z),
			step.kind .. " " .. step.name,
			step.kind == "Jump",
			step.kind == "Return",
			step.takeoff and at(arena, step.takeoff.x, step.takeoff.y, step.takeoff.z),
			step.runup and at(arena, step.runup.x, step.runup.y, step.runup.z)
		)
		if not reached then
			if reason == "expiry" then
				expired = true
				break
			end
			rejoin = true
			continue
		end
		if s.phase == "Home" then
			break
		end
		if step.kind == "Dodge" then
			if not dodge() then
				rejoin = true
				continue
			end
		end
		if step.kind == "ClimbRamp" then
			SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestClimbObserved", true)
		end
		index += 1
	end
	if expired then
		verifyExpiry(player, states, pens, world, api, log, item, initialCount, completed)
		monitor.item = nil
		assert(returnPortal(player, states, api, log, navigate))
		api.audit()
		return "PASS-with-expiry / conserved loss " .. item.id, "expiry"
	end
	SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestPortalToPortal", os.clock() - started)
	SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestCatches", s.catches or 0)
	assert(item.securedAt < item.escapeDeadline, "solo did not escape inside deadline")
	place(player, states, pens, api, walk, log, item, initialCount)
	return "steal/secure/place; conserved " .. item.id, "placed"
end
function Test.pvp(player, states, pens, world, api, log, setDummy)

	end)

		for i = 2, #routes.Dummy do

			local p = routes.Dummy[i]
			dummyWalk(at(arena, p.x, p.y, p.z), "dummy court approach " .. i)
		end
		assert(recover(api, dummy, states, dummyNavigate, item, log, checked), "PvP cargo expired during dummy approach")
	end)

	assert(approachOK, approachProblem)
	record("phase", nil, "shield and Bump/drop/settle/Grab")
	log("guardian isolated at camp for PvP court; real shield/mercy/holds unchanged")
	-- Keep the dummy moving to avoid the production AFK drop while shield expires.
	while os.clock() < ds.shield + 0.05 do
		local pacing = routes.Pacing
		dummyWalk(at(arena, pacing[2].x, pacing[2].y, pacing[2].z), "dummy shield pacing")
		dummyWalk(at(arena, pacing[1].x, pacing[1].y, pacing[1].z), "dummy shield pacing")
		recover(api, dummy, states, dummyNavigate, item, log, checked)
	end
	local handoff = false

		dummyWalk(at(arena, court.x, court.y, court.z), "dummy handoff court")

			recover(api, dummy, states, dummyNavigate, item, log, checked)
		end
		-- Fixed court goals plus normal walk tolerance do not establish Bump range.
		-- Follow the live root using Humanoid movement, then re-read both roots.
		closeToDummy(api, walk, player, dummy)
		local pr, dr = api.root(player), api.root(dummy)
		assert(ds.item == item and item.holder == dummy and item.state == "Carried", "dummy not carrying at Bump")
		assert((pr.Position - dr.Position).Magnitude <= 3, "Bump setup outside live 3-stud approach range")
		log("Bump begin / actual distance " .. (pr.Position - dr.Position).Magnitude)

	for attempt = 1, Config.TestRecoverRetries do

local Test = {}
-- Shared acceptance cases: live floor/raycast fixture in Studio, scalar terrain
-- fixture under Lune. Accelerated clock proves lifecycle, not 90s wall time.
function Test.exercise(Traps, t, a, states, actorFactory, react)
	local points = {}
	local v4 = a.layout.version == 4
	for x = v4 and -150 or -66, v4 and 150 or 66, 12 do
		for z = v4 and -100 or 0, v4 and 120 or 66, 6 do
			local p = a.origin + Vector3.new(x, 0, -z)
			local floor = t.arenaAPI.floor(a, p)
			if floor and Traps.spot(t, a, floor, floor + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) then
				local spaced = true
				for _, other in points do
					if (other - floor).Magnitude < 12 then
						spaced = false
					end
				end
				if spaced then
					table.insert(points, floor)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	assert(#points >= 5, "need five freely selectable legal open-floor points")
	local owners = {}
	local function owner()
		local actor = actorFactory()
		local s = { phase = "Run", run = a, meadowEscapes = 0 }
		states[actor] = s
		table.insert(owners, actor)
		Traps.entry(t, actor, s)
		return actor, s
	end
	local first, s = owner()
	local p, r = points[1], points[1] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	local function action(stage, now, position, kind)
		return Traps.action(t, first, s, a, r, stage, position or p, now, kind)
	end
	assert(not action("begin", 0), "locked decoy accepted")
	first:SetAttribute("GreyboxDevTrapUnlock", true)
	assert(not action("begin", 15, p, "Sticky"), "Sticky unlocked by dev decoy grant")
	assert(action("begin", 15))
	assert(not action("finish", 15.5), "short hold accepted")
	assert(s.trapCharge and #t.active == 0, "short hold spent charge")
	assert(not action("begin", 16), "cooldown bypassed")
	assert(action("begin", 30))
	assert(action("cancel", 30.2))
	assert(s.trapCharge and not action("begin", 31), "cancel charge/cooldown")
	assert(action("begin", 45))
	assert(action("finish", 46, points[5])) -- Forged finish position must be ignored.
	local trap = t.active[1]
	assert((trap.position - p).Magnitude < 0.01, "client moved held placement")
	assert(not trap.part.CanCollide and not trap.part.CanQuery and not trap.part.CanTouch, "route-blocking trap")
	assert(not s.trapCharge and not action("begin", 61), "one charge/player")
	s.trapCharge = true -- Adversarial corrupted charge cannot bypass active-owner cap.
	assert(not action("begin", 61), "active-owner limit")
	s.trapCharge = false
	a.guardian.CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 1))
	a.guardian.Position = p + Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 1)
	Traps.tick(t, 47, states)
	assert(not a.decoy, "triggered before 2s arm")
	a.attack = { fixture = true }
	Traps.tick(t, 48, states)
	assert(not a.decoy and a.attack.fixture, "committed throw cancelled/retargeted")
	a.attack = nil
	Traps.tick(t, 49, states)
	assert(a.decoy and trap.tellEnd == 50.2 and trap.effectEnd == 52.2, "decoy tell/effect duration")
	a.target = first
	react(49, "DecoyTell")
	assert(not a.target, "decoy failed to release player target")
	react(50.3, "Investigate")
	Traps.tick(t, 52.3, states)
	assert(#t.active == 0 and not a.decoy and a.decoyImmuneUntil >= 60.2, "one-shot cleanup/immunity")
	Traps.entry(t, first, s)
	assert(not action("begin", 59), "entry refreshed cooldown")
	s.trapPickedUp = true
	assert(not action("begin", 80), "drop reopens planning")
	s.trapPickedUp = false
	assert(action("begin", 95))
	assert(action("finish", 96))
	Traps.tick(t, 185.9, states)
	assert(#t.active == 1, "early lifetime cleanup")
	Traps.tick(t, 186, states)
	assert(#t.active == 0, "90s lifetime cleanup")
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local actor, state = owner()
		state.meadowEscapes = 3
		assert(Traps.action(t, actor, state, a, points[i] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "begin", points[i], 200))
		assert(Traps.action(t, actor, state, a, points[i] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "finish", nil, 201))
	end
	local fifth, fifthState = owner()
	fifthState.meadowEscapes = 3
	assert(
		not Traps.action(t, fifth, fifthState, a, points[5] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "begin", points[5], 200),
		"fifth island trap"
	)
	assert(fifthState.trapCharge, "limit refusal consumed charge")
	assert(
		not Traps.spot(t, a, points[1] + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), points[1] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)),
		"elevated placement"
	)
	assert(not Traps.spot(t, a, Vector3.new(0 / 0, 0, 0), r), "NaN accepted")
	local rejected = v4 and { { 0, 96 }, { 0, -136 }, { -24, -136 }, { 148, -40 }, { 0, 0 }, { 0, 42 }, { 175, 60 } }
		or { { 0, 32 }, { 0, -58 }, { -24, -58 }, { -25, -10 }, { -32, -28 }, { 0, -24 }, { 79, 60 } }
	for _, point in rejected do
		local position = a.origin + Vector3.new(point[1], 0, -point[2])
		local floor = t.arenaAPI.floor(a, position) or position
		assert(not Traps.spot(t, a, floor, floor + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), "protected/only-route placement accepted")
	end
	local departing = t.active[1].owner
	states[departing].phase = "Home"
	Traps.tick(t, 202, states)
	assert(#t.active == 3, "owner exit orphan")
	Traps.remove(t, t.active[1].owner)
	assert(#t.active == 2, "disconnect/reset cleanup")
	Traps.clearIsland(t, a)
	assert(#t.active == 0, "arena expiry cleanup")
	-- Simulate other island managers filling the global server budget. Actual
	-- placement still executes the authoritative cap check before spending.
	for _ = 1, t.config.MaxServer do
		table.insert(t.active, { owner = {}, arena = {}, position = points[1] })

	assert(
		not Traps.action(t, fifth, fifthState, a, points[5] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "begin", points[5], 220),
		"8/server cap"
	)
	assert(fifthState.trapCharge, "server cap consumed charge")
	t.active = {}
	assert(Traps.action(t, fifth, fifthState, a, points[5] + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "begin", points[5], 235))
	assert(
		not Traps.action(t, fifth, fifthState, a, points[5] + Vector3.new(20, 3, 0), "finish", nil, 236),
		"finish skipped range revalidation"
	)
	assert(fifthState.trapCharge and #t.active == 0, "invalid finish consumed charge")
	for _, actor in owners do
		states[actor] = nil
	end

end
function Test.run(player, _states, api, log)
	local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local Traps = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxTraps"))
	local Arena = require(SSS:WaitForChild("GreyboxArena"))
	local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GreyboxConfig"))
	local a = api.arena()
	api.pvpCourt(true)
	local manager = Traps.new(Config, Arena, api.traps.make, api.traps.label)
	local saved = a.guardian.CFrame
	local savedImmunity = a.decoyImmuneUntil
	local actors = {}
	local ok, result = pcall(Test.exercise, Traps, manager, a, {}, function()
		local attributes = {}
		local actor = { UserId = -100 - #actors }
		function actor:GetAttribute(name)
			return attributes[name]
		end
		function actor:SetAttribute(name, value)
			attributes[name] = value
		end
		table.insert(actors, actor)
		return actor
	end, function(now, mode)
		Arena.tick(a, 0.05, now, {}, function()
			return nil
		end, function()
			error("decoy hit a player")
		end, function() end)
		assert(a.mode == mode and not a.attack, "guardian did not react: " .. mode)
	end)
	Traps.clearIsland(manager, a)
	Arena.reset(a)
	a.guardian.CFrame = saved
	a.decoyImmuneUntil = savedImmunity
	api.pvpCourt(false)
	assert(ok, result)
	log("player " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. result .. " (accelerated clock; real Studio floor)")
	return result
end
return Test

-- CC0 Kenney/Quaternius models; server-only, one sanitized template per island/name.
local Insert = game:GetService("InsertService")
local Storage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Tags = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local manifest = Http:JSONDecode(script.Manifest.Value)
local Kit = { manifest = manifest, failures = {}, templates = {}, loaded = 0 }
local state = "new"
local folder = Storage:FindFirstChild("KitTemplates") or Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name, folder.Parent = "KitTemplates", Storage
local function key(name, island) return island .. "__" .. name end
local function clearWalkable(node)
 node:SetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor", false)
 node:SetAttribute("Walkable", false)
 node:SetAttribute("LaneId", nil)
 for _, tag in {"AuthoredLaneFloor", "WalkableLaneFloor", "Walkable"} do
  Tags:RemoveTag(node, tag)
 end
end
-- Interim palette until the kits are re-imported with per-material meshes and textures.
local MATERIAL_LOOK = {
 meadow_leaf = { Color3.fromRGB(86, 168, 62), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
 cave_leaf = { Color3.fromRGB(92, 78, 120), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
 meadow_flower = { Color3.fromRGB(236, 120, 170), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic },
 cave_flower = { Color3.fromRGB(110, 210, 230), Enum.Material.Neon },
 wood = { Color3.fromRGB(132, 88, 52), Enum.Material.WoodPlanks },
 meadow_stone = { Color3.fromRGB(134, 136, 142), Enum.Material.Slate },
 cave_stone = { Color3.fromRGB(78, 80, 104), Enum.Material.Slate },
}
local function propType(name)
 if name:find("Tree") or name:find("Pine") or name:find("tree_") then return "tree" end
 if name:lower():find("flower") or name:lower():find("mushroom") or name:find("Pebble") then return "small" end
 if name:find("fence") or name:find("bridge") then return "infrastructure" end
 return "prop"
end
function Kit.init()
 if state == "ready" then return end
 if state == "loading" then repeat task.wait() until state == "ready"; return end
 state = "loading"
 local memoryBefore = Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()
 for _, entry in manifest do
  local id = key(entry.name, entry.island)
  local loaded, lastError
  for attempt = 1, 3 do
   local ok, result = pcall(function()
    local model = Insert:LoadAsset(entry.id)
    clearWalkable(model)
    local valid, err = pcall(function()
     local count = 0
     for _, node in model:GetDescendants() do
      clearWalkable(node)
      if node:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then node:Destroy()
      elseif node:IsA("BasePart") then
       count += 1
       node.Anchored, node.CanCollide, node.CanTouch, node.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
       -- RenderFidelity is plugin-only at runtime; imported meshes already default to Automatic.
       -- Bulk import dropped the kit colours; the mesh name carries its material (__<island>_<mat>).
       local mat = node.Name:match("__%a+_(%a+)$") or node.Name:match("__%a+_[%w_]+_(%a+)$")
       local look = MATERIAL_LOOK[(entry.island or "") .. "_" .. (mat or "")] or MATERIAL_LOOK[mat or ""]
       if look and node:IsA("MeshPart") and node.TextureID == "" then
        node.Color, node.Material = look[1], look[2]
       end
      end
     end
     assert(count > 0, "empty model")
     assert(count == entry.meshParts, "manifest MeshPart count differs")
     model.PrimaryPart = nil
     local box, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
     local shift = CFrame.new(-box.X, -box.Y + size.Y / 2, -box.Z)
     for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
      if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CFrame = shift * part.CFrame end
     end
     model.WorldPivot = CFrame.identity
     model:SetAttribute("KitNativeSize", size)
     model:SetAttribute("KitNativeScale", model:GetScale())
     model:SetAttribute("KitAssetId", entry.id)
     model:SetAttribute("KitIsland", entry.island)
     model:SetAttribute("KitName", entry.name)
     model:SetAttribute("KitTriangles", entry.triangles)
     model.Name = id
    end)
    if not valid then model:Destroy(); error(err) end
    return model
   end)
   if ok then loaded = result; break end
   lastError = tostring(result)
   warn(string.format("[KitLibrary] %s asset %s attempt %d/3 failed: %s", id, entry.id, attempt, lastError))
   if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt) end
  end
  if loaded then loaded.Parent = folder; Kit.templates[id] = loaded; Kit.loaded += 1
  else Kit.failures[id] = lastError; warn("[KitLibrary] FALLBACK original code-built prop: " .. id) end
 end
 state = "ready"
 folder:SetAttribute("Loaded", Kit.loaded)
 folder:SetAttribute("Expected", #manifest)
 folder:SetAttribute("MemoryBeforeMb",memoryBefore)
 folder:SetAttribute("MemoryAfterMb",Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb())
 folder:SetAttribute("LoadMemoryDeltaMb", folder:GetAttribute("MemoryAfterMb") - memoryBefore)
 folder:SetAttribute("TemplateInstances",#folder:GetDescendants())
 local triangles=0
 for _,t in Kit.templates do triangles+=t:GetAttribute("KitTriangles") or 0 end
 folder:SetAttribute("TemplateSourceTriangles",triangles)
 print(string.format("[KitLibrary] %d/%d templates; memory delta %.2f MB (whole server, not asset-exclusive)", Kit.loaded, #manifest, folder:GetAttribute("LoadMemoryDeltaMb")))
end
-- number = native-size multiplier; Vector3 = target bounding dimensions (uniform fit).
-- cframe is the bottom-centre base frame. Caller parents the returned model.
-- Missing model returns nil + reason; callers MUST retain/create their original prop.
function Kit.spawn(name, island, cframe, scale)
 Kit.init()
 local template = Kit.templates[key(name, island)]
 if not template then
  local reason = Kit.failures[key(name, island)] or "unknown manifest key"
  warn("[KitLibrary] FALLBACK " .. key(name, island) .. ": " .. reason)
  return nil, reason
 end
 local model = template:Clone()
 clearWalkable(model)
 local size = template:GetAttribute("KitNativeSize")
 local factor = scale or 1
 if typeof(factor) == "Vector3" then factor = math.min(factor.X / size.X, factor.Y / size.Y, factor.Z / size.Z) end
 assert(type(factor) == "number" and factor > 0 and factor < math.huge, "invalid kit scale")
 model:ScaleTo(template:GetAttribute("KitNativeScale") * factor)
 model:PivotTo(cframe)
 local kind = propType(name)
 local hasTrunk=false
 for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
  clearWalkable(p)
  if p:IsA("BasePart") then
   p.Anchored, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = true, false, false
   -- Decorative material components never participate in collision or landing rays.
   p.CanCollide = false
   if p.CanCollide then hasTrunk=true end
   p.CastShadow = kind ~= "small"
   -- RenderFidelity left at its imported default (plugin-only property).
  end
 end
 if kind=="tree" and not hasTrunk then
  local trunk=Instance.new("Part");trunk.Name="KitTrunkCollider"
  clearWalkable(trunk)
  trunk.Size=Vector3.new(math.min(size.X,size.Z)*0.08*factor,size.Y*0.35*factor,math.min(size.X,size.Z)*0.08*factor)
  trunk.CFrame=cframe*CFrame.new(0,trunk.Size.Y/2,0)
  trunk.Anchored,trunk.CanCollide,trunk.CanTouch,trunk.CanQuery=true,false,false,false
  trunk.Transparency=1;trunk.CastShadow=false;trunk.Parent=model
 end
 Tags:AddTag(model, "KitProp"); Tags:AddTag(model, island); Tags:AddTag(model, "KitType_" .. kind)
 model:SetAttribute("KitScale", factor)
 return model
end
-- Explicit fitted infrastructure only; foliage/rocks always use uniform ScaleTo.
-- Reject rotated component bases that would require mesh shearing.
function Kit.fit(model, target, frame)
 model:PivotTo(CFrame.identity)
 local pivot=CFrame.identity
 local _,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
 local ratio=target/size
 local edits={}
 for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then
  local cf=pivot:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
  local axes={cf.RightVector,cf.UpVector,-cf.LookVector}
  for _,a in axes do
   local v=math.max(math.abs(a.X),math.abs(a.Y),math.abs(a.Z))
   if v<0.9999 then return false,"non-axis-aligned component requires shear" end
  end
  local function axisScale(a) return math.abs(a.X)*ratio.X+math.abs(a.Y)*ratio.Y+math.abs(a.Z)*ratio.Z end
  table.insert(edits,{part=p,cf=CFrame.new(cf.Position*ratio)*cf.Rotation,
   size=p.Size*Vector3.new(axisScale(axes[1]),axisScale(axes[2]),axisScale(axes[3]))})
 end end
 for _,e in edits do e.part.Size=e.size;e.part.CFrame=frame*e.cf end
 model.WorldPivot=frame
 model:SetAttribute("KitFittedSize",target)
 return true
end
return Kit

   table.sort(posts,function(p,q) return (p.CFrame.Position-a.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<(q.CFrame.Position-a.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
   assert(#posts>=2,"fence bay has no posts")
   local pa,pb=posts[1],posts[2]
   local va=pa.CFrame.Position-Vector3.new(0,pa.Size.Y/2,0)
   local vb=pb.CFrame.Position-Vector3.new(0,pb.Size.Y/2,0)
   local right=(vb-va).Unit
   local back=right:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit;local up=back:Cross(right).Unit
   local mid=(va+vb)/2
   g.base=CFrame.new(mid.X,mid.Y,mid.Z,right.X,up.X,back.X,right.Y,up.Y,back.Y,right.Z,up.Z,back.Z)
   -- Imported end-post faces meet the retained post faces, never overlap them.
   g.size=Vector3.new((vb-va).Magnitude-pa.Size.X,4.5,pa.Size.Z)
   g.posts={pa,pb};g.ends={va,vb};g.fitted=true
   if math.abs(va.Y-vb.Y)>0.001 then g.keepReason="rigid kit end posts cannot match vertical posts on a sloped bay" end
   table.insert(result,g)
  end
 else
  -- Complete arch assemblies, clustered by plan position; labels/lights stay put.
  for _,family in {{"CaveArchStone","CaveArchVoussoir"},{"TunnelArchPier","TunnelArchVoussoir"}} do
   local remaining={}
   for _,p in parts do if p.Name==family[1] or p.Name==family[2] then remaining[p]=true end end
   for _,seed in parts do if remaining[seed] then
    local group={seed};remaining[seed]=nil;local i=1
    while i<=#group do
     local a=group[i]
     for p in remaining do
      local delta=p.CFrame.Position-a.CFrame.Position
      if math.sqrt(delta.X^2+delta.Z^2)<13 and math.abs(delta.Y)<30 then table.insert(group,p);remaining[p]=nil end
     end
     i+=1
    end
    local base,size=Plan.bounds(group)
    table.insert(result,{anchor=seed,parts=group,name=D.."wall-opening",base=base,size=size,fitted=true,arch=true})
   end end
  end
  for _,p in parts do
   if p.Name=="CaveMouthTimber" or p.Name=="CampShelterTimber" or p.Name=="CartStationTimber" or p.Name=="MainGatewayTimber" then
    local base,size=Plan.bounds({p})
    table.insert(result,{anchor=p,parts={p},name=D.."wood-support",base=p.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-p.Size.Y/2,0),size=p.Size,fitted=true})
   end
  end
 end
 if island=="cave" then
  local station=root:FindFirstChild("CartStationTimber",true)
  if station then
   local crates={}
   for _,g in result do if g.anchor.Name:find("Crate") then table.insert(crates,g) end end
   table.sort(crates,function(a,b) return (a.base.Position-station.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<(b.base.Position-station.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
   if crates[1] then crates[1].name=D.."barrel" end
   if crates[2] then crates[2].name=D.."chest" end
  end
 end
 return result
end
-- Conservative footprint test: every component, every deck, including stacked
-- routes. Project into each deck's local frame and reserve a full stud outside
-- its edges. Dropping a placement is preferable to obscuring a walking lane.
function Plan.laneClear(parts, lanes)
 for _,p in parts do
  if not p:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
  for _,lane in lanes do
   local lo,hi=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge),Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
   for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,y in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
    local v=lane.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(p.Size*Vector3.new(x,y,z)/2))
    lo=Vector3.new(math.min(lo.X,v.X),math.min(lo.Y,v.Y),math.min(lo.Z,v.Z))
    hi=Vector3.new(math.max(hi.X,v.X),math.max(hi.Y,v.Y),math.max(hi.Z,v.Z))
   end end end
   if hi.X >= -lane.Size.X/2-1 and lo.X <= lane.Size.X/2+1
    and hi.Z >= -lane.Size.Z/2-1 and lo.Z <= lane.Size.Z/2+1 then return false,lane.Name end
  end
 end
 return true
end
function Plan.lanes(root)
 local lanes={}
 for _,p in root:GetDescendants() do
  if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:HasTag("AuthoredLaneFloor") and p:GetAttribute("WalkableLaneFloor")==true then table.insert(lanes,p) end
 end
 return lanes
end
function Plan.bridgeCandidate(root)
 local deck={}
 for _,p in root:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name=="BridgeTimberPlank" then table.insert(deck,p) end end
 if #deck==0 then return nil end
 local base,size=Plan.bounds(deck)
 return {base=base,size=size,parts=deck,name=N.."bridge_wood"}
end
return Plan

local Kit = require(script.Parent.KitLibrary)
local Plan = require(script.Parent.KitPlan)
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local applied = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local function apply(root,island)
 if applied[root] then return end
 applied[root]=true
 Kit.init()
 if not root:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
 local memoryBefore=Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()
 local before=#root:GetDescendants()
 local primitiveProxy,curved=0,0
 for _,p in root:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency<1 then
  if p:IsA("WedgePart") then primitiveProxy+=8
  elseif p:IsA("Part") and p.Shape==Enum.PartType.Block then primitiveProxy+=12
  else curved+=1 end
 end end
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="KitDressing";folder.Parent=root
 local count,failed,meshParts,triangles=0,0,0,0
 local groups=Plan.groups(root,island)
 local lanes=Plan.lanes(root)
 local dropped=0
 local function clear(model, originals)
  if island~="meadow" then return true end
  local ok=Plan.laneClear(model:GetDescendants(),lanes)
  if originals then ok=ok and Plan.laneClear(originals,lanes) end
  if ok then return true end
  model:Destroy();dropped+=1
  -- Remove obsolete collision carriers with the rejected dressing placement.
  if originals then for _,p in originals do p:Destroy() end end
  return false
 end
 local function add(name,frame,size)
  local m=Kit.spawn(name,island,frame,size)
  if not m then failed+=1;return end
  if not clear(m) then return end
  for _,p in m:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide=false;p.CanQuery=false end end
  m.Parent=folder;count+=1;triangles+=m:GetAttribute("KitTriangles") or 0
  for _,p in m:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("MeshPart") then meshParts+=1 end end
 end
 for index,g in groups do
  -- This native wall is a gameplay collider. Rejecting its kit placement must
  -- never delete the wall with the cosmetic originals.
  local gameplayCover=false
  for _,p in g.parts do if p:GetAttribute("GameplayCover") or p:GetAttribute("OutsmartBaitCover") then gameplayCover=true;break end end
  if gameplayCover then continue end
  if g.keepReason then failed+=1;warn("[KitSwap] FALLBACK "..g.anchor.Name..": "..g.keepReason);continue end
  local scale=if g.fitted then 4 else g.size
  if g.tree then
   local template=Kit.templates[island.."__"..g.name]
   if template then
    local native=template:GetAttribute("KitNativeSize")
    scale=g.size.Y/native.Y
   end
  end
  local model,reason=Kit.spawn(g.name,island,g.base,scale)
  if not model then failed+=1;continue end
  if g.fitted then
   local ok,err=Kit.fit(model,g.size,g.base)
   if not ok then model:Destroy();failed+=1;warn("[KitSwap] FALLBACK "..g.anchor.Name..": "..err);continue end
  end
  if not clear(model,g.parts) then continue end
  -- Accepted placements retain original collision/query/touch carriers and names.
  -- Kit meshes cannot change lanes, reachable drops, cart contacts, or trunk hulls.
  for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide=false;p.CanQuery=false end end
  model.Name="Kit_"..g.anchor.Name.."_"..index
  model:SetAttribute("KitAssemblyId",island..":"..index)
  model:SetAttribute("KitOriginalBase",g.base)
  if g.tree then model:SetAttribute("KitTargetHeight",g.size.Y) end
  if g.fence then
   model:SetAttribute("KitJointStart",g.ends[1]);model:SetAttribute("KitJointEnd",g.ends[2])
   -- Existing shared posts close all bay ends, including failed adjacent bays.
  end
  model.Parent=folder
  for _,p in g.parts do
   p:SetAttribute("KitOriginalTransparency",p.Transparency)
   p:SetAttribute("KitAssemblyId",island..":"..index)
   p.Transparency=1 -- undo: restore this attribute, remove KitDressing
  end
  count+=1;triangles+=model:GetAttribute("KitTriangles") or 0
  for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("MeshPart") then meshParts+=1 end end
  -- Three-piece accents stay inside existing bush/rock footprints, not on lanes.
  if island=="meadow" and g.anchor.Name:find("Bush") and index%4==0 then
   local w,d=math.min(g.size.X/4,2),math.min(g.size.Z/4,2)
   add("quaternius-nature__Pebble_Round_1",g.base*CFrame.new(w,0,d),Vector3.new(1.2,0.3,1))
   add("kenney_nature-kit__log",g.base*CFrame.new(-w,0,d),Vector3.new(2.5,1,2.5))
   add("kenney_nature-kit__stump_round",g.base*CFrame.new(w,0,-d),Vector3.new(1.4,1,1.4))
  end
 end
 if island=="cave" then
  local station=root:FindFirstChild("CartStationTimber",true)
  if station then
   local crates={}
   for _,g in groups do if g.anchor.Name:find("Crate") then table.insert(crates,g) end end
   table.sort(crates,function(a,b) return (a.base.Position-station.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<(b.base.Position-station.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
   -- Place station dressing on the existing crate cluster footprints.
   for i=1,math.min(3,#crates) do
    local g=crates[i]
    add("quaternius-nature__Mushroom_Common",g.base*CFrame.new(g.size.X/2,0,g.size.Z/2),Vector3.new(0.8,0.8,0.8))
   end
  end
 end
 if island=="meadow" then
  local bridge=Plan.bridgeCandidate(root)
  local template=Kit.templates[island.."__kenney_nature-kit__bridge_wood"]
  if bridge and template then
   local native=template:GetAttribute("KitNativeSize")
   local ratio=bridge.size/native
   if math.max(ratio.X,ratio.Y,ratio.Z)/math.min(ratio.X,ratio.Y,ratio.Z)<1.15 then
    -- A bridge deck is itself a lane; retain the native walking surface.
    root:SetAttribute("KitBridgeFit","kept: kit dressing excluded from lanes")
   else
    root:SetAttribute("KitBridgeFit","kept: uniform bridge asset does not fit thin ravine deck")
    warn("[KitSwap] bridge_wood does not fit ravine deck; original planks retained")
   end
  else root:SetAttribute("KitBridgeFit","kept: no deck or loaded bridge template") end
 end
 if island=="meadow" then
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   local section=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.Section1)
   section.spawnKits(root,Kit)
   section.clearProps(root)
  end)
  if not ok then warn("[KitSwap] Section1 dressing skipped: "..tostring(err)) end
   local ok2,err2=pcall(function()
    require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").MeadowV4.Section2).spawnKits(root,Kit)
   end)
   if not ok2 then warn("[KitSwap] Section2 dressing skipped: "..tostring(err2)) end
 end
 root:SetAttribute("KitSwapVersion",1)
 root:SetAttribute("KitLanePlacementsDropped",dropped)
 root:SetAttribute("KitSwapped",count);root:SetAttribute("KitFallbacks",failed)
 root:SetAttribute("KitInstancesBefore",before);root:SetAttribute("KitInstancesAfter",#root:GetDescendants())
 root:SetAttribute("KitMeshParts",meshParts);root:SetAttribute("KitSourceTriangles",triangles)
 root:SetAttribute("KitMemoryDeltaMb",Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()-memoryBefore)
 root:SetAttribute("KitPrimitiveTriangleProxyBefore",primitiveProxy)
 root:SetAttribute("KitUnknownCurvedPartsBefore",curved)
 root:SetAttribute("KitMemoryBeforeMb",memoryBefore)
 root:SetAttribute("KitMemoryAfterMb",Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb())
 print(string.format("[KitSwap] %s: %d swaps, %d fallbacks; instances %d -> %d; meshes %d; source triangles %d; memory delta %.2f MB",island,count,failed,before,#root:GetDescendants(),meshParts,triangles,root:GetAttribute("KitMemoryDeltaMb")))
end
local function watch(node)
 if node:IsA("Model") and (node.Name=="MeadowV4" or node.Name=="CaveV2") then
  task.spawn(apply,node,node.Name=="MeadowV4" and "meadow" or "cave")
 end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
for _,node in workspace:GetDescendants() do watch(node) end
task.spawn(Kit.init)

-- Studio integration: live Meadow colliders + production attack/trap/guardian code.
-- Bounded accelerated clock with yields; never awards items, Coins or time.
local Test = {}
function Test.run(api, log)
	local RS, SSS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local Arena, Traps = require(SSS.GreyboxArena), require(RS.GreyboxTraps)
	local Kit, Pose = require(RS.MeadowKeeper.Attacks), require(RS.MeadowKeeper.Pose)
	local O, Config = require(RS.MeadowV4.Outsmart), require(RS.GreyboxConfig)
	local a, rows, stage, logged = api.arena(), {}, "setup", 0
	local seen = {}
	local saved = {cf=a.guardian.CFrame, corner=a.wallBaitCorner, immunity=a.decoyImmuneUntil}
	local fixtures = Instance.new("Folder")
	fixtures.Name, fixtures.Parent = "OutsmartFixtures", a.model
	local manager = Traps.new(Config, Arena, function(parent, ...)
		return api.traps.make(parent == a.model and fixtures or parent, ...)
	end, api.traps.label)
	manager.rattle = api.traps.rattle
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name, root.Anchored, root.CanCollide, root.CanTouch, root.CanQuery = "OutsmartRunner", true, false, false, false
	root.Transparency, root.Parent = 1, fixtures
	local actor = {UserId=-9001, GetAttribute=function() return nil end}
	local states = {[actor]={phase="Run", run=a, meadowEscapes=3, mercy=0}}
	local state, now = states[actor], os.clock()
	local function check(value, message)
		assert(value, stage .. ": " .. message)
		if not seen[message] then
			seen[message] = true
			if #rows < 64 then table.insert(rows, message) end
			if logged < 12 then logged+=1; log(message) end
		end
	end
	local function ground(localPoint)
		return assert(Arena.floor(a, a.origin + localPoint + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), "missing live walking floor")
	end
	local function tick(dt)
		now += dt
		Traps.tick(manager, now, states)
		Arena.tick(a, dt, now, states, function(who) return who==actor and root or nil end,
			function() error("fixture received an attack hit") end, function() end)
		task.wait(0.03)
	end
	api.pvpCourt(true)
	local ok, why = pcall(function()
		stage = "wall bait"
		a.wallBaitCorner = nil -- Isolated fixture; restore live memory on cleanup.
		local start, bait = ground(O.Start), ground(O.Bait)
		local level, laneDetail = O.levelApproach(a, Arena.floor)
		check(level, "chosen corner has level approach: " .. laneDetail)
		a.guardian.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(start+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0), bait+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0))
		root.Position = bait+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
		local target = root.Position
		check(Kit.begin(a, actor, target, now, "dash", Arena, Pose), "locked dash starts at marked corner")
		local locked = a.attack.direction
		local stars, impact = 0, nil
		local attackAPI = table.clone(Arena)
		attackAPI.fx = function(arena, name, p, radius)
			if name=="WallStun" then stars+=1; impact=p end
			Arena.fx(arena,name,p,radius)
		end
		for i=1,24 do
			now+=0.05
			if i==8 then root.Position=ground(Vector3.new(-58,0,100))+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
			if a.attack then
				check(a.attack.direction==locked, "dash aim remains committed")
				Kit.step(a,now,states,function() return root end,function() error("sidestep hit") end,attackAPI,Pose)
			end
			task.wait(0.03)
			if not a.attack then break end
		end
		check(a.keeperStunUntil and stars==1 and impact~=nil, "wall impact requests stun and literal-star FX once")
		tick(0.05)
		check(a.guardian:GetAttribute("KeeperClip")=="stun", "wall impact drives live rig stun pose")
		check((a.wallBaitCorner-(a.origin+O.Corner)).Magnitude<13, "stun belongs to chosen broad cover")
		check(a.keeperStunUntil-now<=1.55+0.001, "wall stun capped at 1.55s")
		local firstEnd, corner = a.keeperStunUntil, a.wallBaitCorner
		stage = "no repeat corner"
		-- Adversarial forced second dash after cooldown must still earn no stun.
		now+=13
		a.guardian.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(start+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0),bait+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0))
		check(Kit.begin(a,actor,target,now,"dash",Arena,Pose), "repeat collision fixture starts")
		for _=1,24 do
			now+=0.05
			if a.attack then Kit.step(a,now,{},function() end,function() error("repeat hit") end,attackAPI,Pose) end
			task.wait(0.03)
			if not a.attack then break end
		end
		check(stars==1 and a.keeperStunUntil==firstEnd and a.wallBaitCorner==corner, "same corner cannot refresh stun or stars")
		a.guardian.CFrame=CFrame.new(start+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0))
		root.Position=a.guardian.Position+Vector3.new(0,-2.5,-20)
		a.throws,a.kitCooldowns=1,{}
		check(Kit.choose(a,actor,now,states,function() return root end)=="fan", "corner recovery selects another attack")
		stage = "bell"
		Arena.reset(a)
		a.decoyImmuneUntil=0
		local point = ground(O.Bell)
		local legal, detail = Traps.spot(manager,a,point,point+Vector3.new(0,3,0))
		check(legal,"legal pre-steal bell floor with open bypass: " .. tostring(detail))
		root.Position=point+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
		Traps.entry(manager,actor,state)
		check(Traps.action(manager,actor,state,a,root.Position,"begin",point,now),"unlocked pre-steal bell begins")
		now+=1.01
		check(Traps.action(manager,actor,state,a,root.Position,"finish",nil,now),"one bell charge placed")
		local trap=manager.active[1]
		check(trap.bell and not trap.bell.CanCollide and not state.trapCharge,"visible bell spends one charge, blocks nobody")
		a.guardian.CFrame=CFrame.new(point+Vector3.new(Config.Traps.Decoy.TriggerRange-1,5.5,0))
		now=trap.armed-0.01; Traps.tick(manager,now,states)
		check(not a.decoy,"bell cannot trigger before arm")
		a.attack={fixture=true}; now+=0.02; Traps.tick(manager,now,states)
		check(not a.decoy and a.attack.fixture,"bell preserves committed attack")
		a.attack=nil
		tick(0.05)
		local rattleAt=trap.part:GetAttribute(Traps.RattleTimeSignal)
		check(a.mode=="DecoyTell" and trap.part:GetAttribute(Traps.RattleSignal)==true

	end)

	local failure={stage=stage,error=ok and "" or tostring(why):sub(1,2000),checks=rows,clock=now,

		rattled=bell and bell.part:GetAttribute(Traps.RattleSignal),rattleAt=bell and bell.part:GetAttribute(Traps.RattleTimeSignal),
		soundPlayed=bell and bell.part:GetAttribute("RattleSoundPlayed"),tellEnd=bell and bell.tellEnd,effectEnd=bell and bell.effectEnd,
