ServerScriptService.StudioPass:
-- Studio-only pass coordinator. Live tests retain their own authoritative assertions.
local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Pass = {}
function Pass.attach(api)
	local control = Instance.new("Folder")
	control.Name, control.Parent = "StudioPassControl", RS
	local function debugToggle()
		control:SetAttribute("ShowDebug", SSS:GetAttribute("ShowDebug") == true)
	end
	SSS:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShowDebug"):Connect(debugToggle)
	debugToggle()
	game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if control:GetAttribute("ShowDebug") then
			control:SetAttribute("KeeperState", api.keeperState())
		end
	end)
	local captureSerial = 0
	SSS:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaptureShots"):Connect(function()
		if SSS:GetAttribute("CaptureShots") then
			captureSerial += 1
			control:SetAttribute("CaptureShots", captureSerial)
			SSS:SetAttribute("CaptureShots", false)
		end
	end)
	local running = false
	local names = {
		"GreyboxSelfTest",
		"DropSampleTest",
		"GreyboxLoopTest",
		"GreyboxPvpTest",
		"GreyboxTrapTest",
		"CoreLoopTest",
		"RavineTest",
		"TunnelTest",
		"OutsmartTest",
	}
	local function run()
		if running or not SSS:GetAttribute("StudioPassAll") then
			return
		end
		running = true
		SSS:SetAttribute("StudioPassBusy", true)
		local began, rows = os.clock(), {}
		local summary = {
			status = "RUNNING",
			tests = rows,
			evidence = "Studio legacy tests + live Outsmart collision; core mock store; ravine/tunnel policy assertions",
		}
		local function publish()
			summary.seconds = os.clock() - began
			SSS:SetAttribute("StudioPassResult", Http:JSONEncode(summary))
		end
		for _, name in names do
			SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "StudioPassStatus", "NOT RUN")
			SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "StudioPassSeconds", 0)
		end
		publish()
		local prepared, failure = pcall(api.prepare)
		local activeThread
		local ok, why = pcall(function()
			assert(prepared, failure)
			SSS:SetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestRuns", 3)
			for _, name in names do
				local start = os.clock()
				local passed, detail = pcall(function()
					api.reset()
					if name == "OutsmartTest" then SSS:SetAttribute("OutsmartTestFailureJSON", "{}") end
					if name == "RavineTest" or name == "TunnelTest" then
						return require(RS.MeadowV4.PolicyTests)[name](
							require(RS.MeadowV4.RavinePolicy),
							require(RS.MeadowV4.TunnelPolicy)
						)
					end
					SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "Result", "RUNNING")
					SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "Success", false)
					if name == "GreyboxSelfTest" or name == "CoreLoopTest" then
						SSS:SetAttribute(name, true)
					else
						SSS:SetAttribute(name, true)
						activeThread = api.start(name)
					end
					local deadline = os.clock() + ((name == "GreyboxLoopTest" or name == "DropSampleTest") and 900 or 300)
					repeat
						task.wait(0.1)
					until SSS:GetAttribute(name .. "Result") ~= "RUNNING" or os.clock() > deadline
					assert(os.clock() <= deadline, name .. " timed out")
					activeThread = nil
					local result = tostring(SSS:GetAttribute(name .. "Result"))
					assert(result:sub(1, 4) == "PASS", result)
					if name ~= "GreyboxSelfTest" then
						assert(SSS:GetAttribute(name .. "Success") == true, result)
					end
					if name == "GreyboxLoopTest" then
						assert(SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestPassCount") == 3, "three runs required")
						assert(
							(SSS:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTestExpiryCount") or 3) < 3,
							"balance failure: all runs expired, no secure/place"
						)
					end
					return result
				end)
				if activeThread then
					pcall(task.cancel, activeThread)
					activeThread = nil
				end
				local row = { name = name, pass = passed, seconds = os.clock() - start, result = tostring(detail) }
				if name == "OutsmartTest" and not passed and SSS:GetAttribute("OutsmartTestFailureJSON") == "{}" then
					SSS:SetAttribute("OutsmartTestFailureJSON", Http:JSONEncode({stage="harness",error=tostring(detail):sub(1,2000)}))
				end
				table.insert(rows, row)
				SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "StudioPassStatus", passed and "PASS" or "FAIL")
				SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "StudioPassSeconds", row.seconds)
				if name == "RavineTest" or name == "TunnelTest" then
					SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "Success", passed)
					SSS:SetAttribute(name .. "Result", (passed and "PASS: " or "FAIL: ") .. row.result)
				end
				print(
					"[StudioPass] "
						.. name
						.. " "
						.. (passed and "PASS" or "FAIL")
						.. " "
						.. row.seconds
						.. "s "
						.. row.result
				)
				publish()
			end
		end)
		local clean, cleanup = true, nil
		if prepared then
			clean, cleanup = pcall(api.reset)
		end
		local all = ok and clean and #rows == #names
		for _, row in rows do
			all = all and row.pass
		end
		summary.status = all and "PASS" or "FAIL"
		summary.error = not ok and tostring(why) or (not clean and tostring(cleanup) or nil)
		publish()
		SSS:SetAttribute("StudioPassSuccess", all)
		SSS:SetAttribute("StudioPassBusy", false)
		SSS:SetAttribute("StudioPassAll", false)
		running = false
	end
	SSS:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StudioPassAll"):Connect(function()
		task.spawn(run)
	end)
	task.spawn(run)
end
return Pass

local function beginHold(input)
	if not selected or not Config.HoldSeconds[selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction")] or holding then
		return
	end
	holding, heldInput, began, sentFinish = selected, input, os.clock(), false
	trapHeldPosition = selected == trapChoice and trapCandidate or nil
	remote:FireServer(selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction"), "begin", selected == trapChoice and trapCandidate or nil)
end
button.Activated:Connect(function()
	if selected and not Config.HoldSeconds[selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction")] then
		remote:FireServer(selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction"))
	end
end)
button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		beginHold(input)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or not selected or shown[selected] then
		return -- native E/X owns input while its prompt is visible
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then
		if Config.HoldSeconds[selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction")] ~= nil then
			beginHold(input)
		else
			remote:FireServer(selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction"))
		end
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if
		input == heldInput
		or (
			heldInput
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			and input.UserInputType == heldInput.UserInputType
			and input.KeyCode == heldInput.KeyCode
		)
	then
		cancelHold()
	end
end)
UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(cancelHold)
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ok, reason)
	if not ok then
		goal.Text = "Action refused: " .. tostring(reason)
	end
end)

local portalInRange = false
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	local r = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local slot = player:GetAttribute("GreyboxPen")
	highlight.Adornee = slot and world:FindFirstChild("PenMarker" .. slot) or nil
	local nearest, distance = nil, math.huge
	local phase, carrying = player:GetAttribute("GreyboxPhase"), player:GetAttribute("GreyboxCarry")
	if r then
		for q in prompts do
			local action, parent = q:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction"), q.Parent
			local owner = q:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
			local legal = (action == "Enter" and phase == "Home" and not carrying)
				or (action == "Return" and phase == "Run")
				or (action == "Steal" and phase == "Run" and not carrying)
				or (action == "Grab" and phase == "Run" and not carrying)
				or (action == "Bump" and phase == "Run" and not carrying and q:GetAttribute("CarrierUserId") ~= player.UserId)
				or (action == "Place" and phase == "Home" and carrying and q:GetAttribute("PenSlot") == slot)
			if
				legal
				and q.Enabled
				and parent
				and parent:IsA("Attachment")
				and (not owner or owner == player.UserId)
			then
				local d = (r.Position - parent.WorldPosition).Magnitude
				local clear = true
				if action == "Bump" or action == "Grab" then
					local params = RaycastParams.new()
					params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances =
						Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, { world:FindFirstChild("SharedIsland") }
					clear = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, parent.WorldPosition - r.Position, params) == nil
				end
				if d <= q.MaxActivationDistance and d < distance and clear then
					nearest, distance = q, d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	trapPreview.Transparency, trapCandidate, trapHint.Visible = 1, nil, false
	if not nearest and r and phase == "Run" and not carrying and player:GetAttribute("GreyboxTrapUnlocked") then
		local island = world:FindFirstChild("SharedIsland")
		local ownTrap
		if island then
			for _, p in island:GetChildren() do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("TrapOwner") == player.UserId then
					ownTrap = p
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if ownTrap then
			nearest = recallChoice
		elseif player:GetAttribute("GreyboxTrapAvailable") and island and workspace.CurrentCamera then
			if not previewArena or previewArena.model ~= island then
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, { island }
				previewArena = {
					model = island,
					origin = Vector3.new(Config.MeadowX, Config.MeadowHeight, Config.MeadowZ),
					layout = Layout.assemble(Config, island:GetAttribute("Seed"), true),
					params = params,
				}
			end
			previewManager.active = {}
			for _, part in island:GetChildren() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("TrapType") then
					table.insert(
						previewManager.active,
						{ arena = previewArena, owner = part:GetAttribute("TrapOwner"), position = part.Position }
					)
				end
			end
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local ray = camera:ScreenPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
			if UserInputService.TouchEnabled or UserInputService:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
				ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
			end
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, { island }
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 500, params)
			if holding == trapChoice and trapHeldPosition then
				hit = { Position = trapHeldPosition }
			end
			if hit then
				trapPreview.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0))
					* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
				trapPreview.Transparency = 0.5
				local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				if now >= nextPreviewCheck then
					nextPreviewCheck, checkedPoint = now + 0.1, hit.Position
					previewValid, previewWhy = Traps.eligible(previewManager, player, {
						phase = "Run",
						run = previewArena,
						trapCharge = true,
						meadowEscapes = player:GetAttribute("GreyboxMeadowEscapes"),
						trapCooldown = player:GetAttribute("GreyboxTrapCooldownUntil"),
					}, previewArena, hit.Position, r.Position, now, holding == trapChoice)
				end
				local valid = previewValid and checkedPoint and (checkedPoint - hit.Position).Magnitude < 0.25
				local why = checkedPoint and (checkedPoint - hit.Position).Magnitude >= 0.25 and "Checking floor"
					or previewWhy
				trapHint.Visible = not valid
				local remaining = math.max(0, (player:GetAttribute("GreyboxTrapCooldownUntil") or 0) - now)
				trapHint.Text = remaining > 0 and ("Decoy ready in " .. math.ceil(remaining) .. "s") or tostring(why)
				trapPreview.Color = valid and Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
				if valid then
					trapCandidate, nearest = hit.Position, trapChoice
				end
			end
		end
	end
	selected = nearest
	if holding and holding ~= selected then
		cancelHold()
	end
	button.Visible = selected ~= nil and not player:GetAttribute("GreyboxLoopTesting")
	if selected then
		local action = selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction")
		button.Text = Config.HoldSeconds[action] and ("Hold to " .. action .. " [E / X]") or action .. " [E / X]"
		if action == "Trap" then
			button.Text = "Hold to place Decoy [E / X]"
		elseif action == "TrapRecall" then
			button.Text = "Recall Decoy [E / X]"
		elseif action == "Enter" and player:GetAttribute("GreyboxTrapUnlocked") then
			button.Text = "Enter Meadow / Decoy selected [E / X]"
		end
		if holding then
			local elapsed = os.clock() - began
			button.Text =
				string.format("Hold %d%%", math.min(100, math.floor(elapsed / Config.HoldSeconds[action] * 100)))
			if elapsed >= Config.HoldSeconds[action] and not sentFinish then
				sentFinish = true
				remote:FireServer(selected:GetAttribute("GreyboxAction"), "finish")
			end
		end
	end
	local portal = world:FindFirstChild("HomePortal", true)
	local inRange = r and portal and (r.Position - portal.Position).Magnitude <= 9
	if inRange and not portalInRange then
		local q = portal:FindFirstChild("ActionPoint"):FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
		local localPos, half = portal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(r.Position), portal.Size / 2
		local surface = Vector3.new(
			math.max(0, math.abs(localPos.X) - half.X),
			math.max(0, math.abs(localPos.Y) - half.Y),
			math.max(0, math.abs(localPos.Z) - half.Z)
		).Magnitude
		local centre = (r.Position - portal.Position).Magnitude
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cameraDistance = camera and (camera.CFrame.Position - portal.Position).Magnitude or -1
		player:SetAttribute("GreyboxPortalCentreDistance", centre)
		player:SetAttribute("GreyboxPortalSurfaceDistance", surface)
		print(
			string.format(
				"[GreyboxPrompt] portal range centre=%.3f surface=%.3f camera=%.3f enabled=%s service=%s maxVisible=%d style=%s shown=%s",
				centre,
				surface,
				cameraDistance,
				tostring(q.Enabled),
				tostring(PromptService.Enabled),
				PromptService.MaxPromptsVisible,
				q.Style.Name,
				tostring(shown[q] == true)
			)
		)
		if not PromptService.Enabled or PromptService.MaxPromptsVisible == 0 then
			warn("[GreyboxPrompt] global prompt service suppresses native UI; fallback remains available")
		end
	end
	portalInRange = inRange == true
end)
StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.HomeA:
-- HOME-only presentation. Never creates LootId, consumes cargo, or delays input.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Blocks = require(RS:WaitForChild("NativeBlocks"))
local Data = require(RS:WaitForChild("HomeArtGeometry"))
local CoreConfig = require(RS:WaitForChild("TreasureCore").Config)
local Style = require(RS:WaitForChild("UIStyle"))
local world = workspace:WaitForChild("GREYBOX")
local templates, pending, active = {}, {}, {}
local PET_SCALE = 1.6 -- >=4-stud pet height, inside the existing placement footprint.
local replacedHome = {
	CentralStonePath = true,
	CyanPortalDisc = true,
	LockedPortalDisc = true,
	PortalFoot = true,
	LockedPortalTerrace = true,
	TerraceLanding = true,
	LanternPost = true,
	LanternCap = true,
	LanternLight = true,
}
local function replaced(name)
	return replacedHome[name] or name:match("^PortalArchStone") or name:match("^TerraceStep")
end
local function petCaption(root, model, kind)
	local text, gui = Style.billboard(root, "HomePetCaption", UDim2.new(6, 36, 2.8, 18), 90, false)
	gui.Parent = model
	local _, bounds = model:GetBoundingBox()
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, bounds.Y + 1, 0)
	text.RichText = true
	local tier = root:GetAttribute("PetTier")
	if tier then
		local rarity = CoreConfig.Rarities[tier]
		local color = Style.rarity(rarity)
		text.Text = (root:GetAttribute("PetName") or kind)
			.. '\n<font color="#' .. color:ToHex() .. '">* ' .. rarity.name .. '</font>'
			.. '\n<font color="#FFCF41">$ +'
			.. tostring(root:GetAttribute("PetRate") or 0)
			.. ' /s</font>'
		if tier > 1 then
			local outline = Instance.new("Highlight")
			outline.FillColor, outline.OutlineColor = color, color
			outline.FillTransparency, outline.OutlineTransparency = 0.92, 0.15
			outline.DepthMode, outline.Adornee, outline.Parent = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded, model, model
			local socket = Instance.new("Attachment")
			socket.Parent = root
			socket.Name = "CoreRaritySparkles"
			local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			particles.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
			particles.Rate, particles.Lifetime, particles.Speed = 3, NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.2), NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
			particles.Color, particles.LightEmission = ColorSequence.new(color), 0.5
			particles.Parent = socket
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color, light.Brightness, light.Range, light.Parent = color, 0.35, 6, socket
		end
		return
	end
	text.Text = kind
		.. '\n<font color="'
		.. (kind == "Crow" and "#42E9FF" or "#A5FF67")
		.. '">'
		.. (kind == "Crow" and "Rare" or "Common")
		.. "</font>\n+? coins/s"
	text.Parent = gui
end
local function destroy(entry)
	if entry.model then
		entry.model:Destroy()
	end
	if entry.burst then
		entry.burst:Destroy()
	end
end
local function template(name)
	if templates[name] then
		return templates[name]
	end
	-- Cache one native template per asset; every instance clones it.
	while pending[name] do
		task.wait()
	end
	if templates[name] then
		return templates[name]
	end
	pending[name] = true
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "HomeArt_" .. name
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local count = 0
		for _, section in ipairs(Data[name]) do
			local neon = section.name == "PortalLight"
				or section.name == "PortalGreen"
				or section.name == "Cyan"
				or section.name == "LampLight"
				or section.name == "Lava"
			local material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			if name == "Decor" then
				local id = section.name:lower()
				material = (id:find("wood") or id:find("brown")) and Enum.Material.WoodPlanks
					or (id:find("grass") or id:find("leaf") or id:find("green")) and Enum.Material.Grass
					or id:find("path") and Enum.Material.Cobblestone
					or Enum.Material.Slate
			end
			count += Blocks.section(section, model, CFrame.identity, neon and Enum.Material.Neon or material)
		end
		model.WorldPivot = CFrame.identity -- JSON origin is the feet, not bounding centre.
		Blocks.log("HomeArt " .. name, count)
	end)
	pending[name] = nil
	if not ok then
		model:Destroy()
		warn("[HomeArt] " .. name .. " geometry failed: " .. tostring(err) .. "; using emergency block build")
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Name = "HomeArt_" .. name
		for _, section in ipairs(Data[name] or {}) do
			Blocks.section(
				{ name = section.name, color = section.color, vertices = section.vertices, triangles = {} },
				model,
				CFrame.identity,
				Enum.Material.Slate
			)
		end
		model.WorldPivot = CFrame.identity
	end
	templates[name] = model
	return model
end
local function clone(name)
	return template(name):Clone()
end
-- Local-only reusable mesh source for the Index's real pet silhouettes.
local preview = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
preview.Name, preview.Parent = "CorePetPreview", RS
preview.OnInvoke = clone
local function species(id)
	local sum = 0
	for i = 1, #id do
		sum += string.byte(id, i)
	end
	return sum % 2 == 0 and "Pup" or "Crow" -- Visual variation only; no rarity/economy claim.
end
local function burst(root)
	local socket = Instance.new("Attachment")
	socket.Name, socket.Parent = "HomeAcornReveal", root
	local sparkle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkle.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	sparkle.Enabled, sparkle.Rate = false, 0
	sparkle.Lifetime, sparkle.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.8), NumberRange.new(3, 7)
	sparkle.SpreadAngle, sparkle.LightEmission = Vector2.new(180, 180), 1
	sparkle.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 222, 105))
	sparkle.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	sparkle.Parent = socket
	sparkle:Emit(24)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name, sound.Volume, sound.RollOffMaxDistance = "HomeRevealPop", 0.45, 48
	-- Owner can set a cleared sound ID on HomeArtGeometry in Studio; no upload needed.
	sound.SoundId = RS.HomeArtGeometry:GetAttribute("RevealSoundId") or "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
	sound.Parent = socket
	if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
		sound:Play()
	end
	task.delay(2, function()
		socket:Destroy()
	end)
	return socket
end
local function acornGlow(model, summit)
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Name, anchor.Size, anchor.Transparency = "AcornGlowAnchor", Vector3.one, 1
	anchor.Anchored, anchor.CanCollide, anchor.CanQuery, anchor.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
	anchor.CFrame, anchor.Parent = CFrame.new(0, 2, 0), model
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Brightness, light.Range = Color3.fromRGB(255,218,103), summit and 1.2 or 0.55, summit and 18 or 8
	light.Parent = anchor
	local sparkles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkles.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	sparkles.Rate, sparkles.Lifetime, sparkles.Speed = summit and 9 or 3, NumberRange.new(0.8,1.6), NumberRange.new(0.5,1.5)
	sparkles.SpreadAngle, sparkles.LightEmission = Vector2.new(180,180), 0.7
	sparkles.Color, sparkles.Size = ColorSequence.new(light.Color), NumberSequence.new(0.22)
	sparkles.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2,0.15),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
	sparkles.Parent = anchor
	if summit then
		local a, b = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Position, b.Position = Vector3.new(0,1,0), Vector3.new(0,66,0)
		a.Parent, b.Parent = anchor, anchor
		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Name, beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = "SummitBeacon", a, b
		beam.FaceCamera, beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = true, 4.4, 1.8
		beam.Color, beam.LightEmission = ColorSequence.new(light.Color), 1
		beam.LightInfluence, beam.Brightness = 0, 3
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8,0.38),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
		beam.Parent = anchor
	end
end
local function observe(root)
	if not root:IsA("BasePart") or not root:GetAttribute("LootId") or active[root] then
		return
	end
	local entry = { generation = 0 }
	active[root] = entry
	local function change()
		entry.generation += 1
		local generation = entry.generation
		destroy(entry)
		local oldFx = root:FindFirstChild("CoreRaritySparkles")
		if oldFx then
			oldFx:Destroy()
		end
		entry.model, entry.burst, entry.started, entry.kind = nil, nil, nil, nil
		entry.hidden = nil
		root.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
		for _, gui in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
				gui.Enabled = true
			end
		end
		local state = root:GetAttribute("LootState")
		local meadowAcorn = state == "Nest" or state == "Carried" or state == "Dropped"
		if state ~= "Secured" and state ~= "Placed" and not meadowAcorn then
			return
		end
		local isCore = root:GetAttribute("CoreState") ~= nil
		local isPet = isCore and root:GetAttribute("CoreState") == "Pet" or not isCore and state == "Placed"
		local kind = isPet and (root:GetAttribute("PetModel") or species(root:GetAttribute("LootId"))) or "Acorn"
		entry.kind = kind
		for _, caption in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if caption:IsA("TextLabel") then
				caption.Text = kind == "Acorn" and "Golden Acorn" or kind
			end
		end
		-- Late join shows the current acorn without replaying an old celebration.
		local reveal = isCore
				and isPet
				and root:GetAttribute("RevealAt")
				and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - root:GetAttribute("RevealAt") < 1
			or not isCore and state == "Secured" and entry.previous ~= nil and entry.previous ~= "Secured"
		entry.isPet = isPet
		entry.previous = state
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, model = pcall(clone, reveal and "OpenAcorn" or kind)
			if not ok then
				warn("[HomeArt] mesh loader failed: " .. tostring(model))
				return
			end
			if active[root] ~= entry or generation ~= entry.generation or not root:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				model:Destroy()
				return
			end
			entry.model, entry.started = model, reveal and os.clock() or nil
			if meadowAcorn then
				acornGlow(model, state == "Nest")
				model:ScaleTo(state == "Nest" and 1.8 or 1.2)
				entry.beacon = model:FindFirstChild("SummitBeacon", true)
			end
			entry.fragments = {}
			if reveal then
				for _, piece in model:GetChildren() do
					if piece:IsA("BasePart") and (piece.Name == "CapBrown" or piece.Name == "StemBrown") then
						entry.fragments[piece] = model:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(piece.CFrame)
					end
				end
			end
			if isPet and not reveal then
				model:ScaleTo(PET_SCALE)
				local pad = Instance.new("Part")
				pad.Name, pad.Size, pad.Position = "CosmeticPetPad", Vector3.new(5, 0.2, 5), Vector3.new(0, -0.1, 0)
				pad.Color, pad.Material = Color3.fromRGB(103, 119, 130), Enum.Material.Slate
				pad.Anchored, pad.CanCollide, pad.CanQuery, pad.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
				if not isCore then
					pad.Parent = model
				else
					pad:Destroy()
				end
				petCaption(root, model, kind)
				for _, gui in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
					if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
						gui.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
			model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, isPet and -1.25 or -1.5, 0))
			model.Parent = world
			root.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			for _, child in root:GetDescendants() do
				if child:IsA("BasePart") and (child.Name == "AcornCap" or child.Name == "AcornStem") then
					child.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end
			if reveal then
				entry.burst = burst(root)
			end
		end)
	end
	root:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LootState"):Connect(function()
		local previous = entry.previous
		change()
		entry.previous = root:GetAttribute("LootState") or previous
	end)
	for _, name in { "CoreState", "PetModel", "PetRate" } do
		root:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(change)
	end
	change()
	entry.previous = root:GetAttribute("LootState")
end
-- Carried parts are parented to Characters, so observe all workspace descendants.
local function watch(root)
	observe(root)
	-- Attribute replication can follow DescendantAdded on a newly created loot root.
	if
		root:IsA("BasePart")
		and (root.Name == "LOOT" or root.Name == "Golden Acorn" or root.Name:match("^Placed_"))
		and not active[root]
	then
		root:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LootId"):Connect(function()
			observe(root)
		end)
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
for _, root in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	watch(root)
end
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, decor = pcall(clone, "Decor")
	if not ok then
		warn("[HomeArt] decor loader failed: " .. tostring(decor))
		return
	end
	decor.Name, decor.Parent = "HomeArtDecor", world
	for _, p in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
		if
			p:IsA("BasePart")
			and p.Name:match("^Pen")
			and (p.Name:find("Rail") or p.Name == "PenPost" or p.Name == "PenAccessPath")
		then
			p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		end
	end
	local home = world:WaitForChild("HomeFloatingIsland")
	for _, p in ipairs(home:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and (p.Name == "TreeTrunk" or p.Name:find("BlockCanopy")) then

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	for root, entry in pairs(active) do
		if not root:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			destroy(entry)
			active[root] = nil
		elseif entry.model then
			if entry.beacon and entry.beacon.Parent then
				-- Five-second breath; widths include the approved 1.8x nest scale.
				local pulse = 1 + 0.07 * math.sin(os.clock() * math.pi * 2 / 5)
				entry.beacon.Width0, entry.beacon.Width1 = 4.4 * 1.8 * pulse, 1.8 * 1.8 * pulse
			end
			-- Recovery temporarily hides the authoritative loot; hide its cosmetics too.
			local hidden = root.Transparency >= 1
			if hidden ~= entry.hidden then
				entry.hidden = hidden
				for _, node in entry.model:GetDescendants() do
					if node:IsA("BasePart") then node.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0
					elseif node:IsA("Beam") or node:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or node:IsA("PointLight") then
						node.Enabled = not hidden
					end
				end
			end
			local t = entry.started and os.clock() - entry.started
			local scale = t and (1 + 0.22 * math.sin(math.min(t / 0.35, 1) * math.pi)) or 1
			if t then
				entry.model:ScaleTo(scale)
			end
			entry.model:PivotTo(
				root.CFrame
					* CFrame.new(
						0,
						(entry.kind ~= "Acorn" and -1.25 or -1.5)
							+ (t and 0.5 * math.sin(math.min(t, 1) * math.pi) or 0),
						0
					)
			)
			if t then
				local pop = math.clamp(t / 0.65, 0, 1) * 1.6
				for piece, localFrame in entry.fragments do
					piece.CFrame = entry.model:GetPivot()
						* CFrame.new(localFrame.Position * scale + Vector3.new(0, pop, 0))
						* localFrame.Rotation
				end
			end
			if t and t > 1 then
				entry.started = nil
				local generation = entry.generation
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, model = pcall(clone, entry.isPet and entry.kind or "Acorn")
					if not ok then
						warn("[HomeArt] acorn loader failed: " .. tostring(model))
						return
					end
					if active[root] ~= entry or generation ~= entry.generation then
						model:Destroy()
						return
					end
					entry.model:Destroy()
					entry.model = model
					if entry.isPet then
						model:ScaleTo(PET_SCALE)
						petCaption(root, model, entry.kind)
						for _, gui in root:GetDescendants() do
							if gui:IsA("BillboardGui") then
								gui.Enabled = false
							end
						end
					end
					model.Parent = world
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Upload-free native block visuals; gameplay and projectile stay on server.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("MeadowKeeper")
local Rig = require(folder.Rig)
local Animator = require(folder.Animator)
local Pose = require(folder.Pose)
local FX = require(folder:WaitForChild("Effects"))
local Props = require(folder:WaitForChild("Projectiles"))
local projectiles = {}
folder:WaitForChild("FXEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(guard, name, position, radius)
	FX.emit(guard, name, position, radius)
end)
local function projectile(node)
	if not node:IsA("BasePart") or projectiles[node] then
		return
	end
	local kind = node:GetAttribute("KeeperProjectile")
	if not kind then
		return
	end
	projectiles[node] = { pending = true }
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, prop = pcall(Props.build, kind, workspace)
		if not ok then
			projectiles[node] = nil
			warn("[Keeper prop] " .. tostring(prop))
			return
		end
		if not node.Parent then
			prop.model:Destroy()
			projectiles[node] = nil
			return
		end
		projectiles[node] = { prop = prop, kind = kind, at = os.clock() }
		node.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		FX.trail(kind == "fan" and prop.pieces[1].part or node, kind)
	end)
end
local loading, active = {}, {}
local function attach(guard)
	if not guard:IsA("BasePart") or not guard:GetAttribute("MeadowKeeper") or loading[guard] or active[guard] then
		return
	end
	loading[guard] = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, rig = pcall(Rig.build, Pose.ground(guard))
		loading[guard] = nil
		if not ok then
			warn("[MeadowKeeper] native block rig failed: " .. tostring(rig))
			return
		end
		if not guard:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			Rig.destroy(rig)
			return
		end
		rig.model.Name, rig.model.Parent = "MeadowKeeper", guard.Parent
		-- Fixed animation/projectile sockets: keep proven scale, strengthen silhouette.
		local outline = Instance.new("Highlight")
		outline.Name, outline.Adornee = "KeeperReadability", rig.model
		outline.FillTransparency, outline.OutlineTransparency = 1, 0.08
		outline.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 135)
		outline.DepthMode, outline.Parent = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded, rig.model
		local anim = Animator.new(rig)
		local attention = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		attention.Name, attention.Size = "BellAttention", UDim2.fromOffset(90, 90)
		attention.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
		attention.Adornee, attention.Parent = guard, rig.model
		attention.Enabled = false
		local question = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		question.Size, question.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1
		question.Text, question.TextScaled, question.Font = "?", true, Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		question.TextColor3, question.TextStrokeTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 70), 0.15
		question.Parent = attention
		anim.connection:Disconnect() -- The shared server timestamp drives rendering.
		local held = Instance.new("Part")
		held.Name, held.Shape, held.Size = "KeeperHeldRock", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		held.Anchored, held.CanCollide, held.CanTouch, held.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
		held.Transparency, held.Parent = 1, rig.model
		local cap = Instance.new("Part")
		cap.Name, cap.Shape, cap.Size = "KeeperHeldAcornCap", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.52, 1.08, 2.52)
		cap.Color, cap.Material = Color3.fromRGB(75, 48, 27), Enum.Material.Wood
		cap.Anchored, cap.CanCollide, cap.CanTouch, cap.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
		cap.Transparency, cap.Parent = 1, rig.model
		local log = Props.build("lob", rig.model)
		local acornOk, acorn = pcall(Props.build, "fan", rig.model)
		if not acornOk then
			warn("[Keeper acorn] " .. tostring(acorn))
			acorn = nil
		end
		active[guard] = { rig = rig, anim = anim, held = held, cap = cap, log = log, acorn = acorn, attention = attention }
	end)
end
local function observe(node)
	projectile(node)
	if node:IsA("BasePart") then
		node:GetAttributeChangedSignal("KeeperProjectile"):Connect(function()
			projectile(node)
		end)
	end
	if node:IsA("BasePart") and node.Name == "Guardian" then
		node:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MeadowKeeper"):Connect(function()
			attach(node)
		end)
		attach(node)
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(observe)
for _, node in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	observe(node)
end
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
	for node, entry in pairs(projectiles) do
		if not node.Parent then
			if entry.prop then
				entry.prop.model:Destroy()
			end
			projectiles[node] = nil
		elseif entry.prop then
			Props.move(
				entry.prop,
				node.CFrame * CFrame.Angles((os.clock() - entry.at) * 18, 0, 0),
				node.Transparency < 1
			)
		end
	end
	for guard, entry in pairs(active) do
		if not guard:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			entry.anim:Destroy()
			Rig.destroy(entry.rig)
			FX.reset(guard)
			active[guard] = nil
		else
			entry.attention.Enabled = guard:GetAttribute("KeeperAttention") == "Investigate"
			entry.rig.root.CFrame = Pose.ground(guard)
			local name = guard:GetAttribute("KeeperClip") or "idle"
			if name ~= entry.clip then
				entry.clip = name
				local events =
					{ warn = "Warn", chase = "Chase", ["return"] = "Return", celebrate = "Celebrate", stun = "Stun" }
				if events[name] then
					FX.emit(guard, events[name], guard.Position)
				end
			end
			local clip = Animator.Clips[name]
			local time = guard:GetAttribute("KeeperElapsed") or 0
			local started = guard:GetAttribute("KeeperStartedAt")
			if started then
				time = math.max(0, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - started)
			end
			if clip.loop then
				time %= clip.duration
			else
				time = math.min(time, clip.duration)
			end
			local pose = Animator.sample(name, time)
			local target = guard:GetAttribute("KeeperLookTarget")
			if target then
				local direction = Pose.ground(guard):VectorToObjectSpace(target - guard.Position)
				local yaw = math.clamp(math.atan2(direction.X, direction.Z), -0.45, 0.45)
				-- Two-hand heave keeps the gaze on the committed forward aim.
				-- Turning the broad hat toward a moving target would hit the raised mittens.
				if name == "lob" then
					yaw = 0
				end
				pose.Head *= CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
			end
			entry.anim:Apply(pose)
			entry.held.Size = name == "lob" and Vector3.new(4, 4, 4) or Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4)
			entry.held.Transparency = (name == "throw" or name == "lob" or name == "fan")
					and time < Pose.ReleaseSeconds
					and 0
				or 1
			entry.held.CFrame = entry.rig:ReleaseCFrame(pose, name)
			entry.cap.Transparency = name == "fan" and time < Pose.ReleaseSeconds and 0 or 1
			entry.cap.CFrame = CFrame.new(entry.held.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.912, 0))
			-- Legacy carriers are hidden; real themed props follow the identical socket.
			entry.held.Transparency, entry.cap.Transparency = 1, 1
			Props.move(entry.log, entry.held.CFrame, name == "lob" and time >= 0.20 and time < Pose.ReleaseSeconds)
			if entry.acorn then
				Props.move(entry.acorn, entry.held.CFrame, name == "fan" and time < Pose.ReleaseSeconds)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Local, non-collidable debug geometry and camera capture; never enabled in live servers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
if not Run:IsStudio() then
	return
end
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local control = RS:WaitForChild("StudioPassControl")
local routes = require(RS:WaitForChild("MeadowV4"):WaitForChild("RouteData"))
local origin = Vector3.new(0, 76, -360)
local function point(p)
	return origin + Vector3.new(p.x, p.y, -p.z)
end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.Parent = "StudioPassDebug", false, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size, text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 82), UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -96)

text.TextXAlignment, text.Parent = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, gui
local folder, timers, last = nil, {}, "No completed route"
local function toggle()
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		folder = nil
	end
	timers, last = {}, "No completed route"
	gui.Enabled = control:GetAttribute("ShowDebug") == true
	if not gui.Enabled then
		return
	end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name, folder.Parent = "StudioPassRouteLines", workspace
	local keys = {}
	for name in routes do
		table.insert(keys, name)
	end
	table.sort(keys)
	for index, name in keys do
		local route = routes[name]
		for i = 2, #route do
			local a, b = point(route[i - 1]) + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), point(route[i]) + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)
			if (b - a).Magnitude < 0.01 then
				continue
			end
			local line = Instance.new("Part")
			line.Name, line.Size, line.CFrame =
				name, Vector3.new(0.13, 0.13, (b - a).Magnitude), CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
			line.Anchored, line.CanCollide, line.CanQuery, line.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
			line.Material, line.Color, line.Parent = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromHSV(index / #keys, 0.8, 1), folder
		end
	end
end
control:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShowDebug"):Connect(toggle)
toggle()
local tickAt = 0
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not gui.Enabled or os.clock() < tickAt then
		return
	end
	tickAt = os.clock() + 0.1
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local current = {}
	for name, route in routes do
		-- Endpoint gates: elapsed includes turns, combat and pauses; this is not a centerline proof.
		local a, b =
			(root.Position - point(route[1])).Magnitude < 6, (root.Position - point(route[#route])).Magnitude < 6
		local timer = timers[name]
		if not timer and (a or b) then
			timers[name] =
				{ began = os.clock(), reverse = b and not a, left = false, carry = player:GetAttribute("GreyboxCarry") }
		elseif timer then
			if not a and not b then
				timer.left = true
			end
			if timer.left and (timer.reverse and a or not timer.reverse and b) then
				last = string.format(
					"%s %s %s %.2fs",
					name,
					timer.reverse and "reverse" or "forward",
					timer.carry and "carry" or "empty",
					os.clock() - timer.began
				)
				player:SetAttribute("StudioPassWalkTime", last)
				print("[StudioPassWalkTime] " .. last)
				timers[name] = nil
			else
				table.insert(current, string.format("%s %.1fs", name, os.clock() - timer.began))
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(current)
	local handle = workspace:FindFirstChild("GREYBOX")
	handle = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("Guardian", true)
	text.Text = "Keeper: "
		.. tostring(control:GetAttribute("KeeperState"))
		.. "/"
		.. tostring(handle and handle:GetAttribute("KeeperClip"))
		.. " | exit "
		.. tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("TunnelGuardedExit"))
		.. " | guarding "
		.. tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("TunnelGuardWaiting"))
		.. "\n"
		.. last
		.. "\n"
		.. table.concat(current, " | ")
end)
local generation = 0
local function capture()
	generation += 1
	local token = generation
	task.spawn(function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end
		local saved = { camera.CameraType, camera.CFrame, camera.FieldOfView, camera.CameraSubject }
		local shots = {
			{ "portal", Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 130), Vector3.new(0, 53, -96), 70 },
			{ "summit", Vector3.new(0, 53.5, -96), Vector3.new(-76, 5.5, -27), 70 },
			{ "bridge", Vector3.new(0, 9, 0), Vector3.new(40, 0, 24), 70 },
			{ "tunnel mouth", Vector3.new(-76, 5.5, -35), Vector3.new(-76, 5.5, 5), 70 },
			{ "tunnel inside", Vector3.new(-76, 5.5, 0), Vector3.new(-76, 5.5, 35), 70 },
			{ "east ridge", Vector3.new(148, 25.5, 24), Vector3.new(148, 27.5, 56), 70 },
			{ "home island", Vector3.new(0, 150, 260) - origin, Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) - origin, 40 },
		}
		local pet
		for _, node in workspace:WaitForChild("GREYBOX"):GetDescendants() do
			if
				node:IsA("BasePart")
				and node:GetAttribute("CoreState") == "Pet"
				and node:GetAttribute("PenSlot") == player:GetAttribute("GreyboxPen")
			then
				pet = node
				break
			end
		end
		local target = pet and pet.Position
			or (player.Character and player.Character:GetPivot().Position or Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		table.insert(shots, { "pet reveal", target - origin + Vector3.new(8, 5, 10), target - origin, 50 })
		local selected
		Run:BindToRenderStep("StudioPassCapture", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
			if selected then
				camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				camera.CFrame, camera.FieldOfView =
					CFrame.lookAt(origin + selected[2], origin + selected[3]), selected[4]
			end
		end)
		local ok, why = pcall(function()
			for _, shot in shots do
				if token ~= generation then
					break
				end
				selected = shot
				player:SetAttribute("StudioPassShot", shot[1])
				print(
					"[CaptureShots] "
						.. shot[1]
						.. (shot[1] == "pet reveal" and not pet and " MISSING PET: complete manual Open first" or "")
				)
				task.wait(2)
			end
		end)
		Run:UnbindFromRenderStep("StudioPassCapture")
		camera.CameraType, camera.CFrame, camera.FieldOfView, camera.CameraSubject =
			saved[1], saved[2], saved[3], saved[4]
		player:SetAttribute(
			"StudioPassShot",
			ok and (pet and "DONE" or "FAIL: pet reveal missing") or "FAIL: " .. tostring(why)
		)
	end)
end
local capturing = false
control:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaptureShots"):Connect(function()
	if capturing then
		return
	end
	capturing = true
	capture()
	task.delay(17, function()
		capturing = false
	end)
end)

local function indexText()
	local found = {}
	for name in (player:GetAttribute("PetDiscoveries") or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do
		found[name] = true
	end
	for i, rarity in config.Rarities do
		local caption = index:FindFirstChild("Entry" .. i)
		if caption then
			caption.Text = found[rarity.pet] and (rarity.pet .. "\n" .. rarity.name)
				or "?\nUndiscovered"
			caption.TextColor3 = found[rarity.pet] and Style.rarity(rarity) or Style.Colors.Cream
		end
		local view = index:FindFirstChild("Silhouette" .. i)
		if view then
			for _, part in view:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					if not part:GetAttribute("OriginalColor") then
						part:SetAttribute("OriginalColor", part.Color)
					end
					part.Color = found[rarity.pet] and part:GetAttribute("OriginalColor")
						or Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Safe-area coordinates from ScreenGui; fit the modal on small landscape phones.
local function fit()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local v = camera.ViewportSize
	local compact = v.Y < 520 or v.X < 600
	counter.Position, counter.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 56), UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 165 or 210, compact and 60 or 72)
	status.Position, status.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, compact and 120 or 132), UDim2.fromOffset(210, 26)
	indexButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -144, 0, 56)
	index.AnchorPoint, index.Position = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	local scale = index:FindFirstChild("Fit") or Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Name, scale.Scale, scale.Parent = "Fit", math.min(1, (v.Y - 60) / 360, (v.X - 32) / 300), index
	card.AnchorPoint, card.Position, card.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.new(0, math.min(340, v.X - 32), 0, 160)
end
local viewportConnection
local function bindCamera()
	if viewportConnection then
		viewportConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	fit()
	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		viewportConnection = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit)
	end
end
workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(bindCamera)

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Style = require(RS:WaitForChild("UIStyle"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local cards = {}
local function styledPrompt(node)
	return node:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (node.Name == "CoreOpen" or node:GetAttribute("CoreCollectSlot") ~= nil)
end
local function decorate(node)
	if not node:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	if node:IsA("BasePart") then
		local route = node:GetAttribute("RouteLabel")
		if route then
			for _, gui in node:GetChildren() do
				if gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
					gui:Destroy()
				end
			end
			Style.sign(node, route)
		end
	elseif styledPrompt(node) then
		-- Greybox actions retain their existing single action button/input path.
		node.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	elseif node:IsA("TextLabel") and not node:FindFirstChild("LetterOutline") then
		local gui = node.Parent
		if gui and (gui:IsA("SurfaceGui") or gui:IsA("BillboardGui")) then
			local color = node.TextColor3
			Style.lettering(node, node.Text == "!" and 64 or 36, 1)
			node.TextColor3 = color
		end
	end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(node)
	task.defer(decorate, node)
end)
for _, node in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	decorate(node)
end

local function hide(prompt)
	local card = cards[prompt]
	if not card then return end
	cards[prompt] = nil
	if card.held then
		prompt:InputHoldEnd()
	end
	for _, connection in card.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	card.gui:Destroy()
end
PromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt, inputType)
	if not styledPrompt(prompt) or cards[prompt] then return end
	local owner = prompt:GetAttribute("CoreOwner")
	if owner and owner ~= player.UserId then return end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name, gui.Adornee, gui.Size = "OpenPrompt", prompt.Parent, UDim2.fromOffset(220, 68)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop, gui.MaxDistance, gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = true, 40, Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size, button.Parent = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), gui
	Style.panel(button, Style.Colors.Gold, 22)
	Style.icon(button, "route")
	local hold = prompt.HoldDuration > 0
	local key = inputType == Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Touch and (hold and "Tap + hold" or "Tap")
		or inputType == Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Gamepad and (hold and "Hold X" or "X") or (hold and "Hold E" or "E")
	local caption = key .. "  " .. prompt.ActionText .. "\n" .. prompt.ObjectText
	button.Text = caption
	local card = {gui = gui, connections = {}, held = false}
	cards[prompt] = card
	local function finish()
		if card.held then
			card.held = false
			prompt:InputHoldEnd()
		end
	end
	table.insert(card.connections, button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			card.held = true
			prompt:InputHoldBegin()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(card.connections, Input.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			finish()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(card.connections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function()
		button.Text = prompt.ActionText .. "...\n" .. prompt.ObjectText
	end))
	table.insert(card.connections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function()
		button.Text = caption
	end))
end)
PromptService.PromptHidden:Connect(hide)
workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(node)
	if cards[node] then
		hide(node)
	end
end)
